armor_sets.name: Circuit
armor_sets.perk_2pc_desc:
While Movement Speed is at least ?m/s:
Grants a stack of Revving Up, with a maximum of 10 stacks.
Transforms into Fully Revved at 10 stacks.
Each Revving Up stack grants increased Critical Health Regeneration Speed. Does not affect Shields in any way.
By default, it takes 1.75 seconds for Critical Health to begin regenerating at a rate of 27.5%HP/s.
At x5 stacks, it takes 1.5 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of ~37.5% HP/s.
At x10 stacks, it takes 1.25 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of 45% HP/s
Sprinting: 5 seconds per stack, takes 45 seconds to max out regardless of speed.
Other movement (Jumping, Falling, Sword Swinging, Sparrows) greatly accelerate the rate based on their speed, down to a minimum of 1.25 seconds per stack.
Most easily achieved by using a Sparrow, as those reach the Movement Cap.
While Movement Speed is lower than 3m/s:
Rapidly removes 4 stacks per second after a 0.5 second delay.
While Fully Revved is ready:
Sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.
Triggering Speed Booster and sliding at least once grants Extended Slide Distance until death.
armor_sets.perk_4pc_desc:
While Speed Booster is active:
Sliding inflicts Jolt to Combatants within 10 meters in a frontal cone.

Both effects can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.

glossary.name: Devour
glossary.description:
Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%

glossary.name: Invisibility
glossary.description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

glossary.name: Overshield
glossary.description:
Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds.
Void Overshield's HP portion has 70% Damage Resist (150eHP) against Combatants.

Damage dealt to Void Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat's OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".

glossary.name: Void Breach
glossary.description:
Void Elemental Pickup.

Grants 11.25% Class Ability Energy on Pickup. Allies do not receive Void Breaches created by the user.
Lasts 25 seconds before disappearing. Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Void Breach spawns.

glossary.name: Suppression
glossary.description:
Suppressed Enemies are removed from active abilities and are unable to use abilities for 10 [5] seconds.

Suppressed Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants also become disoriented and will be unable to shoot.

Suppressed Guardians are removed from their active Super Ability and Transcendence, and cannot use Grenade, Melee, Class, Super, Movement Abilities, and Transcendence.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon being Suppressed.

glossary.name: Volatile
glossary.description:
Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after being dealt 190 [200] damage or upon dying, dealing up to 145 [80] Void Ability Damage in a 5 meter radius.
Volatile lasts for 10 [6] seconds, harmlessly expiring afterwards. Debuff is removed after triggering the explosion.
The damage from the hit that applies Volatile doesn't count towards the detonation threshold. 

Incurs a 1 second cooldown before Volatile can be reapplied to an enemy after the explosion is triggered.

glossary.name: Volatile Rounds
glossary.description: Void Weapons inflict Volatile upon dealing damage and deal 10% increased Weapon Damage against Champions while Volatile Rounds are active.

glossary.name: Weaken
glossary.description:
Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Weakened Combatants become less accurate and slower.

Unique Weaken Effects:
Certain sources of Weaken inflict a dramatically stronger weaken that grants 30% [generally 50%] increased damage.

Shadowshot: Moebius grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies.

Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst.
Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force and Fafnir (Quantum Nova Active) grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages.
Fafnir's, Felwinter's, Tractor's weaken duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.

Shadowshot: Deadfall uniquely grants 35% [50%?] increased damage against tethered enemies.

Shadowshot fires a single Deadfall Anchor that attaches to surfaces and enemies, pulling all enemies within 12.5 metres towards it upon impact. 
Void Anchor activates on a 1 second delay after it detects an enemy within 12.5 metres, or automatically after 30 seconds have passed.

Deals 2,583 [?] Damage on impact, inflicting Deadfall Weaken and Suppression to enemies within ? meters. Counts as a Construct with ? HP.

Super Duration: 16 seconds [20 with Orpheus Rigs]

Upon killing a Priority Target:

Solar Elemental Pickup

glossary.name: Radiant
glossary.description:
Increases Weapon Damage by 20% [10%] for 10 seconds and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
Also affects Golden Gun's Damage.

Reapplying Radiant will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration.

Damage Buff effect is increased to 30% against Champions. Well of Radiance's 25% overrides the 30% against Champions.

glossary.name: Restoration
glossary.description:
Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s
Healing Effect does not stack with Healing Rift.

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.
If the new duration is longer than the previous longest, the new duration is used instead.
Eg: If the maximum Restoration duration achieved was 15 seconds, a Phoenix Dive or Healing Grenade will refresh it to 15 seconds.
Using a Phoenix Dive after using a Healing Grenade will refresh its duration to 4+2 seconds.
Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

glossary.name: Ignition
glossary.description:
Explosion that deals 676 [120 Guardians | 250 Construct] Solar Damage in a 8 meter radius without [with] damage falloff. 
Ignitions remove all Scorch, and incur a 1.6 second cooldown before Scorch can be reapplied. 

Ignition damage can be increased through certain damage increases if the initial Scorch source had a damage increase.
Eg: Verity's Brow x5 + Fusion Grenade = 100% Increased Ignition Damage.
Melee Damage Buffs do not scale Ignition nor Scorch damage.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving Ignition damage.

glossary.name: Scorch
glossary.description:
Scorched Enemies are dealt Scorch-stack based damage every 0.56 seconds after being scorched for 0.5 seconds. 
All Scorch is removed upon reaching x100 Scorch to trigger an Ignition.
The 2nd Scorch tick has a 0.93s delay for some reason.

Scorch Stack Damage Scaling per Tick:
2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.
 x1 = 3 | x30 = 5 | x50 = 6.5 | x60 = 7.21 | x80 = 8.64 | Scorch Damage is non-lethal.
Deals 2.5% increased damage upon reaching at least x60 Scorch, indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.

Scorch Decay:
Scorch duration and decay rate is difficulty-dependent. 
 Scorch lasts for 2.3 seconds, then decreases by x1 stacks every 0.04 seconds (-25/s)

glossary.name: Solar Effect Damage Scaling
glossary.description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Inflicting a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected, on top of Combatant Rank Scalars.

Inflicting Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs and 100+ Melee Stat do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

fragments.name: Ashes
fragments.description:
Scorch Stacks inflicted are increased by 50%, rounded up. Eg: x3 -> x5 | x40 -> x60.
Every source of Scorch will have its base number alongside Ember of Ashes' benefit in smaller text next to the regular stack amount. Eg: x40+20.

Certain sources of Scorch do not follow the 50% increase, such as Caliban's Hand (x60+0), Tommy's Matchbook (x15+5), Skyburner's Oath (x5+5), among others.

 Empowering Rifts | Crest of Alpha Lupi's Healing Pulse | Mothkeeper's Overshield Moth | Non-Solar Support Frame Auto Rifles | Armor Mods & Perks | 4 Piece Healing Initiative

 +20 Airborne Effectiveness and Solar Weapon Kills spawn a Firesprite while active.

grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Sends forth a Solar Wave on impact, repeating every 1.45 seconds up to 3 times. 

Solar Waves travel up to 20 meters away, each dealing up to 246+206 [80 + 50] damage and inflicting x10+10 Scorch.

Deals up to 1,808 [360] damage and inflicts x40+40 Scorch if all 4 Solar Waves hit without falloff.

grenades.name: Tripmine Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted | Sticky

Attaches to surfaces, projecting a laser every ? seconds. Sticking to a non-surface immediately triggers the Tripmine.

Triggers after an enemy is within its scanning cone, or after being attached for 10 seconds.
Scanning Cone extends up to 10 meters away, with a radius of 7 meters.

Explodes after 1 second of triggering, or upon being destroyed, dealing up to 805 [140] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch over ? meters on detonation.

melees.name: Knife Trick
melees.description:
Throws a fan of 3 Solar Knives.

Each knife deals 257 [38] damage with a 1.3x Precision Multiplier and inflict x20+10 Scorch per hit.
Can deal up to 1,002 [147] damage and x60+30 Scorch by scoring all 3 knives as Precision Hits.

melees.name: Lightweight Knife
melees.description:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Quickly throws a Lightweight Knife that travels at a speed of 40m/s.

Precision Hits grant Radiant for 10 seconds.

Lightweight Knife deals 408 [100] damage with a 1.5x Precision Multiplier.

melees.name: Proximity Explosive Knife
melees.description:
Quickly throws an Explosive Knife that is able to stick to surfaces for up to 14 seconds.

Proximity Knife explodes upon detecting an enemy within 5 meters of it, or upon directly sticking to an enemy.

Explody Knife deals 306 [20] impact damage with a 1.3x Precision Multiplier, and up to 405 [100] detonation damage over 6 meters.

melees.name: Weighted Throwing Knife
melees.description:
Weighted Knife that requires a 0.65 second wind-up before throwing. Animation takes 1.55 seconds to complete.

Scoring a Precision Kill grant a Class Ability Charge.
Scoring a hit against a Scorched enemy causes an ignition.

Weighted Knife deals 571 [140] damage with a 1.5x Precision Multiplier.

supers.name: Blade Barrage
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90?% [49%]

Releases two volleys of 7 homing knives each, totalling 14 knives.
Knock 'Em Down adds an additional 3 knives to each fan, totalling 20 knives.

Knives embed themselves on impact, dealing 99 [not much?] damage and detonate after 0.5 seconds.
Knife explosions deal up to an additional 560 [generally dead?] damage each and inflict x?+? Scorch over 4.25m.
Deals a total of 8,512 [death] (12160 [deathx1.43] with Knock'Em Down) damage with all knife hits+explosions

supers.name: Golden Gun: Deadshot
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 60% [0%]
Damage Resistance +Knock'Em Down: 66% [15%]
Base Duration: 12 seconds, or 8.34% Super Drain per Second

6 Shot Golden Gun
Deals 1453 [393] damage and inflicts x40+10 Scorch per shot, without the ability to score Precision Hits.
Damage Falloff begins at 26m and decreases down to 34.5% damage at 100m. ADS Zoom has no effect on damage falloff (1x ADS scalar).
 Radiant's damage bonus affects its damage output.

Super Kills grant an additional bullet to the magazine and refund Super Energy.
Initially refunds ~80% Super Energy per kill, decreasing by ~10% per kill, down to a minimum of ~12% Super Energy per kill.

supers.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 60% [0%]
Base Duration: 12 seconds, or 8.34% Super Drain per Second
Base Duration +Knock'Em Down: 16 seconds, or 6.25% Super Drain per Second.

3 Shot Golden Gun
Deals 1574 [426] damage and inflicts x40+10 Scorch per shot with a 2x Precision Multiplier.
 Radiant's damage bonus affects its damage output.

On Precision Hit: 
Grants a stack of Line'Em Up, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, and spawns 2 Orbs of Power. Buff lasts until Super End.
Line'Em Up x1 | 45.8% increased damage, and 25?% Decreased Passive Super Drain.
Line'Em Up x2 | 90% increased damage, and 50?% Decreased Passive Super Drain.

Precision Hit Orbs of Power Super Gains:
Non-Boss Combatants = 3.57% Super Energy | Boss Combatants = 2.85% Super Energy | Boss + Star-Eater Scales = 2.5% Super Energy

aspects.name: Crackshot
aspects.description:
Hovering the reticle near enemies within 27 meters applies a ◇mark until they leave Line of Sight.
Replaces Class Ability with Crackshot Dodge and overrides Class Ability Cooldown to Marksman's Dodge.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage.
Crackshot Dodge can be used midair, triggering a burst of speed.
No interaction with Celestial Nighthawk :(

On Crackshot Dodge:
Fires up to 3 Scorching Shots at an average of 150RPM over 1.2 seconds. RPM varies based on FPS, lower framerate = slower same animation duration
Scorching Shots deal 354 [21] Damage and inflict x20+10 Scorch. 
Landing all 3 Scorching Shots grants Cure x1.
Radiant grants 20% Increased Crackshot Damage against Combatants.
Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [10%] at 200 Stat. Acrobat Dodge's Radiant applies before Crackshot is fired.

aspects.name: Gunpowder Gamble
aspects.description:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive. Readies at 6 Charges.
Weapon = 1 [2] | Ignition & Scorch = 3 [4] | Abilities = 4 | Super = 6

Replaces Grenade with an Ignition-on-a-Stick that causes an ignition that deals 50% increased damage upon being shot or after 3 seconds.
Shooting the dynamite increases its damage by 50% [5%], its radius by ?% to ? meters, and releases 9 homing submunitions, with each dealing up to 80 [?] Damage.

Incurs a 6 second cooldown after activating. Kills while on cooldown don't give charges.

aspects.name: Knock 'Em Down
aspects.description:
While Radiant:
Powered Melee Ability Kills grant 100% Fixed Melee Ability after a 0.2 seconds delay.
Activating Radiant from the same hit that kills will refund Melee Ability.

Enhances Super Abilities:
Marksman Golden Gun lasts 4 seconds longer.
Deadshot Golden Gun has 15% Damage Resist.
Blade Barrage throws an additional 3 knives per fan.
Grants x1 Cure on Super Activation.

aspects.name: On Your Mark
aspects.description:
Upon scoring Precision Kills, Precision Hits, or using Class Abilities:
Grants the user and allies within 15 meters stacks of On Your Mark for 12 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Precision Kills and Hand Cannon Precision Hits grant 2 stacks. | Class Ability usage grants 1 stack.
Precision Hits grant 1 stacks [and incur a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks against Guardians.]

Class Ability Usage grants a stack of On Your Mark to the user.

On Your Mark:
Grants +5 Weapons Stat, +Reload Speed, and Reload Duration Multiplier per stack.
Maxes out at +50 Weapons Stat, +? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier.

While at x10 On Your Mark:
Kills while On Your Mark is equipped grant Restoration x1 for 3+1.5 seconds.

melees.name: Hammer Strike
melees.description:
Shared with other Shoulder Charge Abilities:
Requires sprinting for 1.25 seconds. Drains 15% Melee Ability Energy if no enemy is hit. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.
Guardians directly hit by Shoulder Charge have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds
Lunges forward 6.8 meters, automatically targeting enemies in range.

Hitting an enemy deals 878 [90] impact damage and inflicts x40+20 Scorch, as well as dealing 586 [60] radial damage to enemies up to 7 meters behind the struck target.

Scoring a Hammer Strike kill on the directly struck enemy triggers an ignition.

melees.name: Throwing Hammer
melees.description:
Quickly throws a Solar Hammer that deals 539 [90] damage.
Deals increased damage based on the distance traveled, up to 36% increased damage at 35+ meters. Multiplicative to everything.
<2m = Base | 2-4m = 6% | 5-8m = 12% | 9m-16m = 18% | 17-25m = 24% | 26-34m = 30% | 35+m = 36% increased Throwing Hammer Damage. 

Hammer is able to be picked up again from the ground, granting 121.5% Melee Ability Energy. 
Picking up the hammer after scoring a hit grants Cure x1.

Automatically explodes after being in the ground for 10 seconds, dealing up to 325 [60] damage. Explosion counts as Melee Damage.

supers.name: Burning Maul
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second
Sol Invictus creates a Sunspot on cast if grounded, and reduces Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 42 seconds, or 2.4% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack | Drains 4% Super Energy.
Spinning attack that deals 111 [?] damage 4 times. Has a 0.67 second delay between light attacks.
Continously scoring hits grants 40% Increased Attack Speed until no longer scoring hits.
Scoring 10 hits with Light Attacks spawns a Cyclone. Can only spawn 1 Cyclone per Super Activation.

Heavy Attack | Drains 8% Super Energy
Slams down, releasing a homing projectile which explodes on impact, dealing 276 [?] damage and creating a Cyclone.
Cyclones deal 24 [16] damage every 0.2 seconds, and apply x3+2 Scorch every 0.56 seconds for 4 seconds.

supers.name: Hammer of Sol
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 21 seconds, or 4.75% Super Drain per Second

Light Attack | Drains 12% Super Energy
Throws a Hammer that explodes on impact, dealing up to 445 [?] damage. Has a 1.5 seconds delay between Hammer Throws.
Impacts release 4 shrapnel, dealing up to 396 [?] damage each.

Hammers visually flares up after being airborne for 0.7 seconds, increasing Shrapnel amount to 5.

Phoenix Cradle Interaction:
Reduces Passive Drain by 20%, increasing duration to 26.25 seconds, or 3.81% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 7.5% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.

Loreley Splendor Helm Interaction:
Reduces Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 35 seconds, or 3.63% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 8.2% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.

Both Exotic Interactions assume 100% Sol Invictus buff uptime, which is not always possible.

supers.name: Hammer of Sol (Sol Invictus Aspect)
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 16.5 seconds, or 6.06% Super Drain per Second
Creates a Sunspot on cast if grounded.

Light Attack | Drains 9% Super Energy
Throws a Hammer that deals 483 [?] damage and creates a Sunspot on impact. Has a 1.5 seconds delay between Hammer Throws.
Impacts release 3 shrapnel, dealing up to 429 [?] damage each.

Sol Invictus Sunspot Buff Effects:
Decreases Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 27.5 seconds, or 3.63% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 5.5% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.

aspects.name: Consecration
aspects.description:
While sliding:
[Melee Ability] launches a wave of Solar Energy 20 meters forward, dealing 40 [30] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. 
Only consumes 50% Melee Ability Energy if the slam is not activated. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

While airborne from the Consecration Melee Ability:
[Melee Ability] slams the ground, creating a second, wider wave that travels 20 meters forward, shatters crystals, and deals 486 [120] damage to Non-Scorched Enemies.
Hits against Scorched Enemies with the second wave deal 472.5 [50] damage and trigger an ignition.

Grants 25% Damage Resist against Non-Melee Damage while in the Melee Animation.

aspects.name: Roaring Flames
aspects.description:
Solar Ability Kills and Ignition Kills grant a stack of Roaring Flames for 20 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Additional Solar Ability and Ignition Kills refresh the buff duration.

Roaring Flames grants increased Solar Ability Damage.
67% | 133% | 200% Increased Melee Damage.
20% [13%] | 44% [28%] | 73% [44%] increased Grenade and Super Ability Damage.

Unpowered Melee Hits while Roaring Flames is active inflict x30+10 Scorch and count as Powered Melee Hits.

aspects.name: Shieldburst
aspects.description:
On Barricade Placement | Overrides the Class Ability to Remote Detonator.
Remote Detonator causes the barricade to detonate, triggering an explosion that heavily knocks back and deals damage.
Explosion counts as destroying a Construct for the purpose of certain effects. 
Performing a Barricade Boost by getting hit by one's own explosion allows usage of Hammer Strike until landing, even after firing midair.
Remote Detonator Usage counts as a Class Ability Usage for most effects but will not grant Overshield at >100 Class stat.

On Towering Barricade Placement: 
Initially placing the Barricade causes it to slide forward up to 20 meters away, deaccelerating as it moves.
Barricade Contact Damage is increased to 328 [?] Damage and inflicts x20+10 Scorch. 
Contact Damage can only trigger once every 2 seconds on the same enemy.

While behind a Rally Barricade:
Grants Scorching Rounds to Kinetic and Solar Weapons.
For the sake of vertical screen accessibility, go to Song of Flame's section.

While a Barricade is active:
Passively grants Barricade-dependent (34% Towering | 10% Rally) Shieldbrust progress.
Dealing damage grants additional progress, at a rate of ~100 damage per 1 second charged.

Shieldburst Detonation:
Explosion deals up to 550 [?] Damage and inflicts x50+25 Scorch over ? meters. Self Damage is reduced to ? Damage.
Solar Shrapnel is flung towards enemies within 40? meters, dealing 71 [?] Damage and inflicting x5+5 Scorch.

Shieldburst grants increased explosion damage, up to 50% increased damage once fully charged.
While at 100% Shieldburst Progress | Explosion additionally releases 3 Solar Waves spread out in a cone up to 15 meters away.
Solar Waves deal 141 [?] Solar Damage. 

Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

aspects.name: Sol Invictus
aspects.description:
Solar Ability Kills, Scorched Enemy Kills, and Hammer of Sol Impacts create a Sunspot for ? seconds.
Standing in a Sunspot refreshes its duration, up to a maximum duration of 12 seconds.

Sunspots grant Sol Invictus for 5 seconds and Restoration x1 for 5+2.5 seconds.
Sol Invictus grant 100% Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate, and 40% Decreased Passive Super Drain.
Sunspots deal 60 [22] damage and inflict x5+3 Scorch every 0.167 seconds.

melees.name: Celestial Fire
melees.description:
Sends out a spiral of 3 homing Solar blasts.

Solar blasts each deal up to 150 [35] damage and inflict x10+5 Scorch in a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [105] damage and inflict x30+15 Scorch by scoring hits with all 3 Solar blasts.

melees.name: Incinerator Snap
melees.description:
Creates a fan of 5 burning sparks.

Sparks explode after ? meters, each dealing up to 90 [27?] damage and apply x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch over a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [135?] damage and apply up to x100+50 [x50+25] Scorch by scoring hits with all 5 burning sparks

supers.name: Song of Flame
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [~50?%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second.

Song of Flame:
Caster is granted +100 Grenade, +100 Melee, +100 Class, Radiant and Scorching Rounds. 
Weapon Kills by the Caster count as Super Kills. Weapon damage does not count as Ability damage.
Allies within 15 metres are granted 30% [?%] Damage Resist, Scorching Rounds, and 15% Fixed Bonus Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per second.
Grants full Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Scorching Rounds:
Scoring a Non-DoT Kinetic or Solar Direct/Explosive Weapon Hit inflicts Scorch, with the stack amount and cooldown between Scorching Round triggers varying per Weapon Type.
x5+0 Scorch every 0.2 seconds = Auto Rifles | Submachine Guns
x5+5 Scorch every 0.2 seconds = Machine Guns | Trace Rifles
x10+5 Scorch every 0.3 seconds = Hand Cannon | Pulse Rifle | Scout Rifles | Sidearms
x15+5 Scorch every 0.4 seconds = Fusion Rifles | Glaive (Melee/Projectile) | Shotgun | Sniper Rifle | Swords
x20+10 Scorch every 0.6? seconds = Bows | Heavy Grenade Launchers | Special Grenade Launchers | Linear Fusion Rifles (+Arbalest) | Rocket Launchers
Hitting multiple enemies at once only scorches one of them.

Grenade Ability: Drains 4.8% Super Energy, and has a 2 second cooldown between usages.
Sends forth a homing Solar Wisp that detonates on impact, dealing up to 647 [?] Damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. Wisps have ? HP.
Another Wisp is spawned on the impact location if an enemy is within 22 meters, seeking the closest enemy it hasn't already damaged.
Each Grenade Ability Usage can spawn a total of 4 Wisps, with each wisp after the first dealing 10% less damage.
Consuming a Solar Wisp while Heat Rises is equipped grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Melee Ability: Drains 2.4% Super Energy, and has a 1.75 second cooldown between usages.
Celestial Fire sends out 5 Solar blasts, each dealing up to 246 [87] Damage and inflicting x10+5 Scorch.
[Auto Melee] within Melee Lunge Distance instead deals 1,224 [?] Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over a tiny radius, consuming Super Energy and a Melee Ability Charge.

Incinerator Snap releases a barrage of 7 Solar Sparks, each dealing up to 139 [41] damage and inflicting x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch.
[Auto Melee] within Melee Lunge Distance performs an Powered Melee, dealing 899 [456] Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over a tiny radius, consuming Super Energy and a Melee Ability Charge.

Class Ability: Drains 6% Super Energy, and has a 2.85 second cooldown between usages.
Functions as the selected Class Ability, recharging quickly at the cost of Super Energy.

supers.name: Daybreak
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 24 seconds, or 4.167% Super Drain per Second.

Light Attack | Drains 6.5% Super Energy to launch a Daybreak Projectile.
Daybreak Projectile deal 426 [?] Impact Damage, exploding on impact, dealing up to 598 [?] Splash Damage, down to 0% damage, inflicting x50+0 Scorch over 5 meters, and launching a streak of flames behind them.
Flame streaks travel ahead, scaling from ~4m to 9m if the Daybreak Projectile traveled at least 12 meters, dealing up to 292 [?] Damage on hit.

Allows the usage of an enhanced Icarus Dash without cooldown that drains 4.2% Super Energy per usage.

Phoenix Dive is enhanced, dealing up to 642 [220?] Damage, down to a minimum of 292 [?] Damage, and inflicting x60+30 Scorch over a 6 meter radius. Deals 45% damage at max falloff.
Phoenix Dive damage is enhanced by Super Damage Increases.

supers.name: Well of Radiance
supers.description:
Places down a Well of Radiance for 30 seconds, restoring 300HP to the caster, dealing up to 150 damage, and inflicting 40+20 Scorch to enemies within 8.5 metres.
Creates 3 Orbs of Power, each granting 3.6% Super Energy.
Super Duration scales with Super Stat, up to 40 seconds at 200 Super.

Well of Radiance:
Construct with 800 HP. Can be frozen and damaged by Stasis Shatter
Projects an aura that buffs the caster and allies within 6 metres. Leaving the aura grants Radiant for 8+4 seconds.
Combatants deal 0.25x Damage against the Well of Radiance.

For Guardians inside the Well of Radiance:
25% Increased Weapon Damage, 20% Damage Resist against Combatants (10% vs Boss Combatants), immunity to Stasis Effects, and restores 50HP/s.
Guardians receive 50% Damage Resist against Special and Power Weapons, as well as Abilities. Primary Weapons remain at 40% Damage Resist.
Removes any active Restoration effect. 
Weapon Damage dealt by the Caster is counted as Super Ability Damage. Caster can spawn up to 5 Orbs from scoring kills within the Well.

aspects.name: Heat Rises
aspects.description:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness, and allows Weapon and Ability Usage while gliding. 

Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy.
Tier 1 Combatant = 20% | T2 = 25% | T3 = 35% | T4 = 50% | Guardians = 50%

Hold [Grenade] to consume a Grenade Ability Charge, granting Heat Rises and releasing a burst of Cure x2 that affects the user and their allies within 9 meters.
Consuming a Healing Grenade increases Cure to x3. Consuming a Touch of Flame Healing Grenade additionally grants Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame' Wisp releases a burst of Cure x3 and grants Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Heat Rises
Grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness, and a modified Glide that changes depending on the selected Movement Ability for 15 seconds.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer while active.
Modified Glide has -99% Glide Upkeep and Activation cost, extending maximum glide duration by 100 times, and marks the user's location on radar to Guardians within 25 meters.
Balanced Glide: Strong Directional and Initial Burst | Burst Glide: Strong Directional Control | Strafe Glide: Strong Initial Burst.

Scoring additional Airborne Kills while Heat Rises is active extends the buff duration, up to 30 seconds.
Tier 1 Combatant = +5 seconds | T2 & T3 = +10 seconds | T4 = +15 seconds | Guardians = +5 seconds
Consuming a Grenade always overwrites the duration to 15 seconds, even if it was previously higher.

aspects.name: Hellion
aspects.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Hellion for 20 seconds.

Hellion:
Lobs scorching Solar projectiles every 1.35 seconds towards enemies up to 32 meters away.
Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30+10 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions. Hellion-inflicted Solar Effects are not scaled by Grenade Damage.

aspects.name: Icarus Dash
aspects.description:
Horizontal dash that travels 8 meters. Distance is increased by 25% while in Daybreak.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown after usage.

While Heat Rises is active, or during the Song of Flame Super Ability while the Incinerator Snap Melee Ability is equipped:
 Gains an additional charge, and recharges both charges simultaneously, but increases cooldown to 5 seconds.
Does not grant 2 charges while in Song of Flame if the Celestial Fire Melee Ability is equipped.  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon or Super Kills while Airborne within 5 seconds of each:
 Rank-And-File = 34% | Elites = 67% | Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 67%.
Grants Cure x1.

aspects.name: Touch of Flame
aspects.description:
Enhances certain Grenade types:

Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds.
Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies.
Solar Grenades linger for 2 seconds longer and release Magma Orbs that deal 125 [50] damage each. Magma Orbs do not have damage falloff.
Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.

glossary.name: Amplified
glossary.description:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, increases Slide Distance to 8.5 meters, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximizes Movement Speed, increased Slide Distance to 11 meters, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.

glossary.name: Bolt Charge
glossary.description:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Weapon Damage Instances within 5 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active:
The next damage instance from any source will grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Can only gain up to 1 stack per simultaneous damage instance.

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 1
Swords and GLs: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1

Gaining a Bolt Charge stack grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, generally granting 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage, only as Generic Arc Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

glossary.name: Ionic Trace
glossary.description:
Arc Elemental Pickup.

Energizing Seekers that home in towards the user at a speed of 6m/s.
Grants 11.25% Grenade, and Melee Ability Energy, and 13.5% Class Ability Energy on pickup. Allies do not receive Ionic Traces created by the user.

glossary.name: Blind
glossary.description:
Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

Blinded Guardians have their HUD removed, screen whitened, and audio distorted for 3 seconds.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon being Blinded.

glossary.name: Jolted
glossary.description:
Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds, dealing 119 [51] Arc Damage to all enemies within 12 meters upon taking 115 [45] damage. 
Duration can be refreshed by reinflicting Jolt.
 The damage from the hit that applies Jolt counts towards the damage threshold. Jolt has a 0.8 second cooldown between chain lightning activations.

Guardians that release Chain Lightning do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other Guardians.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving Jolt damage.

fragments.name: Amplitude
fragments.description:
While Amplified:
Scoring 2 kills within 4 seconds of each creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Triggering Amplified through an Arc Kill will count the kill towards the 2-kill counter.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power. Kills during the cooldown do not count.

fragments.name: Beacons
fragments.description: Special and Heavy Ammo Arc Weapon Kills while Amplified create a blinding blast, inflicting Blind to enemies within 7.5 metres.

fragments.name: Brilliance
fragments.description: Precision Kills against Blinded Enemies trigger a Blinding blast, inflicting Blind to enemies within 7.5 metres.

fragments.name: Discharge
fragments.description:
Arc Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns an Ionic Trace upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 67%

Picking up Ionic Traces grants x1 Bolt Charge.

fragments.name: Feedback
fragments.description:
Upon being physically struck by a Melee Attack:
100% [50% | 15% while Knockout is active] Increased Melee Damage for the next Melee Hit within 5 seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.

fragments.name: Focus
fragments.description:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting, while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5m/s:
150% [75%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Deactivates once Class Ability has at least 1 charge readied.

fragments.name: Frequency
fragments.description:
Upon scoring a Melee Hit:
+15 Stability, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.

While Amplified:
(almost) All sources of Bolt Charge now grant an additional stack.
In-game tooltip mentions increasing the fragment's effects, which is not true, at least for the Reload Speed bonuses.

fragments.name: Haste
fragments.description:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting, while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5m/s:
 Grants +50 Health Stat.

fragments.name: Instinct
fragments.description:
While at Critical Health:
Being damaged releases a burst of Arc Energy, dealing up to 46 [20] damage and inflicting Jolt to enemies within ? metres.
Incurs a 15? second cooldown between activations.

fragments.name: Ions
fragments.description:
Killing Jolted Enemies, or scoring a Bolt Charge Kill creates an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between Ionic Traces spawns.

fragments.name: Magnitude
fragments.description:
Lightning Grenade fire an additional lightning bolt, increasing to a maximum of 5 bolts.
 Pulse Grenade release an additional 2 pulses, increasing to a maximum of 8 pulses.
 Storm Grenade release an additional barrage. Enhanced Storm's Roaming Storm lasts 1.5 seconds longer.

fragments.name: Momentum
fragments.description:
Upon sliding over Ammo Bricks while not on Full Ammo of the respective type:
Refills the equipped weapon and grants x3 Bolt Charge.

fragments.name: Recharge
fragments.description:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
400% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate.
Buff lasts until Shields are fully restored.

fragments.name: Resistance
fragments.description:
While within 15 metres of at least 3 enemies:
25% [10%] Damage Resist.
Lingers for 2 seconds.

fragments.name: Shock
fragments.description:
Arc Grenades inflict Jolt on hit.

Arc Soul and Ionic Sentries have a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict Jolt again.

fragments.name: Volts
fragments.description: Finishers grant Amplified and x1 Bolt Charge.

grenades.name: Arcbolt Grenade
grenades.description:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans and targets the closest enemy in Line of Sight within 12 meters upon impact, releasing Arc Lightning towards them after 1 second.
After dealing damage, it chains to the closest enemy within 10 meters that hasn't been hit by Arc Lightning, repeating until it has damaged a maximum of 4 enemies.

Arc Lightning deals 521 [85] damage.

grenades.name: Flashbang Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.

Explosion deals up to 684 [120] damage, down to 0% damage over a 7.5 meter radius, and inflicts blind to enemies within 10 meters for up to 5 [3] seconds.
The user is immune to self-blind.

grenades.name: Touch of Thunder
grenades.description: Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage over 7.5 meters and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.

grenades.name: Flux Grenade
grenades.description:
Almost Straight Trajectory | Slight Projectile Tracking | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after 1.7 seconds.

Explosion deals up to 901 [150] damage, down to 0% damage over a 6 meter radius on detonation.
Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to 1,500 [250] damage.

grenades.name: Lightning Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted

Attaches to surfaces and enemies, projecting a laser for 1 second before triggering.

Emits a Lightning Bolt every 1.67 seconds, up to a maximum of 4+1 times.
Lightning Bolts deal 373 [120] damage, up to a total of 1492 [1865] [480 [600]] damage.

grenades.name: Touch of Thunder
grenades.description:
Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.
Lightning Bolts after the first inflict Jolt on hit.
Grants x5 Bolt Charge upon dealing damage, up to once per lightning bolt.

grenades.name: Pulse Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 156 [50] damage in a 6 meter radius.

Periodically pulses every 0.7 seconds, dealing up to 249 [80] damage in a 6 meter radius an additional 5+2 times.
Can deal up to a total of 1,245 [1,743] [530 [690]] damage.

grenades.name: Touch of Thunder
grenades.description:
Pulse Grenade hits spawn an Ionic Trace and deal increased damage. Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

Pulse Damage Increases: 1st = 2% | 2nd = 9% | 3rd = 18.5% | 4th = 24% | 5th onwards = 25%

grenades.name: Skip Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 metres of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

Each projectile deals 24 [4] impact damage twice, then explodes for up to 90 [15] damage.
Deals up to 552 [92] damage with all 4 seekers.

grenades.name: Storm Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Calls down a focused strike on impact which hits after 0.85 seconds, dealing up to 440 [70] damage in a 7 meter radius.

After 0.6 seconds of the initial strike:
Calls down a barrage of bolts in a X pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Spark of Magnitude: Calls down a second barrage of bolts in an + pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Combatants can only be damaged once per barrage, up to a maximum of 751 [1062] damage.
Guardians can only be hurt once by the barrage of bolts, regardless of pattern, for a maximum of 120 damage.

grenades.name: Touch of Thunder
grenades.description:
Creates a roaming storm for 4+1.5 seconds after detonating, chasing after enemies at an initial speed of 2 [1.5] m/s, increasing to 4 [3] m/s after 1.3 seconds.
 Roaming Storm fires lightning bolts underneath it that deal 158 [30] damage up to 11+4 times.

melees.name: Combination Blow
melees.description:
Upon scoring a Melee Kill:
Grants 100% Class Ability, restores 100 Health, and grants a stack of Combination Blow for 20 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
Basic Melee Attacks count as Arc-Infused Melee Damage while Combination Blow is active.
70 Class Stat is required for a full Gambler's Dodge refund.

Combination Blow x1 | 133% [23%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 80 HP.
Combination Blow x2 | 266% [51.3%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 60 HP.
Combination Blow x3 | 400% [86%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 40 HP.

melees.name: Disorienting Blow
melees.description:
Deals 162 [?] Impact Damage and up to 976 [?] Splash Damage, down to ?% damage over 7 meters.
Inflicts Blind for 8.5 seconds to enemies within 9.6 meters on hit.

Grants Amplified and x2 Bolt Charge on hit.

supers.name: Arc Staff
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Base Duration: 20 seconds, or 5% Super Drain per Second

Kills grant x1 Bolt Charge.

Aerial and Grounded Light Attack | Drains 2.5% Super Energy.
Hits deal 864 [?] damag up to 8 meters away.
Grounded Attacks can be chained up to 3 hits.

Grounded Heavy Attack | Drains 8% Super Energy
Deals 1,264 [?] damage in a ~45° angle up to 8 meters away.

Airborne Heavy Attack | Drains 8%? Super Energy
Deals 1,264 [?] damage and inflicts blind over 7 meters away

Palm Strike | Light-Light-Heavy Combo.
Deals 2,950 [?] damage and inflicts blind in a ~45° angle up to 8 meters away.

Guarding | Drains an additional ?% Super Energy per second.
Fully blocks and reflects all attacks in a 180?° Angle, granting x1 Bolt Charge per attack reflected.
Reflected Projectiles are redirected to the reticle and deal 100% increased damage against Combatants.

Class Ability | Does not drain Super Energy.
Perfoms an evasive dodge. Grants ?% [?%] Damage Resist while dodging. 
 Allows the repeated usage of Ascension while the Aspect is equipped at the cost of ?% Super Energy.

supers.name: Gathering Storm
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Hurls forward an Arc Staff that explodes and embeds itself on whatever it hits on impact.
Deals 544 [300] damage and inflicts jolt on impact. Explosion deals up to 608 [?] damage in a 10 meter radius.

After 2 seconds, the Arc Staff gets struck by a lightning strike, dealing up to 1350 [500] damage in a 10 meter radius.

After 1.2 seconds of being struck by lightning, the Staff emits a damaging field, dealing 446 [60] damage every 0.7 seconds in a 10 meter radius for 8 seconds.

supers.name: Storm's Edge
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [45%]
Base Duration: ? seconds, or ?% Super Drain per Second.

Throws out a homing knife, dealing 90 [?] impact damage and up to 171 [45?] radial damage to enemies within 3 meters on impact, teleporting to it afterwards.
Performs a wide whirling strike after teleporting, dealing 1,440 x 2 [300?] damage to enemies within 6 metres.
Consumes ?% Super Energy per knife thrown, up to 3 times per Super activation.

aspects.name: Ascension
aspects.description:
While Airborne and having a Class Ability Charge:
[Air Move] consumes a Class Ability Charge to perform an upwards Arc Staff Twirl.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage. 

Grants Amplified to the user and allies within 10 meters.
Deals up to 181 [?] damage, as well as Jolting enemies within 10 metres.
Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

aspects.name: Flow State
aspects.description:
Scoring a Jolted Enemy Kill grants Amplified. 

While Amplified:
200% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier.
66% [32%] Damage Resist during Dodge Animation.

aspects.name: Lethal Current
aspects.description:
Direct Melee Hits on Jolted Enemies inflict Blind.

On Class Ability Usage:
Melee Lunge Distance is increased to 7 metres. 
The next Melee/Tempest Strike Hit within 10 seconds inflicts Jolt and triggers a damaging aftershock, dealing 195 [?] damage to enemies within 6 metres.

aspects.name: Tempest Strike
aspects.description:
Scoring a Jolted Enemy Kill grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Does not stack alongside Dielectric's x1 Bolt Charge.

While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] performs an uppercut, launching an Arc Wave along the ground up to 22 metres away, dealing 739 [125] damage and inflicting Jolt.
Grants 75% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds after usage. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.
Can trigger Combination Blow effects, and benefits from its damage increase. Does not interact with Disorienting Blow.

melees.name: Ballistic Slam
melees.description:
While Airborne, after sprinting for 0.03 seconds:
Quickly descends and strikes the ground, dealing a minimum of 210 [65] damage with no falloff to enemies within 8 metres.
Grants 3% Super Energy and x3 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.
Damage scales with time spent falling. A maximum jump height diagonal slam deals ~1,000 damage
Cannot perform a Melee Attack within 0.9 seconds of landing.

melees.name: Seismic Strike
melees.description:
Shared with other Shoulder Charge Abilities:
Requires sprinting for 1.25 seconds. Drains 15% Melee Ability Energy if no enemy is hit. Unable to use during slide if user shoots. 
Guardians directly hit by Shoulder Charge have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds
Lunges forward 6.8 meters, automatically targeting enemies in range.

Hitting an enemy deals 1,073 [110] impact damage, as well as dealing 391 [40] radial damage and inflicting Blind for 8 [1.6] seconds to enemies within 6 meters.

While Amplified:
 Blind Radius is increased to 10 metres, and the Blind Duration is increased to 10 [3] seconds.

melees.name: Thunderclap
melees.description:
Chargeable Melee Attack
Deals 703 [120] damage in a 7.5 metre wide cone up to 16 metres away, gradually dealing up to 100% increased damage after charging for 2 seconds.
Grants 80% Damage Resist against Combatants during the animation, and for ? seconds after usage.

supers.name: Fists of Havoc
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second

Light Attack | Drains 6% Super Energy.
Hits deal 499 [?] damage and heavily knock enemies back.
Scoring a Light Attack grants the next heavy attack hit 4 additional damage instances of 273 [?] damage each.

Heavy Attack | Drains 12% Super Energy.
Slams downwards, dealing 1619 [?] damage and inflicting blind in a 11 metre radius. Super Cast also slams, without the aftershocks
Slam deals 4 additional damage instances of 273 [?] damage each if the user is in the animation for at least 1 second. Requires inputting a directional key.
Creates up to 4 aftershocks, each dealing up to 292 [?] damage.

supers.name: Thundercrash
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [25%]
Base Duration: Up to 4.5 seconds, or 22.2% Super Drain per Second

Enemies that are very close when flying receive 150 [?] Collision Damage.

Detonates on impact with a surface or enemy, dealing 180 [?] impact damage, as well as up to 8,260 [?] explosive damage over 10 meters.
Explosion releases aftershocks 0.75 seconds after impact, dealing up to 108 [?] damage every second for 4 seconds.

aspects.name: Juggernaut
aspects.description:
While sprinting, while Movement Speed is above ~4m/s and with full Class Ability Energy:
Grants a Frontal Overshield with 50 HP that absorbs damage, granting x1 Bolt Charge per attack blocked.
Overshield receives 33% Damage Resist while Amplified, increasing its effective health to 75eHP.
60% [10%] Splash Damage Resist, and 10% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.

Overshield is able to fully absorb the last hit before being destroyed, depleting all Class Ability Energy.

Stacks with other Overshields.

aspects.name: Knockout
aspects.description:
On Melee Kill:
Quickly restores a varying amount of Health over 0.1 seconds, begins Health Regeneration and grants Amplified.
Rank-and-File = 50 HP | Elite = 75 HP | Miniboss+ = 100 HP | Guardian = 30 HP 

Upon breaking an Enemy Shield, or dealing damage to an enemy below 30% HP:
Grants Knockout for 6 seconds.

Knockout:
160% [30%] increased Basic/Glaive Melee Damage
160% [20%] increased Charged Melee Damage
Basic Melee Attacks count as Arc Powered Melee Hits.
Increases Melee Lunge Distance against Combatants to 6 metres

aspects.name: Storm's Keep
aspects.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants x4 Bolt Charge. 
Thruster grants x6 Bolt Charge.

While behind the Barricade:
Grants a stack of Bolt Charge every 0.6 seconds. 
Bolt Charge can now trigger with Weapon Damage.
Spark of Frequency does not increase the number of Bolt Charge stacks gained. Does not stack with multiple barricades.

aspects.name: Touch of Thunder
aspects.description:
Enhances certain Grenade types:

Flashbang: Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage, down to 0% damage over 7.5 meters, and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.

Lightning: Grants an additional Grenade Charge, lightning strikes after the first inflict jolt, and hits grant x5 Bolt Charge up to once per lightning bolt.

Pulse: Damaging an enemy creates an Ionic Trace with a 1 second cooldown. Deals up to 25% increased damage as it lingers.
1st = 2% | 2nd = 9% | 3rd = 18.5% | 4th = 24% | 5th onwards = 25%

Storm: Creates a roaming storm for 4.5+1.5 seconds after detonating, chasing after enemies at an initial speed of 2 [1.5] m/s, increasing to 5.5 [3] m/s after 1.6 seconds.
 Roaming Storm fires lightning bolts underneath it that deal 164 [30] damage up to 11+4 times.

melees.name: Ball Lightning
melees.description:
Fires a Ball Lightning forward up to 35 meters away, releasing a lightning strike if an enemy is up to 4? meters under it, after reaching its maximum distance, or on impact.

Lightning strike deals 271 [70] damage over 2? meters.
Directly impacting an enemy will deal an additional 117 [30] damage.

While Amplified:
Creates 2 additional lightning strikes, each dealing 163 [?] damage.
Deals up to 714 [240] damage upon scoring a direct hit alongside all 3 lightning strikes.

melees.name: Chain Lightning
melees.description:
Melee Attack with an extended lunge distance of 6 meters.
Arc Subclass Exclusive: Has 2 Ability Charges.

Directly strikes an enemy, dealing 390 [100] damage, inflicting Jolt, and causing them to release chain lightning.
Chain lightning deals 265 [54] damage to enemies within 9 metres, chaining towards enemies up to a maximum of 5 times. Cannot chain to the most recently targeted enemy.

While Amplified:
Releases two sets of chain lightning, each targeting a different enemy, doubling the maximum amount of enemies hit. Enemies can still only be hit once by chain lightning.

supers.name: Chaos Reach
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [55%]
Base Duration: 4 seconds, or 25% Super Drain per Second
Movement Speed: 4.5 meters per second.

Channels a long range beam towards the reticle, dealing 378 [?] damage every 0.13 seconds. Does not deal damage for the first 0.67 seconds of the animation.
Scoring 7 hits on an enemy summons a jolting lightning strike on the enemy's location, dealing 202 [?] damage.

Partially refunds Super Energy on early deactivation, up to a maximum of 30% Super Energy if immediately cancelled.

supers.name: Stormtrance
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 16 seconds, or 6.25% Super Drain per Second.

On Super Cast:
Deals up to 690 [?] damage in a 6 meter radius, knocking enemies back, and releases 5 Lightning Seekers around the caster.
Lightning Seekers deal 440 [150] damage and inflict jolt for 16 seconds.

Light Attack | Drains ?% Super Energy.
Targets enemies within 12 meters, releasing chain lighting that deals 178 [90] damage every 0.34 seconds.
Damage ramps up over time, increasing by 5% every 0.33 seconds, up to 65% increased damage after 3.33 seconds.
 Damage Increase decays after 2 seconds of not dealing damage.

Heavy Attack | Sprint
Performs an Ionic Blink, consuming 6.25% Super Energy and teleporting up to 7 meters away towards the currently input movement direction.

aspects.name: Arc Soul
aspects.description:
Rifts created by the user grant an Arc Soul to the user and allies that pass through it.
Duration can be refreshed by stepping back into the Rift.

Arc Buddy lasts 15 seconds and fires homing projectiles that deal 69 [11] Arc Grenade Damage in 3-round bursts at a rate of 100RPM towards enemies within 24 meters.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions.

Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate while within 15? metres of allies.
x1 = 40% [20%] | x2 = 80% [40%] | x3 = 120% [60%]

While Amplified:
Arc Boi shoots bursts of 5 shots, increasing its overall RPM to 225RPM.

aspects.name: Electrostatic Mind
aspects.description:
Arc Ability Kills and kills against enemies affected by Arc Elemental Debuffs create an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 1? second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

Ionic Traces grant Amplified on pickup.

aspects.name: Ionic Sentry
aspects.description:
Arc Kills and Kinetic Kills charge up an Ionic Sentry. Readies at 6 Charges.
Weapon = 1 [2] | Abilities = 2 [?]

Replaces Grenade with an Ionic Sentry.
Counts as an Arc Grenade Ability Damage, and will trigger Grenade Ability interactions.

Ionic Sentry:
Inflicts Blind for 10? [3?] seconds to enemies within 5 meters upon landing
Automatically shoots a chaining bolt of lightning every second at enemies within 16 metres, dealing 202 [50] Arc Damage. 
Chains towards an additional enemy within 6 meters of the initially struck target.
Grants x1 Bolt Charge on hit.
Lasts for 15 seconds and has ? Construct HP.
User is immune to self-blind.

Incurs a 6 second cooldown after activating. Kills while on cooldown don't give charges.

aspects.name: Lightning Surge
aspects.description:
While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] warps the user forward 10 meters, calling down 5 lightning bolts in a ⬠-shape 7 meters away from the exit point, and granting x1 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.
Grants Amplified on usage. Does not grant any Bolt Charge past x1 unless hits are scored.
Grants ?% Damage Resist against Combatants for ? seconds after usage. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

Lightning bolts deal 634 + 127 = 761 [105 + 47 = 152] damage simultaneously and inflict Jolt.

glossary.name: Stasis Shard
glossary.description:
Stasis Subclass Intrinsic:
Shattering a Stasis Crystal or Frozen Enemy, or killing an enemy affected by a Stasis Debuff (Slow, Freeze) spawns a Stasis Shard. 
Small Stasis Shard = Rank-And-File
Large Stasis Shard = Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Guardians.

Stasis Elemental Pickup:
Stasis Shards grant Melee Ability Energy on pickup. 
Shards last for 20 seconds. Allies receive a copy of all Shards created by the user.
Small Stasis Shards grant 10% Melee Energy, and Large Stasis Shards grant 50% Melee Energy.

While Glacial, Grim or Tectonic Harvest is equipped:
Small Stasis Shards restore 10 HP and grant x1 Frost Armor.
Large Stasis Shards restore 20 HP and x3 Frost Armor.

glossary.name: Stasis Crystal
glossary.description:
Solid Pillars that can be spawned on surfaces, possessing a varying amounts of health depending on their size, lasting up to 15 seconds.

Crystals, upon being created, inflict freeze [x15 Slow Stacks for 1.5+0.5 seconds] to enemies within 2.6 metres. 

Stasis Crystals can be destroyed by depleting their health, dealing up to generally 158 [25] damage over a 8 metre radius.

Small Crystals: ? HP | Medium Crystal: ? HP | Large Crystal: ? HP
User deals double damage to their own Crystals.

glossary.name: Frost Armor
glossary.description:
Grants 7% [2%] Damage Resist per stack, up to 31.25% [10%] Damage Resist at x5 stacks
Frost Armor decays 1 stack at a time every 5 seconds.
Damage Resist per stack is decreased to ?% [?%] while in Super.

Whisper of Rime:
Increases the maximum stack amount to x7, increasing the maximum Damage Resist to 50% [16%]
Increases the Frost Armor stack duration to 6 seconds.

glossary.name: Slow
glossary.description:
Slowed Enemies receive multiple penalties related to movement or weapon performance.
Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

Slowed Combatants have 50% Decreased Movement Speed and are less accurate.

Slowed Guardians have 50% Reduced Movement Speed, 50% Decreased Jump Height, are unable to use Movement Abilities, receive ?% increased Flinch, and have a penalty to their Weapon Stats.

Slowed Weapon Stat Penalties:
Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.
Stat Reduction takes place after Weapon Perks. Weapon Stats are considered uncapped before slow's reduction is applied.
Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving any amount of Slow Stacks.

glossary.name: Freeze
glossary.description:
Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.
Frozen Enemies receive 10% increased damage from Special and Power Weapons, 5% increased damage from Arc, Solar, and Void Abilities, and 5% [60%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons. 
Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants and Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage, on top of the aforementioned effects.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds. 
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

glossary.name: Shatter
glossary.description:
Frozen Enemies can be shattered through damage or directly through specific Stasis Aspects, dealing up to 361 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving shatter damage.

fragments.name: Bonds
fragments.description:
Killing Frozen Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown after creating an Orb of Power.

fragments.name: Chains
fragments.description:
Kills while Frost Armor is active progress a counter that spawns a Small Stasis Shard upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = ?%

fragments.name: Chill
fragments.description:
Stasis Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns a Small Stasis Shard upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 67%
Incurs a 5? second cooldown after creating a Stasis Shard, before additional kills progress the counter.

fragments.name: Conduction
fragments.description: Stasis Shards within 15 metres are pulled towards the user after a 1 second delay.

fragments.name: Durance
fragments.description:
Slow Debuff Duration and certain abilities last longer.
All affected Slow sources and abilities will have their value with Durance shown in smaller text next to the regular duration or stack amount.
Eg: 25 seconds -> 25+5

fragments.name: Fissures
fragments.description:
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals deals an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] metre radius. 
Falloff decreases damage dealt down to a minimum of 15 [4] damage at 10 [8] meters.

fragments.name: Fractures
fragments.description: Grants x1 Frost Armor upon shattering an enemy with Melee Damage.

fragments.name: Hedrons
fragments.description: Freezing an enemy grants +? Handling, and +30 Health for 11 seconds.

fragments.name: Hunger
fragments.description:
Stasis Shards grant 60% increased Melee Energy.
Additive to other sources such as Yearning Echo's Overflowing Coffers's 260% increase.

fragments.name: Impetus
fragments.description:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Refills all weapons and grants +40 Handling for 5 seconds.
Buff duration serves as cooldown.

fragments.name: Refraction
fragments.description:
Kills against enemies affected by Stasis effects grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank.
9% = Tier 1 Combatant
13% = Tier 2 Combatant
15% = Guardian
20% = Tier 3 Combatant
30% = Tier 4 Combatant
40% = Miniboss
50% = Boss

fragments.name: Rending
fragments.description:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 100% increased damage against Stasis Crystals and 50% increased damage against Frozen Enemies.
Includes Fighting Lion, Revision Zero, Vex Mythoclast, and their respective alternate fire modes.

fragments.name: Reversal
fragments.description:
While Frost Armor is active:
Dealing or receiving Physical Melee Damage applies x10? Slow for ?+? [?+?] seconds.
Also applies to Glaive Melee.

fragments.name: Rime
fragments.description: Enhances Frost Armor, increasing the maximum stack amount to x7 (50% [16?%] DR), and the duration to 6 seconds.

fragments.name: Shards
fragments.description:
Upon destroying a Stasis Crystal: 
Grants 500% [150%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate for 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 11 seconds.

fragments.name: Torment
fragments.description:
Upon receiving damage:
Grants 7% Grenade Ability Energy.
Increased to 12% Grenade Ability Energy while Frost Armor is active.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Grenade Energy gains.

grenades.name: Coldsnap Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | Seeker

Directly hitting an enemy inflicts x50 [x?] Slow Stacks for 4+2 seconds.
Direct Hits count as Stasis Grenade Ability Damage.

Spawns a seeker after 0.8 seconds of impacting the ground, tracking the closest enemy within 20 meters at a speed of 17m/s for 1 second.
Tracking strength gets weaker over the seeker's lifespan.

Seeker detonates upon reaching an enemy or expiring, dealing 20 [20] damage and freezing enemies within 3 [1.75] meters.

If the seeker freezes an enemy, another seeker is spawned, targeting a different enemy, chaining up to 2 times.

grenades.name: Touch of Winter
grenades.description:
Seekers duplicate upon freezing an enemy. 
Seekers now spawn a Small, Medium, and Large Stasis Crystal on detonation upon chaining 1, 2, and 3 times respectively.

grenades.name: Duskfield Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | DoT Field

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 20 [20] damage and inflicting x20 [x10] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds in a ? meter radius, as well as creating a Slowing Field.

Slowing Field:
Deals 1 damage and applies x10 [x5] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds every 0.35 [0.3] seconds for 7+2 seconds in a 4 meter radius.

grenades.name: Touch of Winter
grenades.description:
Duskfield Radius is increased by 50% to ↑6 meters.
Duskfield now creates a Small Stasis Crystal on impact.

grenades.name: Glacier Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Creates 5 Stasis Crystals in a straight line on impact, perpendicularly from where it was thrown.
Glacier Grenades' Stasis Crystals deal up to 158 [?] Stasis Grenade Damage upon being shattered, down to 66% damage over 8 meters.

grenades.name: Touch of Winter
grenades.description: Creates ↑7 Stasis Crystals in a heptagon shape on impact.

grenades.name: Shatter Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory | Sticky

Attaches to enemies, inflicting Freeze [x? Slow] on direct hits.
Explodes after ? seconds, dealing up to 325? [?] damage over ? meters and releasing 9 Tracking Stasis Shrapnel in 3 groups of 3, forming a Y shape.
Stasis Shrapnel deals 216 [?] damage and bounces up to ? times.
Sticking a Frozen Enemy causes an instantaneous explosion and increases the explosion damage by 100%.

grenades.name: Touch of Winter
grenades.description:
Creates 9 additional Shrapnel.
Hitting Frozen Enemies grants FPS-based Grenade Ability Energy.
42% at 30 FPS | 30% at 60FPS | 28% at 120+FPS

melees.name: Withering Blade
melees.description:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Quickly tosses a Stasis Shuriken towards enemies.
Shurikens are able to ricochet up to 3 times off of surfaces or towards up to 4 enemies, tracking towards enemies within 12 [8] meters.

Withering Blades deal 296 [72] damage and inflict x60 [x40] Slow for 3.5+3.5 [1.5+0.5] seconds on hit.

supers.name: Silence & Squall
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]

Silence
Deals 338 [847] impact damage and freezes enemies within 8.5 metres.

Squall
Deals 338 [847] impact damage, and creates a Stasis Storm on detonation.

Stasis Storm
Lasts 14+2 seconds, dealing 28 [14] damage and inflicting x20 Slow Stacks for 1 second every 0.1 [0.17] seconds for 6 seconds in a 5.5 meter radius.
Deals 300% increased damage against Non-Boss Frozen Enemies.

aspects.name: Grim Harvest
aspects.description:
Picking up Small Stasis Shards restores 10 HP and grants x1 Frost Armor.
Picking up Large Stasis Shards restore ? HP and grant x3 Frost Armor.

While Frost Armor is active:
Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills progress a counter that, upon reaching 100%, cause the kill to trigger a Stasis Shatter. 
Each Frost Armor stack increases the amount of progress gained per kill.
Taking damage grants ?% Class Ability Energy, up to once a second?.

Crucible-Only:
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 Shards within ? seconds of the first shard?, preventing additional Stasis Shard creation from Harvest Aspects for 10 seconds.
Shard creation count and cooldown is shared for the entire fireteam.

aspects.name: Shatterdive
aspects.description:
[Air Move] activates Shatterdive.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown between Shatterdive activations.

Shatterdive performs a dive, dealing up to 50 damage, and shattering frozen enemies and Stasis Crystals within 8.5 metres radius.
Shatterdive damage is increased to 180 against Frozen Enemies.
Shattering a Frozen Enemy deals an additional 250 Shatter Damage. Displayed in Yellow Numbers.

Shattering Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies grants maximum Frost Armor stacks.

Grants ?% Stasis Shatter Damage Resist and Fall Damage Immunity while diving.

aspects.name: Touch of Winter
aspects.description:
Enhances Stasis Grenades.

Coldsnap Grenade Seekers duplicate upon freezing an enemy. 
Seekers now spawn a Small, Medium, and Large Stasis Crystal on detonation upon chaining 1, 2, and 3 times respectively.

Duskfield Grenade create a Small Stasis Crystal on impact, and their Slowing Field has 50% Increased Radius.

Glacier Grenades form a heptagon hexagon, and creates an additional 2 Large Stasis Crystal.

Shatter Grenades release 9 additional Shrapnel and refund ~30% Grenade Ability Energy upon directly hitting a Frozen Enemy.

aspects.name: Winter's Shroud
aspects.description:
Upon inflicting Slow to an enemy:
Grants 300% [150%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds.

On Class Ability Usage:
Inflicts x60 [x40] Slow for 8+4? [1.5+0.5] seconds to enemies within 9 [8] metres.
Grants 50% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds.

melees.name: Shiver Strike
melees.description:
Leaps through the air, performing an extended lunge distance melee upon releasing [Melee Attack].
Shiver Strike shatters Stasis Crystals on contact. 
Failing to score a hit will refund 80% [40%] Melee Ability Energy.

Deals 511 [105] impact damage on hit, heavily [moderately] knocking enemies back and inflicting x50 [x40] Slow.
Hits attach a delayed Stasis Explosive that deals up to 219 [?] explosive damage and inflicting x100 [x40] Slow after 1 second to enemies, down to 20% damage over 8 meters.
Both the Impact and Explosion benefit from Melee Damage Increases. Impact damage is non-lethal.
Guardians directly hit by Shiver Strike have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.

supers.name: Glacial Quake
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [47%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second
Grants increased Jump Height and Cryoclasm has no cooldown while in Super.
On Super Cast: Freezes enemies within 8 [6] meters.
On Super End: Grants 3 Melee Ability Charges.
Scoring a kill through any means while Glacial Quake is active spawn an Orbs of Power, each granting 7.15% Ability Energy up to 7 times per Super Cast.

Frozen Enemies and Stasis Crystals are dealt 300 Stasis Super Damage every 0.15 seconds on contact, almost instantly shattering them. 

ALL STASIS DAMAGE (except for Light Attacks and Contact Damage) against Frozen Enemies is increased by 310%, count as Super Damage, and is displayed in Yellow Numbers.

Light Attack | Drains 7.45% Super Energy.
Leaps through the air forward, dealing 1,838 [210] impact damage and heavily knocking enemies back.
Hits attach a delayed Stasis Explosive that deals up to 897 [?] explosive damage, and inflicts x100? [x?] Slow after 1 second to enemies, down to 20% damage over 8 meters.
 Impact Damage is non-lethal.

Heavy Attack | Drains 7.45% Super Energy.
Slams the ground, dealing 73 [50] damage and freezes over 9 meters, as well as creating 3 waves of Stasis Crystals, each composed of a Small, Medium and a Large Crystal.
Enemies within a ~45 cone ahead of the caster are dealt up to 579 [?] Damage, down to 0% damage over 8 meters.
Glacial Quake Stasis Crystals deal up to 158 [?] Stasis Super Damage and can be scaled with 100+ Super Stat and other Super Damage Increases.

Howl of The Storm (Glacial Howl) | Drains 15% Super Energy (Up to x5 per Cast).
Behaves and deals the same base damage as the regular Aspect and is considered "Super Melee Damage".
Glacial Howl stacks Glacial Quake's 310% Frozen Enemy Damage Increase multiplicatively with Howl's intrinsic 1.5x Damage against Frozen Non-Boss Combatants.
Glacial Howl damage can be further scaled by 100+ Super Stat, Super Melee Damage Buffs (Armorsmith, Shieldcrush, No Backup Plans), and Super Damage Buffs (Synthoceps).
All those damage buffs stack multiplicatively with each other. No Backup Plans is additive to Armorsmith/Shieldcrush.

Glacial Howl against Frozen Enemies while Synthoceps' buff is active removes Titan's intrinsic 1.2x Melee Damage, only granting +25% Damage instead of the expected 50%

aspects.name: Cryoclasm
aspects.description:
Sliding into Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies shatters on contact.

Passively increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 11 meters.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown after an extended slide.

Sliding launches a Stasis wave that deals 18 [?] Damage, shatters Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies.

aspects.name: Diamond Lance
aspects.description:
Creates a Stasis Lance upon scoring 1 [3] Stasis Weapon Kills, a Stasis Ability Kill, or a Shatter Kill.

Stasis Lance is a single-use weapon that can be picked up while it is within 3 meters and can held for up to 10 seconds.
Remains for up to 25 seconds on the ground.

[Fire] throws the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 5 metres of the impact, shattering crystals on direct impact, and dealing 136 [45] damage. 
[Melee] slams the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 8 [6.75?] metres, dealing up to 180 [90] damage, and bestowing the user and their allies within ? meters x2 Frost Armor.
Diamond Lances instantly shatter Stasis Crystals upon damaging them.
Diamond Lance Damage is considered Generic Stasis Ability Damage. Not Grenade nor Melee Damage.

Incurs a 7 [17] second cooldown after spawning a Stasis Lance before another can be spawned.

aspects.name: Howl of the Storm
aspects.description:
Grants an additional Melee Ability Charge.
Howl of the Storm deals 1.5x Damage against Frozen Non-Boss Enemies.
Does not apply the 1.5x if Wormgod's Burning Fists is active.

While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] performs an uppercut, dealing 146 [?] Melee Damage, freezing [Slow x? for ? seconds] enemies within ? meters, and creating multiple Stasis Crystals.
Creates 2 Small, 4 Medium, and 2 Large Crystal in a V formation ahead of the user. Uppercut damage scales with Melee Stat and Melee Damage Buffs.
Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

Howl of the Storm's Stasis Crystals deal 158 [?] Powered Stasis Melee Damage, down to 45% damage over 8 meters.
Howl's Crystal Damage counts as Powered Stasis Melee Damage and scale normally with Melee Damage Buffs. DOES NOT SCALE WITH 100+ MELEE STAT.

Howl of the Storm during Glacial Quake is complicated and is explained thoroughly in the Glacial Quake Super section.

aspects.name: Tectonic Harvest
aspects.description:
Picking up Small Stasis Shards restores 10 HP and grants x1 Frost Armor.
Picking up Large Stasis Shards restore ? HP and grant x3 Frost Armor.

While Frost Armor is active:
Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills progress a counter that, upon reaching 100%, cause the kill to trigger a Stasis Shatter.
Each Frost Armor stack increases the amount of progress gained per kill.
Taking damage grants ?% Melee Ability Energy, up to once a second?.

Crucible-Only:
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 Shards within ? seconds of the first shard?, preventing additional Stasis Shard creation from Harvest Aspects for 10 seconds.
Shard creation count and cooldown is shared for the entire fireteam.

melees.name: Penumbral Blast
melees.description:
Sends forth a freezing projectile that automatically detonates after traveling 22 metres.

Projectile detonates on impact, dealing up 240 [30] damage and freezing enemies within 2.7 [2] metres on detonation.

supers.name: Winter's Wrath
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4.08% Super Drain per Second
Glide becomes a variant of Strafe Glide with unlimited duration.

Light Attack | Drains 4.5% Super Energy per twin-shards.
Casts two freezing homing twin-shards, one after another. Each projectile deals 11 impact damage and up to 50 [33] splash damage over ? meters to unfrozen enemies.
Frozen enemies receive 90% decreased damage.

Heavy Attack | Does not drain Super Energy.
Casts a shockwave that deals 45 [? and Non-Lethal] damage and heavily staggers enemies within 30 metres. Shockwave travels 45 meters per second.
Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies hit by the shockwave are dealt 3,453 [?] Stasis Damage.
 Combatants of all ranks are dealt an additional Shatter Damage Instance of 361 damage, totalling 3814 Damage.

aspects.name: Bleak Watcher
aspects.description:
Grenade Base Cooldown and Chunk Scalar is set to Glacier Grenade's while this Aspect is equipped.

Hold [Grenade] to convert the Grenade Ability into a Stasis Turret. 

Stasis Turret:
