Automatically shoots a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds at enemies within 35 metres, inflicting x20 [x10] Slow for 4.5+4.5 [2+1.75] seconds per hit. 
Lasts for 25+5 seconds, has 150 Construct HP, and 67% Damage Resist until it has fired.
Bleak Watcher damage counts as Stasis Grenade Ability Damage.

aspects.name: Frostpulse
aspects.description:
Grants 11% Class Ability Energy upon freezing an enemy.

On Class Ability Cast:
Freezes enemies within 8.5 [5] metres. Grants +2.5 Meters Melee Lunge Distance for 1.2 seconds.
Freezing an enemy with Frostpulse grants x5 Frost Armor.
[Guardians within 5-8 meters are inflicted with x50 Slow for ?+? seconds instead.]

aspects.name: Glacial Harvest
aspects.description:
Picking up Small Stasis Shards restores 10 HP and grants x1 Frost Armor.
Picking up Large Stasis Shards restore ? HP and grant x3 Frost Armor.

While Frost Armor is active:
Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills has a chance to cause the kill to trigger a Stasis Shatter.
Each Frost Armor stack increases the odds of it triggering.
x1 = 10?% | x2 = 15?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = 50?% | x6 = 85?% | x7 = 100%

Taking damage grants ?% Grenade Ability Energy, up to once a second?.

Crucible-Only:
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 Shards within ? seconds of the first shard?, preventing additional Stasis Shard creation from Harvest Aspects for 10 seconds.
Shard creation count and cooldown is shared for the entire fireteam.

aspects.name: Iceflare Bolts
aspects.description:
Shattering a Frozen Enemy creates a seeker, targeting the closest enemy up to 12 metres away.
Seeker detonates upon reaching an enemy or expiring, freezing enemies within 3 [1.75] meters.

Incurs an 8 second cooldown after creating 7 [1] seekers.

glossary.name: Tangle
glossary.description:
While a Strand Ability is equipped:
 Killing an enemy affected by a Strand Debuff (Sever, Suspend, Unravel) spawns a Tangle, adhering to the standard cooldown. 

Strand Elemental Pickup:
Construct with ? HP that can exist for up to 20 seconds before dissipating.
Can be picked up while within 5 meters, and can be held for up to 20 seconds.
 Incurs a 12 second cooldown upon creating a Tangle before additional ones can be created, barring exceptions.

Detonating a Tangle through damaging it or throwing it creates an explosion, dealing 346 [100] damage over a 8 metre radius.
Either method counts as an Elemental Interaction for the purposes of perks and effects.

Grappling a Tangle fully refunds Grenade Energy and pulls the user towards it.

glossary.name: Grapple Tangle
glossary.description:
Tangle Equivalent that exclusively interacts with Grapple, behaving identically to a Tangle for Grappling.

Lasts for up to 20 seconds. Duration is refreshed by 5 seconds upon using Grapple on it. Cannot be destroyed, nor picked up.
Targeting a Grapple Tangle within 27 meters (32m with Grapple Grenade equipped) for 0.3 seconds overrides Grenade Ability to a Non-Offensive Grapple.
Grapple Melee can only be performed on Grapple Tangles if a Grapple Grenade Ability Charge is readied. Works on Prismatic Hunters, too.

Grappling a Grapple Tangle 5 consecutive times reduces the duration refresh to 1 second.

glossary.name: Threadling
glossary.description:
Strand minions that chase enemies within 20? metres, leaping towards the targeted enemy upon being within ? metres.

Threadlings explode on contact or after leaping, dealing up to 366 [35] damage in a small radius.
Threadlings that lose their target before impact will land and look for another combatant instead of exploding.
Threadlings count as damage from the source they were spawned, but will lose that inheritance if they perch.

Warlock Interaction:
Threadlings return after travelling 14 metres if they do not start chasing an enemy, remaining perched on the Warlock, up to a maximum of 5 Threadlings. 
Releases a Threadling upon dealing weapon damage or scoring a Powered Melee Hit, with a 0.5 second cooldown between releases. Instantly killing an enemy won't release Threadlings.
Threadlings released this way will track at any range.

glossary.name: Woven Mail
glossary.description:
Grants 45% [25%] Damage Resist for 10 seconds. 
Precision Hits and Melee Attacks from Guardians bypass the Damage Resist.

Woven Mail is removed upon casting any Super Ability.

glossary.name: Sever
glossary.description: Decreases the enemy's outgoing damage dealt by 40% [15%] for 10+5 [5+2.5] seconds.

glossary.name: Suspend
glossary.description:
Suspended Combatants are unable to move, shoot, or use abilities.
Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants are suspended for up to 6+2 seconds. Minibosses are only suspended for up to 3+1 seconds.
Boss Combatants are unimpeded by suspension's effects, snapping out of them after 1 second, receiving instead 300 Strand Damage.
Boss Combatants still count as being afflicted by the Suspend debuff during its brief duration despite not receiving its effects.

Suspended Guardians are lifted midair, being able to slowly hover horizontally and hipfire their weapons for 2+1 seconds in a third-person perspective.

Unstoppable Champions are stunned upon being Suspended.

glossary.name: Unravel
glossary.description:
Unraveled Enemies release 3 seeking threads towards enemies within ? metres 0.25 seconds after receiving 40 damage.
Each Thread deals 26 [4] damage and applies Unravel on hit.
Unravel has a 1.2 second cooldown between thread releases. 

 Thread hits refresh the duration of Unravel, up to its original duration. 
(If the Unravel source applied a 9 second debuff, thread hits will reapply it to 9 seconds)

glossary.name: Unraveling Rounds
glossary.description: Strand Weapons inflict Unravel upon dealing damage.

fragments.name: Ascent
fragments.description:
On Grenade Ability Usage:
Refills readied weapon.
+40? Handling, +40 Reload Speed, 0.925x Reload Duration Multiplier and +30 Airborne Effectiveness for 15 seconds.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown between Ammo Refills upon activation.

fragments.name: Binding
fragments.description:
Super Kills cause the enemy to trigger a damaging Suspending Burst.
Suspending Burst deals 108 [?] Damage and inflicts Suspension to enemies within 6 meters.

fragments.name: Continuity
fragments.description:
Strand Debuffs normally last 50% longer.
Debuff sources will have their value with Continuity shown in smaller text next to the regular duration.

fragments.name: Evolution
fragments.description:
Threadling move 30?% faster, travel further, and deal increased damage.

Threadling Damage Increase:
33% against Combatants | 12.5% against Guardians

fragments.name: Finality
fragments.description:
Finishers create Threadlings, with the amount scaling with Enemy Rank.
Rank-And-File = 1 | Elite = 2 | Miniboss = 3

fragments.name: Fury
fragments.description:
Upon dealing damage with Tangles:
Grants a varying amount of Melee Energy per damage instance.
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 18% | T3 = 20% | T4 = 30% | Guardians = 25%
Incurs a 1? second cooldown between triggers.

fragments.name: Generation
fragments.description:
Upon dealing damage:
Grants a variable amount of Grenade Ability Energy.
Does not grant Slicewire Grenade Energy.

Grenade Ability Energy Gains vary depending on the source, as well as the amount of damage.
Generally, the more damage something deals, the more Ability Energy it will grant.

fragments.name: Isolation
fragments.description:
Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each:
Emits a Severing Burst, inflicting Sever to enemies within ? metres. 
Incurs a 4 second cooldown upon Severing. Precision Hits during the cooldown will not be counted.

Precision Hits work on a Counter System, triggering the Severing Burst upon reaching 100%.
Counter System is exclusively Weapon Archetype based.

Counter Progress per Precision Hit:
50% Counter: Slug Shotguns
34% Counter: Bows and Sniper Rifles
25% Counter: Hand Cannons and Scout Rifles
20% Counter: Sidearms
15% Counter: Auto Rifles
12% Counter: Machine Guns and Pulse Rifles
10% Counter: Trace Rifles and Submachine Guns

fragments.name: Mind
fragments.description:
Killing Suspended Enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank.
Incurs a 1? second cooldown upon scoring a kill.
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 12% | T3 = 15% | T4 = 30% | Guardians = 15%

fragments.name: Propagation
fragments.description:
On Powered Melee Ability Kill:
Grants Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 8 [5] seconds.

fragments.name: Rebirth
fragments.description:
Strand Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns a variable number of Threadlings upon reaching 100%.

Counter Progress (Threadling Amount):
Rank-And-File = 34% (1) | Elite = 67% (2) | Miniboss and Boss = 100% (3) | Guardians = 67% (2)

fragments.name: Transmutation
fragments.description:
While Woven Mail is active:
Weapon Kills spawn a Tangle.

fragments.name: Warding
fragments.description:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Woven Mail for 5 seconds.

fragments.name: Wisdom
fragments.description:
Killing Suspended Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown after creating an Orb of Power.

grenades.name: Grapple
grenades.description:
Hooks up to 22 metres away, dealing 38 [?] damage and staggering enemies on impact, as well as attaching to enemies or objects.
Cancelling a Grapple within 1 second of activation refunds 50% Grenade Energy.

Upon Grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle:
Fully refunds a Grapple Ability Charge and grants Grapple Returned for 4 seconds, allowing immediate reactivation if Grappling ends while the buff is active.
Grenade Kickstart does not activate when grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Melee:
Performed by pressing [Melee Attack] while grappling, or for up to ? seconds after, while at a sufficiently fast speed.
Deals 432 [61] impact damage, and up to 432 [61] radial damage over a 4? metre radius, unraveling and pushing enemies back.
Guardians directly hit by Grapple Melee have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds

Grapple Melee counts as both a Grenade and Melee Ability.
Ashes to Assets grants 50% less Super Energy when a Grapple Melee is used with a Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Passive Ability Regeneration is disabled until no longer airborne. Also applies to Silkstrike.

grenades.name: Mindspun Invocation
grenades.description: Grapple Melee creates 3 Threadlings on hit.

grenades.name: Shackle Grenade
grenades.description:
Bola Trajectory

Throws a bola, releasing an explosion on impact that deals 190 [?] damage and inflict Suspension in a ? metre radius to enemies hit, then releases smaller bolas.
2 Small Bolas are released on direct hit. 3 Smaller Bolas are released if they instead impact a surface.

Smaller Bolas are released towards nearby enemies, each dealing 81 [?] damage and inflicting Suspension on hit.

grenades.name: Mindspun Invocation
grenades.description:
Grants Weaver's Trance for 25 seconds.
Kills while Weaver's Trance is active cause the enemy to trigger a Suspending explosion on death.
Suspending Explosion deals 108 [?] Strand Grenade Ability Damage to enemies within 6 meters.

grenades.name: Slicewire
grenades.description:
Medium? Trajectory

Throws a bouncing grenade that explodes soon after impact, dealing splash damage over 4 hits and inflicting Sever for 10+5 seconds over 6 meters.

Slicewire Maximum Damage:
1st = 178 [?] | 2nd = 178 [?] | 3rd = 222 [?] | 4th = 267 [?] damage.
The first hit against any enemy deals an additional instance of 307 [?] damage.

grenades.name: Mindspun Invocation
grenades.description:
The fourth explosion will release 4 submunition in a X formation, each dealing up to 64 [?] damage and spawning a Tangle.
Ignores Tangle Creation Cooldown.

grenades.name: Threadling Grenade
grenades.description:
Medium Trajectory

Splits into 3 projectiles while midair, each creating a Threadling on impact.

grenades.name: Mindspun Invocation
grenades.description:
Hold [Grenade] to prepare a Nest Grenade.
Nest Grenade creates a Teeming Nest on impact.

Teeming Nest: 300 Construct HP. Lasts for 17.5 seconds, constantly draining 6.7% (-20) HP per second 1.5 seconds after reaching Full Health.
Gives birth to 3 Threadlings on deployment, followed by a Threadling every 5 seconds.

melees.name: Threaded Spike
melees.description:
Bounces on hits or upon striking surfaces, heading towards up to 9 enemies within ? metres of each, dealing 427 [82] damage and severing for ?+? seconds on hit. 
Deals 18% decreased damage on the first bounce, and 42.5% decreased damage on every bounce afterwards.

Grants Melee Energy based on the amount of hits scored upon returning.
[Melee Attack] while the projectile is nearby to catch it. 
Catching the Threaded Spike increases the amount of Melee Energy gained.
Strand Subclass Exclusive: Catching the Threaded Spike grants Woven Mail for 2 seconds for each kill it scores, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

Hits | Melee % | Caught %
0 | 5% | 20% 
1 | 10% | 30%
2 | 20% | 50%
3 | 30% | 70%
4 | 35% | 85%
5+ | 40% | 100%

supers.name: Silkstrike
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [45%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second

Light Attack
Drains 4% Super Energy.
Hits deal 1638 [260] damage.
Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 1293 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Heavy Attack
Drains 9% Super Energy.
Swings the rope dart in a 360-degree arc, dealing [504] [80] damage in a ? metre radius. Hits twice per usage.

Grenade
Does not drain Super Energy.
Functionally identical to a Grapple Grenade that instantly recharges once grounded.

Class Ability
Drains 4.5% Super Energy.
Performs the Arc Staff Dodge Animation, evading attacks.

 Allows the repeated usage of Ensnaring Slam while the Aspect is equipped at the cost of 4.5% Super Energy.

aspects.name: Ensnaring Slam
aspects.description:
[Air Move] expends Class Ability Energy to dive downwards, dealing 61 [11] damage and inflicting Suspension to enemies within 8 [6.5] metres.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability, as well as Threaded Specter if equipped.

Grants Woven Mail for 4 seconds for each enemy suspended with the Ensnaring Slam, up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

aspects.name: Threaded Specter
aspects.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Spawns a Strand Decoy. 

Decoy has 175 Construct HP and lasts for up to 12 seconds. Combatants are lured to attack it, and has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants. 
Allies and Caster deal 150% increased Ability and Weapon Damage towards it.
Decoy always counts as hostile and can be damaged by allies, enemies, and the caster. Does not activate any On-Kill effect.

Upon losing all HP or when an enemy is within ? metres:
 Deals up to 600 [60 Guardians | 121 Objects] damage in a ? metre radius.
Explosions triggered by enemies being near it spawn 2 Threadlings.

Passively applies 0.6x Class Ability Regeneration Speed while equipped.

aspects.name: Whirling Maelstrom
aspects.description:
Upon destroying a regular, boring Tangle:
Summons a Spinny Tangle, which seeks enemies within ? metres, accelerating as it gets closer, up to a maximum of 6m/s.
Beyblade Tangles counts as a Grapple Tangle.

Whirling Tangles have ? Construct HP, and last for 12 seconds.
🛸UFO Tangles deal 29 [?] Strand damage every 0.1 seconds in a 2? meter radius, and release Unraveling Projectiles on kill.
Stabby Tangles kills count as Tangle Kills. Rotating Tangles Hits do not count as Tangle hits nor as Ability Damage.

aspects.name: Widow's Silk
aspects.description:
Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.

Grapple creates a Grapple Tangle.
Grapple Tangle won't be created if Grapple attaches to an enemy or ally.

melees.name: Frenzied Blade
melees.description:
Innately has 3 Melee Ability Charges.

supers.name: Bladefury
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [50%]
Base Duration: 24 seconds, or 4.167% Super Drain per Second
Grants 3 Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Light Attack
Drains 3% Super Energy.
Performs a strengthened Frenzied Blade Melee that deals 851 [210] damage and can be infinitely chained.
Deals 25% increased damage against Suspended enemies. 
Attacks 3 times per second. Increases Attack Speed by 100% after chaining 3 sustained light attacks. 
Performing a Heavy Attack, or failing to maintain a Light Attack chain will remove the Attack Speed Increase.

Heavy Attack
Drains 10.5% Super Energy. Incurs a 3 second cooldown after usage.
Hurls a pair of Suspending projectiles forward that home in towards enemies, dealing 143 x 2 [61] impact damage, and up to 608 x 2 [36] splash damage over ? meters.
Light Attack Hits reduce the cooldown by 1 second. Receiving any damage reduces the cooldown by 1 second.

aspects.name: Banner of War
aspects.description:
Upon scoring a Sword Kill, Melee Kill, Glaive Melee Kill, Super Light Attack Kill, or Finisher:
Raises a Banner of War for 15 seconds, buffing the user and nearby allies within 10 metres. 
Kills scored by the user or nearby allies empower and extend the duration of Banner of War, up to a maximum of x4 Banner of War and 30 seconds.

Banner of War:
Lasts for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 24 seconds.
Grants x1 stacks for every 7 [2] enemies that either die within 20 meters, are killed by the user, or by allies within 20 metres.
Kills increase the duration by +5 seconds. Each stack after the second decreases the duration extension by -1, down to +3 seconds per kill at x4 stacks.
Periodically restores 20 HP every 2.5 seconds. Each stack after the first decreases the delay between pulses by 0.5 second, down to 1 second at x4 stacks.
Grants 100% [Varies] Increased Melee Damage, 40% Increased Bladefury Damage, and 20% Increased Sword Damage.
[x1 = ?% Inc. Melee DMG | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?%]

Stacks | Time Extension | Kills for next stack | Pulse Delay
x1 | +6 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 2.5 seconds
x2 | +5 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 2 seconds
x3 | +4 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 1.5 seconds
x4 | +3 seconds | - | 1 second

aspects.name: Drengr's Lash
aspects.description:
Killing Elementally-Debuffed Enemies grants ?% Class Ability Energy.

aspects.name: Flechette Storm
aspects.description:
While sliding:
[Melee Ability] leaps into the air, draining 50% Melee Energy, knocking enemies within ? metres back, and dealing 135 [66] damage.
Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

While Airborne after using Melee Ability:
[Melee Ability] drains 50% Melee Energy to launch a cluster of 4 Unraveling Projectiles, each dealing 171 [25.2] damage to enemies within ? metres.
[Melee Ability] while airborne to chain additional throws.

Grants 25% Damage Resist against Non-Melee while in the Melee Animation.

aspects.name: Into The Fray
aspects.description:
Upon destroying a Tangle:
Releases 3 pulses from where the Tangle was destroyed, restoring 15 HP and granting Woven Mail to the user and allies within 10? metres every 2 seconds.

On Super Cast:
Grants allies within ? metres Woven Mail.

While Woven Mail is active:
300% [200%] Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate.

melees.name: Arcane Needle
melees.description:
Innately has 3 Melee Ability Charges.
0 Charges = 1.16x Regeneration Speed | 1 Charge = 1.64x Regeneration Speed | 2 Charges = 2.6x Regeneration Speed
On Prismatic: Penalized with an additional 0.7x Regeneration Speed

Throws a seeking Strand Needle, homing towards the targeted enemy, dealing 505 [68] damage and inflicting unravel for ?+? [7+2.5] seconds.

supers.name: Needlestorm
supers.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: ?% [53%]

Releases 9 homing projecties, each dealing 783 [?] damage and embedding on hit, exploding after ? seconds into threadlings.
Threadlings spawned from Needlestorm deal 368 [?] damage.

aspects.name: Mindspun Invocation
aspects.description:
Enhances Strand Grenades:

Grapple | Grapple Melees create 3 Threadlings.

Threadling Grenade | Hold [Grenade] to throw a Threadling nest.

Shackle Grenade | Hold [Grenade] to consume a Grenade Charge, granting Weaver's Trance for 25 seconds. 
Kills create a Suspending Explosion while Weaver's Trance is active that deals 108 [?] Strand Grenade Ability Damage to enemies within 6 meters.

Slicewire Grenade: Hold [Grenade] to overcharge it.
 The fourth explosion will release 4 submunition in a X formation, each dealing up to 64 [?] damage and spawning a Tangle.
Ignores Tangle Creation Cooldown.

aspects.name: The Wanderer
aspects.description:
Tangles trigger a Suspending Explosion after 1 second of exploding, dealing 324 [?] Damage and inflicting Suspension to enemies within 6 metres.

Thrown Tangles now seek and attach to enemies and are unaffected by Gravity.

Threadling Kills spawn a Tangle and decrease the Tangle Cooldown by 1 second.

aspects.name: Weaver's Call
aspects.description:
Threadling damage instances grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

Dealing an accumulated total of 700 [?] damage grants a Perched Threadling.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown before additional threadlings can be generated. Cannot generate more than 1 Threadling at a time.

On Class Ability Usage:
Creates 3 Threadlings, and deploys all Perched Threadlings.

Kills progress a counter that grants a Perched Threadling upon reaching 100%.
 Miniboss and below = 34% | Boss = 100% | Guardians = 67%

aspects.name: Weavewalk
aspects.description:
While airborne and while having at least 1 Melee Ability Charge:
[Air Move] grants Weavewalk and instantly consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.

While Weavewalk is active:
Generates a Perched Threadlings every 0.5 seconds. Grants 90% [90%, 60% while carrying Spark] Damage Resist.
Drains 25% Melee Ability Energy per second.
Functionally identical to Void Invisibility.
Arc Souls, No Time To Explain's Time-slip Portal, and Threadlings deal 50% Decreased Damage.
Unable to use Weapon, Abilities, or perform revives. Cannot pick up ammo or Orbs of Power.

Upon exiting Weavewalk:
Grants Woven Mail to the user and allies within ? meters.
Duration scales from 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 20 seconds after being in Weavewalk for ? seconds.

glossary.name: Transcendence
glossary.description:
Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.
Having one full Alignment bar makes Kinetic Damage fill the remaining bar with at 40% decreased rate.

Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy. 
Applying Elemental Effects, both buffs and debuffs, grant Transcendence Energy to their corresponding alignment.

Transcendence:
Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.
Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.
Grants 5% Increased Weapon Damage, an additional 10% Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed, and 20% [5%] Damage Resist for 20 seconds.
Damage Increase stacks with everything.

Dealing Grenade Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Melee Regeneration Speed to 35% Fixed Melee Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.

Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%
Each kill after the first gets a cumulative 0.9?x penalty to the duration extension.

glossary.name: Elemental Effects
glossary.description:
Elemental Effects include all of the verbs that subclasses apply that can either positively (Buff) or negatively (Debuff) affect a target.

Equipping any Arc Ability or Aspect allows Amplified to be activated by scoring multiple Arc Kills. Thruster does not count as an Arc Ability.
Equipping any Strand Ability or Aspect allows the creation of Tangles, and Warlocks are able to possess Perched Threadlings.

Light Subclass Verbs:
Arc = ↑Amplified ↑Bolt Charge ↓Blind ↓Jolt | Ionic Trace
Solar = ↑Cure ↑Radiant ↑Restoration ↓Scorch ↓Ignition | Firesprites
Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield ↓Suppression ↓Volatile ↓Weaken | Void Breach

Darkness Subclass Verbs:
Stasis = ↑Frost Armor ↓Slow ↓Freeze ↓Shatter | Stasis Shards
 Strand = ↑Woven Mail ↓Sever ↓Suspend ↓Unravel | Tangle

fragments.name: Awakening
fragments.description:
Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each, or a Super Kill spawns an Element-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final kill.

Incurs a 5 second cooldown between spawning the same Non-Tangle Elemental Pickups.
Kills with the element of the spawned pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.

fragments.name: Balance
fragments.description:
Killing 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each with Light Damage grants 10% Melee Energy.

Killing 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each with Dark Damage grants 10% Grenade Energy.

fragments.name: Blessing
fragments.description:
Melee Kills begin health regeneration. 
Effect applies to allies within ? metres while Transcendent.

fragments.name: Bravery
fragments.description:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.

Powered Melee Kills grant Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.

fragments.name: Command
fragments.description:
Suppressing or Freezing an enemy refills the readied weapon and grants +20? Stability, +? Aim Assist, and +40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds. 
Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated.

Killing Frozen or Suppressed Enemies spawns a Stasis Shard or Void Breach respectively.

fragments.name: Courage
fragments.description:
Against enemies inflicted with Stasis or Strand Elemental Debuffs:
Light Abilities deal 10% increased damage.
Light Powered Melee Abilities deal 50% [10%] increased damage.

fragments.name: Dawn
fragments.description:
Powered Melee Hits grant Radiant for 5 seconds.

Powered Melee Kills grant Radiant for 5 seconds to the user and allies within ? metres.

fragments.name: Defiance
fragments.description:
Finishers trigger an Elemental Detonation that deals 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff to enemies within 7 meters.
Arc = Jolt | Solar = x40 Scorch | Void = Volatile 
Stasis = x? Slow for ? seconds | Strand = Sever

fragments.name: Devotion
fragments.description:
Killing enemies affected by Stasis or Strand Elemental Debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy.
Rank-and-File = 1% | Elites = 3% | Minibosses+ = 5% | Guardians = ?%

fragments.name: Dominance
fragments.description:
Void Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.

Arc Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Jolt.
Arc Soul has a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict Jolt again.

fragments.name: Generosity
fragments.description:
Kills while Transcendent progress a counter that spawns Orbs of Power that grant 7.15% Super Energy for allies at specific thresholds.
Up to a maximum of 4 Orbs of Power can be spawned per Transcendence activation.

Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4 = 34% | Minibosses = 40% | Bosses = 50% | Guardians = ?%
Orbs of Power are spawned at the 30% (1st) | 50% (2nd) | 70% (3rd) | 100% (4th) thresholds.

fragments.name: Grace
fragments.description:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence energy.

Super Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence Energy to the user and allies within ? metres.

fragments.name: Honor
fragments.description:
Picking up Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment.

Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches = 7.5% Light Energy 
Stasis Shards = 5% Darkness Energy | Tangles = 10% Darkness Energy

fragments.name: Hope
fragments.description:
Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate based on the amount of active Elemental Buffs.
x1 = 40% | x2 = 60%

fragments.name: Justice
fragments.description: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [?] Ability-Matching damage over ? meters

fragments.name: Mending
fragments.description:
Grenade Ability Kills grant Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant Cure x2.

fragments.name: Protection
fragments.description:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies:
15% [?%] Damage Resist.

Instead, the 15% DR from Protection stacks with Transcendence's 20%, totalling 32% DR.

fragments.name: Purpose
fragments.description:
Orbs of Power grant Elemental Buffs on pickup, based on the equipped Super.

Arc: x1 Bolt Charge.
Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds.
Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds.
Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds.

fragments.name: Ruin
fragments.description:
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals deals an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] metre radius. 
Falloff decreases damage dealt down to a minimum of 17 [4] damage at the maximum falloff distance.

Ignitions have 25% increased radius.

fragments.name: Sacrifice
fragments.description: Ability Kills while affected by an Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental Buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

fragments.name: Solitude
fragments.description:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each:
The next damage instance from any source within 3 seconds will emit a Severing Burst.
Sever Burst inflicts Sever to enemies within 3 metres. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown upon Severing. Precision Hits during the cooldown will not be counted.

Precision hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
20% of Magazine + 1, rounded down.
Bows: 2 hits
The Precision Hit that prepares the Severing Burst can't trigger the effect through simultaneous damage instances. Trinity Ghoul and the Explosive Payload perk, for example.

aspects.name: Ascension
aspects.description:
While Airborne and having a Class Ability Charge:
[Air Move] consumes a Class Ability Charge to perform an upwards Arc Staff Twirl.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability, as well as Threaded Specter if equipped on usage.

Grants Amplified to the user and allies within 10 meters.
Deals up to 181 [30] damage, as well as Jolting enemies within 10 metres.

aspects.name: Gunpowder Gamble
aspects.description:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive. Readies at 6 Charges.
Weapon = 1 [2] | Elemental-Debuff = 3 [4] | Abilities = 4 | Super = 6

Replaces Grenade with an Ignition-on-a-Stick that causes an ignition that deals 50% increased damage upon being shot or after 3 seconds.
Shooting the dynamite increases its damage by 50% [5%], its radius by ?% to ? meters, and releases 9 homing submunitions, with each dealing up to 80 [?] Damage.
Only triggers Grenade-Effects when it automatically detonates, and not when shot.

Incurs a 6 second cooldown after activating. Kills while on cooldown don't give charges.

aspects.name: Stylish Executioner
aspects.description:
Killing enemies affected by any Elemental Debuff grants Invisibility for 8 seconds, and Truesight for 4 seconds.

While invisible, and for 0.5 seconds after leaving Invis from activating Stylish Execution:
Melee Attacks deal 300% [20%] increased damage, weaken enemies for 5 [2.5] seconds, and have their Melee Lunge Range extended to ? metres.

Applies "Too Stylish" after Stylish Executioner is triggered, preventing additional Stylish Execution activations for 2 [12] seconds.

aspects.name: Winter's Shroud
aspects.description:
Upon inflicting Slow to an enemy:
Grants 300% [150%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds.

On Class Ability Usage:
Inflicts x60 [x40] Slow for 8 [1.5] seconds to enemies within 9 [8] metres.
Grants 50% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds.

aspects.name: Threaded Specter
aspects.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Spawns a Strand Decoy. 

Decoy has 175 HP and lasts for up to 12 seconds. Combatants are lured to attack it and has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants. 
Allies and Caster deal 150% increased Ability and Weapon Damage towards it.

Upon losing all HP or when an enemy is within ? metres:
 Deals up to 479 [60 Guardians | 121 Objects] damage in a ? metre radius.

prismatic_grenade.name: Hailfire Spike
prismatic_grenade.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Attaches to surfaces or enemies, releasing a torrent of Stasis and Solar energy in a cone up to ? meters away.

Erupts into a slowing storm, dealing up to 78 [?] damage upon erupting.
Slowing storm deals 15.6 [?] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.45 seconds.

After 3.45 seconds of attaching, it releases a scorching cyclone that deals 39 [?] Solar Damage and inflicts x10 Scorch every 0.25 seconds for 4 seconds.

aspects.name: Knockout
aspects.description:
On Melee Kill:
Quickly restores a varying amount of Health over 0.1 seconds, begins Health Regeneration and grants Amplified.
Rank-and-File = 50 HP | Elite = 75 HP | Miniboss+ = 100 HP | Guardian = 30 HP 

Upon breaking an Enemy Shield, or dealing damage to an enemy below 30% HP:
Grants Knockout for 6 seconds.

Knockout:
160% [30%] increased Basic/Glaive Melee Damage
160% [20%] increased Charged Melee Damage
Basic Melee Attacks count as Arc Powered Melee Hits.
Increases Melee Lunge Distance against Combatants to 6 metres

aspects.name: Consecration
aspects.description:
While sliding:
[Melee Ability] launches a wave of Solar Energy 20 meters forward, dealing 40 [30] damage and inflicting x40 Scorch. 
Only consumes 50% Melee Ability Energy if the slam is not activated. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

While airborne from the Consecration Melee Ability:
[Melee Ability] slams the ground, creating a second, wider wave that travels 20 meters forward, shatters crystals, and deals 486 [120] damage to Non-Scorched Enemies.
Hits against Scorched Enemies with the second wave deal 472.5 [50] damage and trigger an ignition.

Grants 25% Damage Resist against Non-Melee Damage while in the Melee Animation.

aspects.name: Unbreakable
aspects.description:
Hold [Grenade] to summon a Void Shield. Can be summoned while Hammer of Sol or Glacial Quake are active.
Overrides Grenade Ability Cooldown to 152 seconds at base while equipped.

Void Shield:
Grants 95?% [64%] Damage Resist against blocked damage, and taunts Combatants in front of the user. Combatants that come into contact with the shield become disoriented.
Generates 10 Void Overshield HP/s that lasts 5+2.5 seconds while draining 7.5% Grenade Energy/s.
Blocking damage decreases Forward Movement Speed by 50?% for 0.5? seconds.
Blocking damage grants Grenade Energy. Energy gains are progressively reduced (over time) OR (as Unbreakable gains damage)?, down to ?% Energy after ? seconds.
Void Shield has no Movement Speed Penalties, only restricting mantling. Sprinting cancels Void Shield.

Releasing [Grenade] or running out of Grenade Energy releases a frontal blast, consuming 50% Grenade Energy and dealing damage up to 11 meters away.
Deals a minimum of 430 [64?] Grenade Damage for not blocking any damage, scaling to 1584 [178?] damage after receiving a lot [?] blocked damage.

Unbreakable Kills grant Devour for 10+5 seconds.

aspects.name: Diamond Lance
aspects.description:
Creates a Stasis Lance upon scoring 1 [3] Stasis Weapon Kills, an Ability Kill, or a Shatter Kill.
Knockout-Infused Unpowered Melee Guardian Kills will not create a Stasis Lance.

Stasis Lance is a single-use weapon that can be picked up while it is within 3 meters and can held for up to 10 seconds.
Remains for up to 25 seconds on the ground.

[Fire] throws the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 5 metres of the impact, shattering crystals on direct impact, and dealing 150 [45] damage. 
[Melee] slams the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 8 [6.75?] metres, dealing up to 200 [90] damage, and bestowing the user and their allies within ? meters x2 Frost Armor.
Diamond Lances instantly shatter Stasis Crystals upon damaging them.
Diamond Lance Damage is considered Generic Stasis Ability Damage. Not Grenade nor Melee Damage.

Incurs a 7 [17] second cooldown after spawning a Stasis Lance before another can be spawned.

aspects.name: Drengr's Lash
aspects.description:
On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes a Strand Lash forward that travels up to 30 metres away.
Strand Lash tracks enemies in its path, dealing 60 [30] damage and suspending on hit.

On Thruster Class Ability Usage:
Creates a Strand Knot that explodes after ? seconds, dealing up to 60 [30] damage and suspending in a ? meter radius.

prismatic_grenade.name: Electrified Snare
prismatic_grenade.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Explosive charged with Arc and Strand energy.
Explodes in a supercharged suspending burst, dealing up to 105 [?] damage, and inflicting Suspension to enemies within ? meters.
Suspended Enemies are dealt ? damage every ? seconds for ? seconds, and are inflicted Jolt.

aspects.name: Lightning Surge
aspects.description:
While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] warps the user forward 10 meters, calling down 5 lightning bolts in a ⬠-shape 7 meters away from the exit point, and granting x1 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.

aspects.name: Hellion

On Class Ability Usage:

Hellion:

Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.

aspects.name: Feed the Void
aspects.description:
Grants Enhanced Devour upon scoring an Ability Kill, Frozen Enemy Shatter Kill, Volatile Explosion Kill, or a Tangle Kill. 
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%

aspects.name: Bleak Watcher
aspects.description:
Hold [Grenade] to convert the Grenade Ability into a Stasis Turret. 
Overrides Grenade Cooldown to 159.6 seconds. Ability Chunk Scalars inherit the currently equipped Grenade Ability's Multiplier.

Stasis Turret:
Automatically shoots a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds at enemies within 35 metres, inflicting x20 [x10] Slow for 4.5 [2] seconds per hit. 
Lasts for 25 seconds, has 150 Construct HP, and 67% Damage Resist until it has fired.
Bleak Watcher damage counts as Stasis Grenade Ability Damage.

aspects.name: Weaver's Call
aspects.description:
Threadling damage instances grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

Dealing an accumulated total of 700 [?] damage grants a Perched Threadling.

Damage requirement is based on the displayed damage numbers, and is penalized by Power Level Delta.

On Class Ability Usage:
Creates 3 Threadlings, and deploys all Perched Threadlings.

Kills progress a counter that grants a Perched Threadling upon reaching 100%.
 Miniboss and below = 34% | Boss = 100% | Guardians = 67%

prismatic_grenade.name: Freezing Singularity
prismatic_grenade.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Deals up to 70 [26] Void Damage on impact, pulling enemies within 12 meters towards it, and creating a miniature black hole orbited by a halo of slowing ice.

The slowing field deals 18 [4] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.65 seconds to enemies within 6 meters.

After 5 seconds of impacting, the black hole implodes, infliction suppression and dealing up to 570 [150] Void Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

Hunter.intrinsics:
Hunters intrinsically possess the following traits over Titans and Warlocks:

Base Sprint Speed is 8.5 meters per second, compared to their baseline of 8m/s.
Enhanced intrinsic Strafe/Walk Speed and 0.9x [0.95x] Ready/Stow Animation Duration.

abilities.name: Acrobat's Dodge
abilities.description:
Performs an acrobatic leap, that, upon landing, grants the user and their allies within 10 meters Radiant for 10+5 seconds.
Enemies within 6.5 meters are dealt up to 40 [20] Solar Damage upon landing.

abilities.name: Gambler's Dodge
abilities.description:
Performs a deft tumble that grants 1% [0.35%] Melee Ability Energy per Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] Melee Ability Energy at 100 Melee Stat.
Dodging within 15 meters of an enemy doubles the Ability Energy gained. No Chunk or Stat Scalar.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

abilities.name: Marksman's Dodge
abilities.description:
Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

Titan.intrinsics:
Titans intrinsically possess the following traits over Hunters and Warlocks:

 20% [5%] Increased Basic Melee Damage.
Increased damage is multiplicative.

abilities.name: Rally Barricade
abilities.description:
Creates a short, curved barricade construct in front of the caster that blocks all damage dealt to it.
Grants 20% [20%] Damage Resist while in the Barricade Placement animation.

Barricade lasts for 20 seconds, and has 500 Construct HP. Barricades have 90% Damage Resist against Combatants, and ?% against Boss Combatants.
Enemies that pass through the barricade rapidly receive ? [?] non-lethal damage every ? seconds.

While within ? meters behind the Rally Barricade:
80% Damage Resist against Splash Damage from Combatants.
Combatants up to ? meters in front of the barricade are taunted.
+30 Stability, +100 Reload Speed, 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier, 10% Increased Damage Falloff Distance, and 50% Flinch Resist.

abilities.name: Thruster
abilities.description:
Performs an evasive first-person dash that removes Combatant Projectile Tracking?, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians.

Quickly dashes 8 metres towards the currently held movement direction. Not inputting a movement direction will result in a 4 metre backwards dash.

abilities.name: Towering Barricade
abilities.description:
Creates a tall, slightly curved barricade construct in front of the caster that blocks all damage dealt to it.
Grants 20% [20%] Damage Resist while in the Barricade Placement animation.

Barricade lasts for 20 seconds, and has 500 Construct HP. Barricades have 90% Damage Resist against Non-Boss Combatants, and ?% against Boss Combatants.
Enemies that pass through the barricade rapidly receive ? [?] non-lethal damage every ? seconds.

While within ? meters behind the Towering Barricade:
80% Damage Resist against Splash Damage from Combatants.
Combatants up to ? meters in front of the barricade are taunted.

Warlock.intrinsics:
Warlocks intrinsically possess the following traits over Titans and Hunters:

1.1x Grenade Regeneration Speed.
5% [2.5%] Increased Grenade Ability Damage.

abilities.name: Empowering Rift
abilities.description:
Conjures an Empowering Rift beneath the caster for 15 seconds. 

Rift grants 20% [15%] increased damage, 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate in a 5 meter radius.
Kills while in the Rift grant 1.15x Ammo Generation Multiplier. Ammo Generation Multiplier is additive to Ammo Finder Multipliers.

Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

abilities.name: Healing Rift
abilities.description:
Conjures a Healing Rift beneath the caster that continuously restores 40 [35] HP per second in a 5 meter radius for 15 seconds.

While at Full Health | Healing Rift generates 3 Overshield HP per second, up to 15 Overshield HP. Having Void Overshield prevents this from happening.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".
Healing Rifts cause the users to count as having Overshields for the purpose of perk interactions.

Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

abilities.name: Phoenix Dive
abilities.description:
Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

While Heat Rises is active:
Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving.
Deals 100 damage and x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 5 metres upon landing.

Hunter.name: Assassin's Cowl
Hunter.description:
On Powered Melee Kill or Finisher:
Grants Void Invisibility and restores 67 Health.
(Finishers) increase the duration of the Void Invisibility by +3 seconds.

Invisibility Duration 
Minor = 7 seconds (10)
Elite | Guardian = 10 seconds (13)
Miniboss+ = 13 seconds (16)

Hunter.name: Athrys's Embrace
Hunter.description:
While Weighted Throwing Knives are equipped:

Weighted Throwing Knives gain a second bounce with greatly increased tracking.

Upon scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each:
 Grants Strengthened Throwing Knife for 10 seconds.
Scoring additional Precision Hits extends the buff duration by 5 seconds, up to 30 seconds.

Strengthened Throwing Knife:
300% [100%] increased Weighted Throwing Knife damage and +50 Melee Stat while active.
Stuns Unstoppable Champions on hit.
 Buff is consumed on hit.

Hunter.name: Balance of Power
Hunter.description:
Enhances Threaded Specter
 Specter has 50% [25%] Damage Resist, 67% increased Duration, and 2 Perched Threadlings.
Perched Threadlings are released when the Specter takes 40 damage.
Destroying the Specter releases all Perched Threadlings.
Damage Resist does not apply to damage from the user.

Being within 15 meters of the user's Threaded Specter removes the user from radar.
Signified by the Hidden buff.

0.5x Class Ability Regeneration Speed for 19 seconds upon Class Ability usage.

Hunter.name: Blight Ranger
Hunter.description:
While in Arc Staff Super:
Blocking doesn't consume any extra Super Energy.
Reflected Projectiles deal 400% increased damage. (10x base damage against Combatants)
Reflecting Projectiles grants ?% Super Energy.

Can deactivate Arc Staff at any time to preserve a portion of unspent Super Energy.
Deactivation refunds up to 75% of unspent Super Energy at 100% Super Energy, down to 50% of unspent Super Energy at 0% Super Energy.

On Arc Staff deactivation:
Triggers an Arc Explosion, dealing scaling damage based on the amount of reflected projectiles and blinding enemies within 10 meters.
Deals 675 [?] damage at base, up to 2,700 [?] damage after reflecting MANY projectiles.
Grants x4 Arc Weapon Surge for 21 [16] seconds.
Blinding Burst Damage has no falloff.

Hunter.name: The Bombardiers
Hunter.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 440 [120] damage over 7.5 metres. Detonates instantly on contact with surface or enemy.

Parting Gift has an additional effect based on the equipped Super:
Arc: Blind for 10 [3] seconds.
Solar: x40+20 Scorch.
Void: Suppress for 10 seconds [Does not apply to Guardians in Super]
Stasis: x40 [x20] Slow for 4+4 [1.5+0.5] seconds.
Strand: Severs for ? seconds.

Hunter.name: Caliban's Hand
Hunter.description:
Proximity Explosive Knife inflicts x60+0 Scorch on detonation. 
Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an ignition.

625%? Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.

Scorch grants 7% [?%] Melee Ability Energy per tick.
Reminder that Proximity Knife has a 0.7x Chunk Scalar.

Ignitions Kills grant a Melee Ability Charge.
Can overflow up to +1 Melee Charges for Solar Knives and Withering Blades.
While on Prismatic, can overflow up to +2 for Knife Trick and Withering Blades.

Hunter.name: Celestial Nighthawk
Hunter.description:
Replaces Golden Gun with a modified single high-damage shot version.
Golden Gun Supers no longer receive Roaming Super Ability Regeneration.

Modified Golden Gun:
Deals 12,984 [?] Damage with a 2x Precision Multiplier. Triggers an ignition on hit.
Ignition damage overrides other sources, always dealing 10% increased damage.
(85% more damage on Precision Hit compared to 3 Precision Hits+Ignition from Base Marksman Golden Gun).

On Golden Gun Kill:
Refunds 33% Super Energy 
Enemy explodes, dealing up to 400 [?] Damage to enemies within ? metres.

On Precision Kill:
Grants additional Golden Gun Super Energy, ranging between 1.5% to 4.5%.
 Actual amount varies by Enemy Rank.

Hunter.name: Cyrtarachne's Facade
Hunter.description:
Upon Grappling:
Grants Woven Mail for 10 seconds.
Restores 7 HP.

While Woven Mail is active:
?% Flinch Resistance.
Kills restore 17 HP.

Hunter.name: The Dragon's Shadow
Hunter.description:
Passively grants +10 Stability and 0.?x Ready Duration Multiplier.

On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Wraithmetal Mail for 15 seconds.
Reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters. Activates On-Reload Perks.

Wraithmetal Mail:
+35 Stability and +? Handling.
Increases Sprint Speed from 8.5m/s to 9m/s.
Increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
?% Decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty.
Does not grant any Class Stat, contrary to description.

Hunter.name: Foetracer
Hunter.description:
Upon dealing Ability Damage to an Elite, Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Guardian: 
Grants x4 Ability Element-Matching Weapon Surge and highlights the enemy for 16 [11] seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted enemies spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

Hunter.name: Fortune’s Favor
Hunter.description:
While at Full Health | Upon scoring a kill, or upon being not receiving damage for 4.5 [15] seconds:
Grants 6.6 [1.1] Void Overshield HP per second until taking damage again.
Continuously refreshes Overshield duration.

While any kind of Overshield is active:
+25 Stability, +25? Handling, and -5% Accuracy Cone Size.
Weapons receive 15% increased damage against Combatants.
Heat Weapons are instead granted 20% increased damage against Combatants.
Damage buff stacks with everything.

Scoring a kill while an Overshield is active prepares Hasty Escape.
Hasty Escape grants +30? Mobility for 5 seconds when Overshield is depleted.

Hunter.name: Fr0st-EE5
Hunter.description:
While Sprinting: 
2x Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed | 100% Additional Base Grenade/Melee Regeneration Rate
100% [200%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Grants a stack of Frost Armor every 3 [6] seconds.
Cannot stack beyond x1 Frost Armor without Whisper of Rime in PvP.

While Frost Armor is active:
x3 [x1] Stasis Weapon Surge.

Hunter.name: Gemini Jester
Hunter.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Inflicts Misdirection to enemies within 10 metres.

 Misdirection:
Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants become disoriented for 5 seconds.
 Audio becomes briefly distorted, briefly applies disorient, and radar is removed for 5 seconds.

Hunter.name: Graviton Forfeit
Hunter.description:
Void Invisibility effects last 2 seconds longer.

Upon gaining Void Invisibility:
Grants Vanishing Shadow for 7 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Vanishing Shadow duration does not decrease while Invisible.

x1 = 166.6% Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 67% Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
x2 = 333.3% Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 134% Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
x3 = 500% Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 200% Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Upon reaching x3 Vanishing Shadow or gaining Void Invisibility while at x3 Vanishing Shadow:
+15 Void Overshield HP for 7+3? seconds.

Hunter.name: Gifted Conviction
Hunter.description:
Upon using Ascension or Tempest Strike:
Releases 3 tracking Arc projectiles forward.
Arc Projectiles deal up to 200 [40] damage and inflict jolt.
Arc Projectiles count towards Sword on-hit effects while a Sword is readied.

Upon inflicting Jolt to enemies within 15? meters:
Grants a stack of Resist for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.
Additional Jolt Applications to enemies within 15? meters refreshes the buff duration.

Damage Resist Scaling:
1 Jolt Applications = 25% [5%] Damage Resist (Resist x2)
2 Jolt Applications = 40% [7.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x3)
3 Jolt Applications = 50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4)

Hunter.name: Gwisin Vest
Hunter.description:
Upon Void Invisibility ending, while within 15 meters of an enemy:
Triggers a Snare Bomb on the user.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between activations.
Does not interact with Trapper's Ambush.

While in Spectral Blades:
Restores Super Energy on Heavy Attack based on the amount of Spectral Blade Kills and Hits.

Super Energy % Extension gains based on hits and kills
?%
?%

Hunter.name: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
Hunter.description:
Upon Void Invisibility ending:
Volatile Rounds for 9 [3] seconds.

Upon performing a Finisher while affected by Void Invisibility:
35% increased damage for 6 seconds. Doesn't stack with Empowering Buffs.
The user and their allies within 24 metres receive a Reserve Overshield 

Reserve Overshield:
500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate until Class Ability Usage.
Consumed on Class Ability Usage, granting a 40 HP Void Overshield for 10 seconds.

Hunter.name: Khepri's Sting
Hunter.description:
Upon killing a Weakened Enemy while a Void Melee Ability is equipped:
Releases a weakening cloud of smoke on Enemy Death Location.
Grants 30% Void Melee Ability Energy.
Functionally, the cloud of smoke is a Snare Bomb that is instantly detonated.

Hunter.name: Knucklehead Radar
Hunter.description:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness and radar remains active while ADS.

While crouched: 
Grants Enhanced Radar.
 (Has 12 sectors instead of 6)

Upon dealing damage to a Combatant, or upon breaking a Guardian's Shield:
Marks enemies for 3 seconds.
Mark persists through walls.

If Enemy is below 30% Health: 
1% increased Weapon and Ability Damage per percent below 30%.
10% HP left -> 20% Increased Damage. Shields do not count as Health.

Hunter.name: Liar's Handshake
Hunter.description:
While an Arc Melee is equipped:
Receiving Melee Damage, or scoring a Powered Melee Hit grants Cross Counter for the next Melee Hit within 3 seconds.

Cross Counter grants 400% increased Melee Damage and restores 40 HP on Melee Hit.
Cross Counter's Melee deals Arc Damage.

Hunter.name: Lucky Pants
Hunter.description:
While a Hand Cannon is readied:
 +20 Airborne Effectiveness, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5m to 8.5m.

Upon readying a Hand Cannon:
Grants Illegally Modded Holster for 6 seconds.
Direct Hits against Combatants grant stacks of Illegally Modded Holster, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Illegally Modded Holster is removed upon readying a non-Hand Cannon.

Illegally Modded Holster:
+100 Ready Speed Handling, 0.6x Ready Duration Multiplier, and -30% Accuracy Cone Size.
45% increased Direct Impact damage against Combatants per stack, up to 450% at 10 stacks.
Uncivil Discourse receives 30% increased Direct Impact Damage per stack.
Sturm's Overcharged Rounds, Hawkmoon's Paracausal Shot, and all other non-direct damage is not increased.
Bosses take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants buffed shots.

After Illegally Modded Holster expires, or upon stowing, if Illegally Modded Holster stacks were at x7 or higher:
Applies Out of Luck for 10 seconds, preventing Illegally Modded Holster from being activated.

Hunter.name: Lucky Raspberry
Hunter.description:
Arcbolt Grenades are now able to chain an additional time, damaging up to 5 enemies.
Arcbolt Grenades inflict Jolt to the first target hit.

Upon inflicting Jolt:
Grants 15% Arcbolt Grenade Ability Energy. 

Upon triggering Jolt chain damage:
Grants 7.5% Arcbolt Grenade Ability Energy.

Hunter.name: Mask of Bakris
Hunter.description:
While an Arc or Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Replaces Dodge with Shift.
Does not replace Acrobat's Dodge. Overrides Cooldown and Chunk Scalar to Marksman's Dodge.

On Class Ability Usage:
Performs a quick shift that moves the user up to 12 meters away, rendering them invisible and invulnerable for the duration of the shift.
Grants a stack of Light Shift for 11 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

Light Shift:
x1 = 10% | x2 = 21% | x3 = 33% increased Arc, Stasis, and Lord of Wolves Weapon Damage.
 10% Increased Weapon Damage against Stasis Debuffed Enemies.
Weapon Kills grant 60% Class Ability Energy while active.
Damage buffs stack with other buffs.

Hunter.name: Mask of Fealty
Hunter.description:
On Withering Blade hits and bounces:
Spawns a Small Stasis Crystal on the 1st and 3rd bounce.
Grants 7.5% Fixed Melee Ability Energy.

Upon shattering a Stasis Crystal with a Withering Blade:
Releases 3 Stasis Projectiles spread out 120° near the Stasis Crystal.
Stasis Projectiles spawn a Small Crystal on impact.

Hunter.name: Mechaneer's Tricksleeves
Hunter.description:
Passively grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness, +100 Handling and +100 Reload Speed to Sidearms.

Upon readying a sidearm while at Critical Health:
Grants Damage Buff and refills Sidearm ammo.

Damage Buff:
Grants 100% [10%] increased Sidearm damage.
Sidearm Kills refill Magazine.
Damage Buff has no timer while at Critical Health. 
Damage Buff has a 5 second timer upon Shields recovering.
Sidearm Kills refresh 3 seconds.

Hunter.name: Moirai
Hunter.description:
Threaded Spike can now bounce to Tangles, detonating them and immediately returning.
Detonating a Tangle with Threaded Spike and catching it automatically picks up a Tangle.
Collecting the Tangle this way counts for Elemental Pickup interactions.

Failing to catch the aforementioned Threaded Spike triggers a Strand Explosion around the user.
Strand Explosion deals 727 [?] Strand Melee Damage over 9 meters with no falloff.
Failure Explosion scales with Melee Damage Buffs and triggers Melee Interactions.
Failure Explosion does NOT count as Tangle damage.

Catching a Threaded Spike that doesn't hit a Tangle refunds an additional 25% Melee Ability Energy, unaffected by Melee Stat.

Hunter.name: Mothkeeper’s Wraps
Hunter.description:
Kills grant charges of Winged Eclipse Ready, up to a maximum of 6.
Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite = 2 | Miniboss+ and Guardians = 3
When fully charged, grants 2 Grenade Charges of Winged Eclipse.
Incurs a 6 second cooldown upon throwing the last moth cage before Winged Eclipse can be charged.

Winged Eclipse:
Releases 2 Moths on impact. Moth Element changes depending on the closest 2 targets within 20 meters.
If there are no targets within 20 meters, they default to Void Moths.

Releases an Arc Moth if the closest target is an enemy, pursuing at ~10m/s and detonating on contact.
Arc Moths deal up to 473 [31 Guardians | 201 Constructs] Arc Grenade Damage and blind over a 4 meter radius.

Releases a Void Moth if the closest target is an allied Guardian.
Void Moths chase their allies at ~25m/s, bestowing 22.5 Void Overshield HP on contact.

Hunter.name: Oathkeeper
Hunter.description:
Passively grants +40 Airborne Effectiveness and +10 Draw Time to Bows.
+10 Draw Time is equivalent to Draw Time Masterwork.

Bows can hold perfect draws indefinitely.

After 0.35 seconds of reaching full draw on a Primary Ammo Bow:
Grants increased damage every 0.5 seconds, up to 200% increased impact damage against Combatants after 2 seconds.
Broadhead, Poison, Stasis Crystals, Dragonfly/Explosive Head, and others are not affected.
Damage Buff disappears after holding full draw for 4 seconds.

Hunter.name: Omnioculus
Hunter.description:
Grants an extra Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.

Void Invisibility grants 50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4).

Upon bestowing an ally with Void Invisibility:
Grants 50% Melee Ability Energy per ally made invisible, up to 200% with 4 allies.
Allies begin Health Regeneration.
Allies share the Damage Resist Effect if made invisible by the Omnioculus Wielder.
Damage Resistance does not apply in Super.

Hunter.name: Ophidia Spathe
Hunter.description:
Grants an extra Melee Charge to Solar Melee Abilities.
All Melee Charges are recharged simultaneously.
Does NOT recharge all Melee Charges if Melee Abilities have been used in the last ? seconds.
(Eg: Both are recharged on Gambler's Dodge)

On Throwing Knife Kill:
67% | 133% | 200% Increased Throwing Knife Damage for 5 seconds.
Gambler's Dodge Usage refreshes the duration.

Hunter.name: Orpheus Rig
Hunter.description:
For each enemy that gets tethered to a Deadfall anchor:
Grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. 
Refunds X% Super Energy, up to a maximum of 50% Super Energy.

Moebius Quiver can fire an additional volley per Super Activation and lasts 4 seconds longer.

Hunter.name: Raiden Flux
Hunter.description:
Arc Staff Hits grant a stack of Synapse Junctions for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 Stacks.
Arc Staff damage inflict Jolt. 
Palm Blast (L-L-H) receives 1.5x the damage increase.

Synapse Junction x1 = 27% (40%) Increased damage and 20% Slower Passive Super Drain.
Synapse Junction x2 = 61% (96%) Increased damage and 40% Slower Passive Super Drain.
Synapse Junction x3 = 105% (174%) Increased damage and 60% Slower Passive Super Drain.

Hunter.name: Raiju's Harness
Hunter.description:
Upon casting Gathering Storm:
Enemies within ? meters are struck by lightning, receiving 650 [?] damage and becoming jolted.
Caster and allies within ? meters are granted Amplified.

Lightning Strikes refund Super Energy per Arc-Debuffed Enemy Hits and Kills.
Hits: T1 = ?% | T2 = ?% | T3 = ?% | T4 = 25?%
Kills: T1 = ?% | T2 = ?% | T3 = ?% | T4 = ?%
Refunds up to a maximum of 50% Super Energy.

On Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kill:
Grants additional Gathering Storm Super Energy.
Rank-and-File = 1% | Elite = 2.5% | Miniboss+ = 4% | Guardian = 4%

Hunter.name: Radiant Dance Machines
Hunter.description:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness to Primary Weapons.

For Primary Weapons while hipfiring:
+30 Mobility, +5 Range, +30 Stability,
-30?% Accuracy Cone Size, +2?° Precision Angle Threshold,
20% Increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance.
 DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook do not receive the Falloff bonuses, and receive uniquely tweaked Accuracy values. 
Accuracy Cone values aren't testable but are high enough to effectively remove any accuracy cone growth.

Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ = 100% | Guardians = 20%

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress by scoring multiple Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each while at Full Class Ability Energy: 
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ = 100% | Guardians = 100%
Grants an additional Class Ability Charge, up to a maximum of 2 additional Class Ability Charges.

Hunter.name: Renewal Grasps
Hunter.description:
Enhances Duskfield Grenades:
Slowing Field is granted 25% Increased Radius.
Creates a Medium Stasis Crytstal.

While inside a Duskfield Grenade's Slowing Field:
Enemies deal 50% [20%] decreased damage.
User and allies are immediately granted x1 Frost Armor.
Grants an additional Frost Armor stack every 0.5 seconds.

When combined with Touch of Winter:
Stasis Crystal Size increases from Medium to Large.
Slowing Field radius is increased by +50%, to a total of 75% Increased Radius.

Hunter.name: Sealed Ahamkara Grasps
Hunter.description:
On Powered Melee/Grapple Melee Kill or Finisher:
Grants Nightmare Fuel for 7 seconds.
Nightmare Fuel | 35% [20%] increased damage, +? Handling and +50 Airborne Effectiveness.
Refills Stowed Weapons.
Does not stack with Empowering Buffs.

Upon readying a different weapon after gaining Nightmare Fuel:
Refreshes Nightmare Fuel duration.

Scoring a Weapon Kill while Nightmare Fuel is active retriggers Nightmare Fuel, allowing the next weapon switch to benefit from the aforementioned bonuses.

Hunter.name: Shards of Galanor
Hunter.description:
Solar Melee Ability Kills grant 2.5% to 5% Blade Barrage Super Energy, depending on Enemy Rank.

Blade Barrage Hits and Kills refund up to 50% Super Energy. Refund is unaffected by Super Stat.
Refund Amount depends on Kills and Hits, as well as Enemy Rank.
Elite = ~20% | Boss = 50%

Blade Barrage Impact and Explosion Damage is increased by 25%.
Triggers a delayed Solar Explosion for each 5 knives landed, up to 2 per Blade Barrage usage.
Each Explosion deals damage without falloff over 10 meters and releases 4 Shrapnel.
1st Explosion = 5852 (3804 Boss) Damage | 2nd Explosion = 6437 (4184 Boss) Damage.
Shrapnel deals up to 290 (190 Boss) Damage over ? meters and inflicts x20+0? Scorch.
Super Damage Increases ONLY affect the initial knife impact, explosion, and ignition damage.
Results in ~140% increased damage on Bosses with zero investment.
Knock 'Em Down increases Blade Barrage damage vs Boss from ~21K to ~26K (~+25%)

Hunter.name: Shinobu's Vow
Hunter.description:
Grants an extra Skip Grenade Charge.
Grants ?% Skip Grenade Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack gained.

Skip Grenades' drones chase enemies much more aggressively.
Skip Grenades hits grant 4.2% [1.4%] Grenade Ability Energy and x1 Bolt Charge.
Counts each impact and explosion damage instances as hits.

Upon reaching x10 Bolt Charge:
Restores ? HP to the user and allies within ? meters.
Grants ~40% Grenade Ability Energy.
The next Skip Grenade thrown is enhanced and bounces one additional time.
Enhanced Skip Grenades release 5 additional seekers on the 1st and 2nd bounce.

Hunter.name: The Sixth Coyote
Hunter.description:
Grants an extra Class Ability Charge.

Passively grants a copy of Reaper.

Hunter.name: Speedloader Slacks
Hunter.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters. Activates On-Reload Perks.
Grants x1 Tight Fit for the wearer and allies within 15 meters for 15 seconds.

While Tight Fit is active:
 Dodges grant an additional stack, up to a maximum of x5 Tight Fit and refresh the duration of the buff.

+40 | +40 | +45 | +50 | +55 Reload Speed
- | 0.925x | 0.915x | 0.91x | 0.89x Reload Duration Multiplier
+40? | +40? | +45? | +50? | +55? Handling

SMG, Trace = 7.14% || Auto, MG = 8.33% || Pulse = 9.1% || Sidearm = 12.5% || HC, Scout = 16.7%
Sword = 20% | Bow, Glaive, GL, Shotgun, Snipers = 34%

On Super Cast:
Consumes all Feast of Light stacks, restoring HP and increasing Super Damage for 14 seconds.
18.2% | 36.4% | 54.6% | 59.7% | 64.8% | 70% increased Super Damage.
Restores ? | ? | ? | ? | ? | 200 HP.

On Super Cast while at x6 Feast of Light Stacks:
 100HP Overshield for 16 seconds.

Hunter.name: St0mp-EE5
Hunter.description:
30% Damage Resist against Combatants while Airborne.

Increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
Greatly enhances all Jumps.

Hunter.name: Triton Vice
Hunter.description:
On Glaive Melee Kill:
Overflows 1 Ammo to Magazine, up to 100% Increased Magazine Capacity.

While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
+50 Reload Speed and 200% Increased Glaive Melee Damage.
Lingers for 5 seconds.

On Glaive Projectile Kill:
Enemies explode, dealing up to 350 [101] Weapon-Matching Damage in a 4? metre radius.

Hunter.name: Wormhusk Crown
Hunter.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants x2 Cure.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress by scoring multiple Solar Kills within 3 seconds of each: 
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ and Guardians = 50%
Grants a stack of Burning Souls for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

Burning Souls:
15% increased Solar Grenade, Melee, Class, and Super Ability Damage. Works on Prismatic for Solar too!
