x1 = x3 Cure.
x2 = x1 Cure + Restoration x1 for 3+1.5 seconds.
 x3 = x2 Cure + Restoration x1 for 5+2.5 seconds.
If Restoration is active, then it will extend its duration by the corresponding duration.

Hunter.name: Young Ahamkara's Spine
Hunter.description:
Intrinsically grants Fastball to all Grenades, including non-Tripmine Grenades.

Enhanced Tripmine Grenades
14% Increased Explosion Damage. Explosion Length and Width are increased to 14 metres.
 Explosions no longer deal self-damage and have no falloff.
Tripmines now lasts 30 seconds and have 70 HP.

Grenade and Melee Ability Hits grant 30% [7%] Tripmine Grenade Ability Energy.
The first Scorch tick from Grenade/Melee enemy will also trigger the Grenade Ability Gains.
Incurs a 0.3 second cooldown between Grenade Ability Gains.
Crackshot Hits each grant 10% [?%] Tripmine Grenade Ability Energy.

Hunter.name:
Sect of Force

Foebreaker Chant
Hunter.description:
Upon scoring 4 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each:
+30 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and +40? Handling for 10 seconds.

Upon scoring 4 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each on an Elite, Miniboss, or Champion Combatant, or upon stunning a Champion:
Marks the Combatant for 30 seconds. Cannot be refreshed.
Marked Combatants are highlight for the entire team and take 20% more damage from Allies. 
Damage increase stacks with everything.
Allies see Marked Combatant with an X through walls.

When first marking a Combatant, Aeon Allies not on Sect of Force within ? metres are granted 33.33% Fixed Bonus Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 3 seconds.

Titan.name: Abeyant Leap
Titan.description:
Enhances Drengr's Lash.
Suspension inflicted by Drengr's Lash last +3 seconds longer.
Drengr's Lash Suspension on Minibosses last +2 seconds longer

Barricade:
Creates 2 additional Lashes.
Lashes now seek enemies more aggressively and travel 16.7% (5 meters) farther.

Thruster:
Knot lasts up to ? seconds, lobbing itself towards enemies within ? meters, and detonates on contact.

Upon inflicting Suspension:
Grants Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

Titan.name: ACD/0 Feedback Fence
Titan.description:
Melee Hits grant a stack of Armor Charge.

While Armor Charge is active:
Grants Melee Damage Resist against Combatants.
Being struck by a Melee Attack triggers an Arc Burst, consuming all Armor Charges.

Arc Burst inflicts Jolt and deals Arc Damage in a ? radius.

Arc Burst:
90 | 130 | 170 | 200 | 225 | 245 Arc Damage
23.3% | 46.7% | 70% | 73.3% | 76.7% | 80% Melee Damage Resist against Combatants

Titan.name: Actium War Rig
Titan.description:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Auto Rifles and Machine Guns.
Readied Auto Rifles and Machine Guns refill 10% of their Magazine every 1.5 seconds.

On Auto Rifle or Machine Gun Kill:
Grants a stack of Auto-Loading Link for a varying duration, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Loses 1 Auto-Loading Link stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.
Stacks can also be gained by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.

Auto-Loading Link:
Up to 15% increased Damage, +? Stability, and +50 Ammo Generation at 10 stacks.
1.5% | 3% | 4.5% | 6% | 7.5% | 9% | 10.5% | 12% | 13.5% | 15% Increased Damage
+? |  | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? Stability
+5 | +10 | +15 | +20 | +25 | +30 | +35 | +40 | +45 | +50 Ammo Generation.
7s | 6.5s | 6s | 5.5s | 5s | 4.5s | 4s | 3.5s | 3s | 2.5s Stack Duration

Titan.name: An Insurmountable Skullfort
Titan.description:
On Powered Arc Melee Kill:
Grants 100% Melee Ability Energy and begins Health Regeneration.

Melee Hits grant Arc Melee Ability Energy, up to once per melee.
50% Melee Ability Energy on Powered Melee Hit.
15% Melee Ability Energy on Non-Glaive Melee Hit while Knockout is active.
5% Melee Ability Energy on Basic/Glaive Melee Hit.

Titan.name: Antaeus Wards
Titan.description:
During a slide, after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds, while Class Ability Energy is full: 
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects damage and projectiles for 0.45 seconds.
Reflected Projectiles deal 50% increased damage.

Drains 2% Class Ability Energy per 1 damage reflected.

Titan.name: Arbor Warden
Titan.description:
Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to pre-EoF versions, resulting in ~1.45x Class Ability Regeneration Speed.
Towering = 101s -> 70s | Rally = 55s -> 38s

On Class Ability Usage:
Replaces Grenade Ability with Barri-Nade. 
Barri-Nade is lost if Class Ability fully recharges.

Barri-Nade spawns a Barricade on impact. 
Enemies that are within 5 metres of impact are disoriented. 
Barricade does not deal Contact Damage within 2 seconds of it being created.
Barricade Type uses selected Barricade and inherits Aspects such as Bastion and Lash.
Non-Barricades default to Towering Barricade and its respective cooldown.

After picking up 3 [?] Orbs of Power:
Enhances Barri-Nade, creating 3 Barricades in a ◯ formation, spread out 120 degrees.
Rally are placed close together, while Towering are placed spread out.

Titan.name: Armamentarium
Titan.description:
Passively grants a copy of Firepower and an extra Grenade Ability Charge.

Weapon Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy.

On Grenade Ability Usage:
Refills Magazine / Dissipates 100% Heat.

Titan.name: Ashen Wake
Titan.description:
Enhances Fusion Grenades:
Grants Fastball intrinsically.
Grenades detonate on impact
Stuns Unstoppable Champions on hit.

Kills with Fusion Grenades grant Fixed Grenade Ability Energy. 
Rank-and-File = 25% | Elites = 50% | Minibosses and Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 100%

Titan.name: Blastwave Striders
Titan.description:
75% Damage Resist against Explosive Self-Damage.

Kills charge up Blastwave Striders:
Rank-and-File = 10% | Elite+ = 25% | Guardians = 20%
Alethonym's Vestiges = 10% 

Upon either dealing Shiver Strike or Howl of the Storm Damage, or receiving Explosive Self-Damage while at 100% Charge:
Propels the wearer 25 meters backwards, granting x5 Frost Armor.
Releases an expanding Stasis Wave that inflicts Freeze [x? Slow for ? seconds] over 15 meters.
Shoots out 8 Tracking Shrapnel, each dealing 623 [?] Stasis Damage over 8 meters on impact.
Self Damage = Arcing Trajectory | Shiver/Howl Damage = Straight ahead.
Shrapnel kills do not charge up Blastwave Striders.

Explosive Head, Explosive Payload, and Timed Payload can trigger Blastwave Striders despite not dealing self-damage.

Titan.name: Cadmus Ridge Lancecap
Titan.description:
Diamond Lance creates a Stasis Crystal on impact. 
Scoring a hit against a non-Rank-and-File Combatant creates 3 Stasis Crystals.

Diamond Lance damage is increased by Frost Armor stacks.
x1 = 144% | x2 = 253% | x3 = 333% | x4 = 389% | x5 = 428% | x6 = 455% | x7 = 475% Increased Damage.
Diamond Lance Slam first grants Frost Armor before dealing damage, always getting damage buffed.

While a Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Upon scoring 3 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each while behind a Rally Barricade OR
Upon reaching 100% Counter by scoring Stasis Weapon Hits within 3 seconds of each
Stasis Bodyshot = 5% | Stasis Precision Hit = 12% OR 
Upon scoring 2 Stasis Weapon Kill:

Spawns a Diamond Lance beside you.

Incurs a ? [8] second cooldown that is shared with the Diamond Lance Aspect.

Titan.name: Citan's Ramparts
Titan.description:
Modifies Towering Barricade into Assault Barricade.

Assault Barricade enables the user and their allies to shoot through it.

Guardians deal 60% increased damage towards Assault Barricade (312.5 eHP)

Titan.name: Crest of Alpha Lupi
Titan.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Instantly restores Health and Shields to the wielder and allies in Line of Sight within 12 metres, centered on the wielder.
Healing is based on the equipped Class Ability.
Barricade restores 160 Health and 110 Shields. Thruster restores 60 Health.

Healing Allies grants ?% Barricade Energy up to once every 1? second.

Scoring direct hits within 3 seconds of each while behind a Barricade progresses a Counter System that triggers an additional healing pulse that restores 30 HP over 12 meters upon reaching 100%.
SMG, Trace = 7.14% || Auto, MG = 8.33% || Pulse = 9.1% || Sidearm = 12.5% || HC, Scout = 16.7%
Sword = 20% | Bow, Glaive, GL, Shotgun, Snipers = 34%
Incurs a 2 second cooldown upon triggering before additional hits count.

Incurs a 5 second cooldown upon triggering a healing pulse before other pulses will restore health again.
Yes, it is desynced from the hit counter cooldown. Why? Dunno

Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power that grants 7.14% Super Energy.
Ward of Dawn generates a total of 4 Orbs, each granting 3.57% Super Energy, for a total of 14.3% Super Energy.

Titan.name: Cuirass of the Falling Star
Titan.description:
Thundercrash deals 55% increased damage.

On Thundercrash Deactivation:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 5 seconds.

On Melee Kill, while Amplified:
Grants additional Super Energy based on the Enemy Tier.
Tier 1 Combatant = 2.5?% | T2 = 2.5% | T3 = ?% | T4 = 3% | Guardian = ?%
Works with any Super Ability.

Titan.name: Doom Fang Pauldron
Titan.description:
Scoring 2–3 Void Kills within 10 seconds of each grants a stack of Void Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds, up to a maximum of x4 Void Weapon Surge.
Additional Void Kills while at x4 Weapon Surge refresh the buff duration.

On Powered Void Melee Kill:
Grants 20% [10%] Super Energy. Can only trigger once per Melee Activation.
Grants x4 Void Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds.

Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw Hits grant 10% Super Energy, extending Super Duration.
Sentinel Shield Light Attack Kills grant 100% Shield Throw Energy.

Titan.name: Dunemarchers
Titan.description:
Increases Sprint Speed from 8m/s to 8.5m/s.
Increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.

After sprinting for 1.5 seconds:
Grants Linear Actuators for 7 seconds.

On Direct Melee Hit while Linear Actuations is active:
Consumes Linear Actuations to inflict Shocked for 2 seconds.
Shocked Enemies release a Static Charge to non-Shocked Enemies within 12 meters.
Static Charge deals 220 [50] damage and inflicts Shocked.
Shocked refreshes when spreading to other enemies up to 6 times per Linear Actuations trigger.
Grants x2 Bolt Charge per Shocked inflicted.
Guardians are immune to additional chain damage for 2 seconds while Shocked.

Titan.name: Eternal Warrior
Titan.description:
Scoring 2–3 Arc Kills within 10 seconds of each grants a stack of Arc Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds, up to a maximum of x4 Arc Weapon Surge.
Additional Arc Kills while at x4 Weapon Surge refresh the buff duration.

On Fists of Havoc Cast: 
Grants a 75 HP Overshield that negates Precision Damage.
Regenerates over 7 second after 5 seconds of not receiving damage if Overshield is active.

Fists of Havoc Kills grant ?% Super Ability Energy.

On Fists of Havoc End:
Grants x4 Arc Weapon Surge for 30 [6] seconds.

Titan.name: Hallowfire Heart
Titan.description:
While a Solar Super Ability is equipped and charged:
Ability Kills grant x2 Cure and grant stacks of Sunfire Furnace, up to 10 stacks for 20 seconds.
Rank-and-File = 1 Stack | Elite = 2 | 
Unpowered Melee Kills also grant Cure and stacks. Glaive Melees do not.

Sunfire Furnace:
Grenade and Shieldburst Barricade Kills trigger ignitions. Grenade Element doesn't matter.
Up to 250% Additional Base Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
6.5% | 13.6% | 22% | 32% | 43% | 57% | 73% | 93% | 118% | 150% Increased Super Damage.
?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | 250% Additional Base Grenade/Class Regeneration Rate.

On Super Cast | Sunfire Furnace stacks are frozen. Cannot gain nor lose stacks.
On Super End | Consumes all Sunfire stacks to refunds Super Energy based on the stack amount.
x1 = 8% | x2 = 20% | x3 = 26% | x4 = 33% | x5 = 45%.

Titan.name: Hazardous Propulsion
Titan.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill, 4 Weapon Kills, or filling up a counter through Precision Hits grants a stack of Exodus Rocket, up to a maximum 6 Exodus Rocket stacks. 

Precision Hit Counter:
Trace Rifles, and Vex Mythoclast: 10%
Auto Rifle and Machine Gun: 15%
Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, and Crimson: 20%
Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles, and Shotguns: 40%
Bows, Linear Fusion Rifles, Rocket Sidearms, and Sniper Rifles: 67%
Precision Counter doesn't reset upon loading a rocket, leading to alternating shots in some cases.  (3 -> 2 -> 3 HC shots, for example)

On Barricade Placement or Thruster Usage:
Consumes all stacks, firing a homing Kinetic Micro-Missile per stack, each dealing up to 540 [28] Kinetic Damage over ? meters and granting a stack of Exodus Rocket for 10 seconds per hit scored.

Exodus Rocket grant increased Rocket and Micromissile Weapon Damage, up to 35% at x6 stacks.
x1 = 10% | x2 = 17% | x3 = 24% | x4 = 30% | x5 = 33% | x6 = 35%

Titan.name: Heart of Inmost Light
Titan.description:
On Grenade or Class Ability Usage, or upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants a stack of Empowered Abilities for the other two abilities for 5 seconds, up to 2 stacks. 
Super Ability Cast removes all stacks.
e.g.: Dealing Thunderclap damage -> Increased Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration.

x1 = 400% [100%] | x2 = 800% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate. 
x1 = 25% | x2 = 50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
x1 = 20% [10%] | x2 = 35% [20%] Increased Grenade Damage.
x1 = 25% | x2 = 50% Increased Melee Damage.

Buff display is NOT accurate to the active ability regen. 
With the example in mind, Class Ability Usage before Empowered x1 from Melee runs out will do the following:
Grenade Empower will go to x2 and will have its duration refreshed. Melee will receive Empower x1 for 5 seconds, and Class Empower x1 won't be refreshed, despite the UI saying Empowered x2.

Titan.name: Helm of Saint-14
Titan.description:
Weapons of Light from Ward of Dawn can now persist outside of the bubble for 15 seconds.

All of the following only applies while Weapons of Light is active:
Dealing an average of 600 of damage and scoring kills grant stacks of The Saint, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.
Damage = 1 stack | Rank-and-File = 1 stack | Elite = 2 | Miniboss+ = 3 | Guardians = 3
The Saint's buff duration is equal to the remaining duration of the current Ward of Dawn.
Damage requirement IGNORES Power-Delta (Requires the same "hits" regardless of difficulty)
The minimum damage needed x hits for a "The Saint" Stack is based on thresholds:
>2,445 x 2 | >767 x 3 | >135 x 4 | >109 x 5 | >108 x 6 | >89 x 7 | >77 x 8 and so on, averaging 600 damage per stack

Upon fulfilling the same conditions as gaining a stack of The Saint through scoring Kinetic or Void Damage/Kills:
Inflicts Suppression for 6 [?] seconds in a 7 meter radius around the target.

Picking up a Ward of Dawn Core consumes all stacks of The Saint. up to twice per Super Cast to its maximum on-cast duration.
Super Duration is initially extended by (The Saint Stacks + 1) seconds, up to +20 seconds at 14 stacks.
Extending it a second time reduces the gains to 1 second per stack, up to +10 seconds at 10 stacks.

Titan.name: Hoarfrost-Z
Titan.description:
While a Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Class Abilities now spawn Stasis Crystals.

Rally and Towering Barricades are replaced by Glacial Fortification.
Glacial Fortification is composed of 4 medium crystals, and a small crystal in the middle.
Glacial Fortification Inherits Rally Barricade Bonuses, even if no crystals remain.
Overrides Barricade Cooldown with Towering Barricade's.

On Thruster Usage:
Spawns 2 Stasis Crystals in a V formation ahead of the user.
Does not receive Rally Barricade bonuses, nor does it override the cooldown.

Titan.name: Icefall Mantle
Titan.description:
While a Stasis Super Ability is equipped:

Restores 10 HP per stack of Frost Armor gained.
Scoring 2 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a stack of Frost Armor. 

Replaces Barricade Class Abilities with Glacial Guard. 
Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to 70 seconds.

On Glacial Guard Cast:
Grants maximum Frost Armor stacks to the user.
Inflicts x100 [x40] Slow to enemies within ? meters.

Titan.name: Khepri's Horn
Titan.description:
Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy.
Incurs a 1? second cooldown between Solar Kills granting Class Ability Energy.

On Barricade Placement, while a Solar Super Ability is equipped:
Unleashes 3 Tracking Solar Wave up to 18.5 metres away.

Solar Waves:
Each deals 480 [100] damage and inflicts x60+30 [x30+15] Scorch. Damage cannot overlap.
Solar Waves spawn a Sunspot under the enemies on hit [kill].
Solar Wave do not benefit from, nor trigger Roaring Flames.

Solar Effects triggered by Khepri's Solar Waves lose their 3x PVE bonus.
This means Ignitions deal 66.7% decreased damage.
Also, due to some wonkiness regarding Sunspot scorch, it takes ~5.3 seconds to ignite without Ashes, and ~1 second with Ashes.

Titan.name: Lion Rampant
Titan.description:
Enables hipfiring and ADS while in Lift, and passively grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness.

Increases Lift Duration to 4 seconds.

Lift Duration in seconds:
High Lift: 2.6 -> 4 (54% increase)
Strafe Lift: 2.2 -> 4 (82% increase)
Catapult Lift: 1 -> 4 (300% increase)

For Primary Weapons while hipfiring:
+5 Range, +30 Stability,
-30% Accuracy Cone Size, +2?° Precision Angle Threshold,
20% Increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance.
 DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook do not receive the Falloff bonuses, and receive uniquely tweaked Accuracy values.

Titan.name: Loreley Splendor
Titan.description:
While a Solar Super Ability is equipped:

Upon either reaching Critical Health if Class Ability is charged or on Class Ability Usage while Rally or Towering Barricade is equipped:
Spawns a Sunspot under the user. 
Consumes a Class Ability Charge if it's triggered by Critical Health.
The Sunspot spawned grants Sol Invictus even without the Aspect equipped. 
However, the Sunspot duration cannot be extended without it.

Titan.name: Mask of the Quiet One
Titan.description:
Upon receiving damage from an enemy:
Grants 5% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between activations.

While a Void Super Ability is equipped:
Upon scoring 3 kills within 5 seconds of each, or a kill while at Critical Health:
Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.

Titan.name: Melas Panoplia
Titan.description:
Upon collecting a Firesprite, or scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3 seconds of each:
Grants Forge Master for 12 seconds. Buff timer begins ticking once a Throwing Hammer is used.

Initially activating Forge Master grants 11.7% Fixed Melee Energy for 8 seconds.

While Forge Master is active:
Allows recalling the Throwing Hammer by pressing [Melee], fully refunding it.
Throwing Hammer tracking is improved.

Recalling after 2? seconds of scoring a Throwing Hammer hit performs a Perfect Recall.
Perfect Recall triggers an explosion that deals up to 290 [?] Damage over ~5 meters.

Performing Perfect Recalls and picking up additional Firesprites extends the buff duration by 3 seconds, up to 12 seconds.

Titan.name: Mk. 44 Stand Asides
Titan.description:
While Juggernaut's Shield is active:
Grants a stack of Bolt Charge every 1.5 seconds.

While Speed Booster is active:
Creates an area behind the user that grants allies Speed Booster.

Titan.name: No Backup Plans
Titan.description:
Passively grants +? Reload Speed and +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress by scoring multiple Shotgun or Melee Kills: 
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ and Guardians = 50%
 Begins Health Regeneration.

While Amplified, Restoration, Void Overshield, Frost Armor, or Woven Mail is active:
35% [10%] increased Shotgun damage.
+30% [+?%] Increased Melee Damage.
Shotgun and Melee Kills extend the buff duration effect by 5 seconds, up to their usual maximum.
Void Overshield also receives +15 HP if active.
Increases Super Melee Damage by 30% as well, additive to Shieldcrush's +50%. 
Includes: Fist of Havoc Light Attack | Hammer of Sol Shrapnel | Sentinel Shield Light Attack
Glacial Quake Light Attacks + Howl during Glacial Quake

Titan.name: One-Eyed Mask
Titan.description:
Upon receiving damage:
Highlights the first enemy that dealt damage for 8 seconds.
Only one enemy can be highlight at once.

Killing the highlighted enemy grants Vengeance, which is a 95 HP Overshield, for 6 seconds.
Enemies cannot be highlighted while Vengeance is active.

Titan.name: The Path of Burning Steps
Titan.description:
Roaring Flame stacks grant increased Solar Weapon and Ignition Damage.
Roaring Flame x1 | 6% Increased Weapon Damage and 15% Increased Ignition Damage.
Roaring Flame x2 | 9.2% Increased Weapon Damage and 20% Increased Ignition Damage.
Roaring Flame x3 | 12.4% Increased Weapon Damage and 24.9% Increased Ignition Damage.

Halves Slow Stacks received (rounded up) and they last half as long. 
Freeze, and Suspend debuffs last half as long.
Stasis Breakout deals no self-damage.
Breaking out of Freeze or Suspend triggers a Solar Blast that deals up to 105 Solar Damage in a 9 metre radius

Titan.name: Peacekeepers
Titan.description:
Passively grants +40 Airborne Effectiveness to Submachine Guns.
Stowed Submachine Guns are refilled after 1.25 seconds.

While a Submachine Gun is readied:
+25 Mobility
+50 Handling with a 0.8?x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier
33% Decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Increases Sprint Speed from 8m/s to 8.5m/s.
Increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.

Upon scoring a Submachine Gun Hit against a Combatant:
Grants a stack of Damage Buff for 1 second, up to a maximum of 20 stacks.
Damage Buff grants 5% increased Submachine Gun Impact Damage against Combatants per stack.
Additional Submachine Gun Hits refresh the Damage Buff duration.
Bosses take 33% decreased damage from Peacekeepers buffed shots.

Titan.name: Peregrine Greaves
Titan.description:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness.

After sprinting for 2 seconds, and after being airborne for 0.5 seconds:
Grants Peregrine Strike until the floor is touched. 

Peregrine Strike:
Shoulder Charge Abilities deal 250% increased impact damage.
Champions, Tormentors, and Minibosses instead take 550% Increased Impact Damage and grant 100% Fixed Melee Ability Energy on hit.
Shoulder Charge includes Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, and Shield Bash.

Frozen enemies will not take increased Melee Damage from Peregrine Strike.

Titan.name: Phoenix Cradle
Titan.description:
Sunspots can affect allies and be extended by dealing sustained Solar Weapon Damage. 
Seems to not work properly without the Aspect, and only getting a maximum of 2 second extension?
Phoenix Cradle Sunspots have a white ring around them.

While the Sol Invictus Aspect is equipped:
Sol Invictus from Sunspots lasts twice as long (5 -> 10 seconds).

Upon granting 3–5 Solar Buffs to allies:
Spawns a Sunspot under the user.
Simultaneous Solar Buffs (such as throwing a Healing Grenade at 2 allies) will count as multiple Solar Buff applications.

Titan.name: Point-Contact Cannon Brace
Titan.description:
Thunderclap and Lightning Strike Kills refund up to 50% Melee Ability Energy.
On Thunderclap Usage: Refunds an additional FPS-based Melee Ability Energy.
FPS Scaling: 30FPS = 10% Melee | 60 = 18% | 120 = 32% | 144 = 41% | 300 = ~77%

On Thunderclap Activation and Discharge:
Strikes enemies within 15 metres with lightning, dealing 181 [50] Arc Damage and inflicting Jolt.
Also instantly triggers Jolt Chain Damage.
Lightning Damage is increased by 100% (360 [100?]) while Amplified.

Lightning Damage can be increased by up to 200% by fully charging Thunderclap. 
Stacks multiplicatively with the Amplified bonus, totalling 1080 [?] lightning damage.

A single fully charged Thunderclap deals 2365 damage.
While Amplified, this goes up to 3085 damage per usage.

Titan.name: Praxic Vestment
Titan.description:
Jetpack Fuel: Passively charges 3.5%/s Jetpack Fuel.
Weapon Kills grant 20% Jetpack Fuel. 
Arc Powered Melee Kills grant 50% Jetpack Fuel.
Use [Air Move] while Airborne to activate Jetpack once it is charged.
Jetpack Fuel is always emptied after usage.

On Jetpack Activation | Deals up to 168 [69] Arc Damage over 6 meters and inflicts exhaust.
Jetpack Duration varies depending on whether Air Move is tapped or held.
[Air Move Tap] travels 30 meters over 1.5 seconds.
[Air Move Hold] travels 50 meters over 3 seconds.
Exhaust reduces Combatant Damage Output by 25%

Colliding with an enemy while flying triggers a Praxic Knee that deals 1509 [?] Arc Damage, blinds over ? meters, and grants +40 Melee Stat for 7 seconds.
Praxic Knee benefits from Melee Damage Buffs.

Titan.name: Precious Scars
Titan.description:
Upon reviving an ally, or being revived: 
Projects a 15 meter field for 10 seconds that grants Wearer and Allies Shielded.
Allies that leave the radius temporarily lose Shielded.

Shielded:
Overshield with 100 HP. 
Regenerates over 1 second after 2 seconds of not receiving damage if Shielded is active.
Shielded is removed and cannot be regained if Overshield gets destroyed.
Shielded is removed from Allies if wearer's Overshield is destroyed.

Upon scoring a Super-Matching Weapon Kill:
Grants x1 Restoration for 3+1.5 seconds to the wearer and allies within 15 metres.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown between activations, displayed with the "Healing" buff.

Titan.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
Titan.description:
Modifies Burning Maul into a single-use slam that deals 650% increased damage, releases 3 tracking waves, but no longer counts as a Roaming Super for Super Ability Generation. 

Waves inflict x20+40 Scorch and create a Cyclone on impact. 

Burning Maul's Cyclones deal 19 [16] damage every 0.2 seconds, inflict x?+? Scorch every 0.56 seconds for 7.5 seconds, and track enemies.
Damage from multiple Cyclones can now overlap. 

Consecration's second slam's middle wave creates a Cyclone, which deals 7 [3] damage every 0.2 seconds, and inflicts x3+2 Scorch every 0.56 seconds.

Titan.name: Second Chance
Titan.description:
Grants an additional Shield Throw Melee Ability Charge.
Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw inflicts Weaken for 10 seconds.
 
Enhanced Shield Throw:
 Becomes Shield-Piercing and inflicts weakens for 10 seconds on hit. 
 Stunning a Barrier Champion grants a Melee Ability Charge. 
Shield Throw Kills spawn a Void Breach without cooldown.

On Void Breach Pickup:
Grants 11.25% Shield Throw Ability Energy.

Titan.name: Severance Enclosure
Titan.description:
On Powered Melee Kill or Finisher:
Enemy triggers a Kinetic Explosion, dealing variable damage in a wide radius with falloff, knocking enemies upwards, and disorienting them.
Falloff decreases damage by up to 20%.
Explosion Damage and Radius scale on Enemy Rank (Finisher). 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between non-chaining explosions. 

Severance Explosion Damage | Radius
Rank-and-File: 439 (598) Kinetic Damage over 15 meters.
Elite: 598 (717) Kinetic Damage over 20 meters
Miniboss+: 717 Kinetic Damage over 20 meters.

Severance Explosions triggered by Powered Melee Kills can chain, triggering a weaker explosion that only deals up to 242 [?] damage in a 8 meter radius. 
Chaining Explosions do not have a cooldown but cannot simultaneously trigger multiple of them.

Titan.name: Stronghold
Titan.description:
Passively grants +100 Guard Resistance and +100 Guard Endurance. 

While Blocking:
50% [10%] Damage Resistance.
Blocking a hit grants x2 Perfect Guard, up to x100.
Having any Restoration effect disables stack accumulation. 
Not blocking any hits for 10 seconds removes all Perfect Guard Stacks.

Upon dealing Sword damage while having Perfect Guard Stacks:
Grants Restoration x2 for a varying amount of time.
Restoration x2 lasts 4 [3] seconds at x1, increasing up to 16+8 [6+3] seconds at x100.

Stronghold Guarding:
Sword Block now grants ?% [68%] Damage Resist.
Sword Energy does not decay from blocking damage or holding guard on Heavy Ammo Swords.

Titan.name: Synthoceps
Titan.description:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies: 
Grants Biotic Enhancements.
Buff lingers for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements:
50% Increased Super Damage.
165% [100%] Increased Melee Damage.
+35? Handling and +35 Reload Speed.

Titan.name: Ursa Furiosa
Titan.description:
While guarding with Unbreakable or Sentinel Shield:
15% Increased Movement Speed.

Converts guarded damage into Super Energy after Super ends, up to 50% Super Ability Energy.

Unbreakable grants up to 60% Grenade Ability Energy once it ends.
Scales from 15% Grenade Energy, up to 60% Grenade Energy after maxing out Unbreakable.

Titan.name: Wishful Ignorance
Titan.description:
Grants an additional Frenzied Blade Melee Ability Charge.

Upon scoring a Frenzied Blade or Flechette Storm hit:
Grants a stack of Wish-Dragon's Talons for 2.75 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
Can only grant 1 stack per Ability Usage.

Wish-Dragon's Talons:
25% | 60% | 120% Increased Flechette Storm and Frenzied Blade damage.

Banner of War's Pulses grant 5% Frenzied Blade Melee Ability Energy per ally within 10 meters.
Wearer counts as an ally.

Titan.name: Wormgod Caress
Titan.description:
On Melee, Glaive Melee, or Finisher Kill:
Grants a stack of Burning Fists, up to 5 stacks, increasing Melee and Weapon Damage per stack.
Loses 1 Burning Fists stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.
Burning Fist stack timer begins decaying after 2 seconds of gaining a stack.
 
Burning Fists:
x1 = 80% increased Melee Damage for 9.5 seconds.
x2 = 160% Melee Damage, and 20% Increased Weapon Damage for 10 seconds.
x3 = 240% Melee Damage, and 25% [20%] Weapon Damage for 4 seconds.
x4 = 320% Melee Damage, and 30% [25%] Weapon Damage for 4 seconds.
x5 = 400% Melee Damage, and 35% [25%] Weapon Damage for 3 seconds.

Titan.name:
Sect of Insight

Armsbearer Chant
Titan.description:
Upon scoring 2 Precision Multikills:
Creates an Orb of Power that grants 3.57% Super Energy for allies.

Upon finishing an Elite Combatant:
Spawns a Special Ammo Brick for Allies within ? meters.

Upon finishing a Miniboss, Champion, or Boss Combatant:
Spawns a Power Ammo Brick for Allies within ? meters.

Aeon Ammo Bricks grant 60% of a Regular Ammo Brick's Pickup Amount, with full variability.

Upon finishing an Elite, Miniboss, Champion, or Boss Combatant: 
Aeon Allies that are not using Sect of Insight are granted ?% Super Energy.

Warlock.name: Apotheosis Veil
Warlock.description:
On Super Cast, for the Caster and Allies within ? meters.
Fully restores Health, Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.

On Super End:
Grants 66% Fixed Bonus Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.

Warlock.name: Astrocyte Verse
Warlock.description:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness and enhances Blink.

While Blink is equipped, either on Void or Prismatic Subclasses:
Grants a free horizontal Dark Blink usage with [Air Move] every 6 [8] seconds.
Dark Blink releases 4 [2] Seekers that are functionally identical to Nova Warp's and scale with Super Damage.

25% Increased Blink Distance.
20% Decreased Cooldown for Blink Charges. (3.55 -> 2.85 seconds for both charges)
Time between blinks is decreased by 30% (1.65 -> 1.15 seconds)  

On Blink/Dark Blink Activation:
Inflicts Volatile to enemies within 10 metres.
Grants Volatile Rounds for 9 [5] seconds.
+100 Handling for 2 seconds. Stowing cancels the effect.
Radar remains active.

During Nova Warp Super:
Dark Blink does not consume Super Energy.

Warlock.name: Ballidorse Wrathweavers
Warlock.description:
Enemies frozen by Winter's Wrath receive 150% increased Shatter Damage.
3453 + 360 (3813) -> 4144 + 1081 (5225) vs Elites | 2302 + 360 (2662) -> 2302 + 901 (3203) vs Bosses

Upon performing Winter's Wrath's Shatter Attack:
Allies within 30? meters receive x4 Stasis Weapon Surge for 15 [6] seconds and maximum Frost Armor stacks. 
Refunds ?% Super Energy per Ally buffed. 
 Buff is refreshable. Refund only works once per ally?.

On Rift Cast while the Frostpulse Aspect is equipped:
User and Allies within ? meters receive x2 Stasis Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds and maximum Frost Armor.
Grants 2% Super Energy per ally that receives Frost Armor through Frostpulse.

On Winter's Wrath End:
Grants maximum Frost Armor stacks to the user.

Warlock.name: Boots of the Assembler
Warlock.description:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina. Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to Lumina.

While standing in a Rift or Well of Radiance:
Spawns Noble Seekers at an average rate of 1 per Fireteam-member every 8 seconds.

Noble Seekers:
Track allies within 40 metres and bestow a buff on close proximity.
Prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8s and won't target an ally more than once every 4s.
 
Healing Rift | Seekers restore 70 Health, 60 Shield, and begin Health Regeneration.
Empowering Rift | Seekers grant 35% [15%] increased damage and +100 Class for 5 seconds.
Well of Radiance Seekers grant both effects.

Grants Fireteam-Based Class Ability Energy upon buffing an ally with a Seeker.
2 Allies = ?% Class Ability Energy | 3 = 25?% | 4 = ?% | 5 = ?%

Warlock.name: Briarbinds
Warlock.description:
Void Souls last 55% longer, deal up to 30% increased damage after 10 seconds, and can be retrieved by interacting with them.
Grants Void Soul Ready for 25 seconds after interaction, allowing redeployment.

On Void Soul Kill:
Grants increased Void Soul damage and Damage Resist. 
Bonuses can be maintained by redeploying.

Void Soul Benefits:
25% | 50% | 75% | 100% increased damage.
12.5% | 25% | 37.5% | 50% Damage Resist.

Warlock.name: Cenotaph Mask
Warlock.description:
Trace Rifles refill 4% of their Magazine every 0.7 seconds. 
Works while stowed.

Upon scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits within ? seconds of each on a Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle:
Combatant is marked for 10 seconds.
Additional Trace Rifle Hits refresh the duration of the mark.

On Marked Enemy Death by Ally:
Generates Heavy Ammo for allies.
Generates Special Ammo for wearer.
Cenotaph Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Warlock.name: Chromatic Fire
Warlock.description:
On Kinetic Weapon Kill: 
Enemy explodes in a Super-Matching Explosion that inflicts an Elemental-Matching Debuff.
Grants a stack of Crystalline Transistor for 11 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 stacks.
Loses 1 Crystalline Transistor stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.

Elemental Explosion:
Deals up to 252 [100] Elemental Damage and inflicts an Elemental Debuff based on the equipped Super.
Radius is based on the amount of Crystalline Transistor stacks.
Base = 4 meters | x1 = 6 meters | x2 OR Kinetic Precision Kill = 8 meters. 
Arc: Blind for ? [1] seconds.
Solar: x15+5 Scorch.
Void: Weaken for 4 seconds.
Stasis: x30 Slow for 7+1 seconds.
Strand: Sever for 6+2 seconds.

Warlock.name: Claws of Ahamkara
Warlock.description:
Grants an extra Melee Ability Charge.

Passively grants a copy of Heavy Handed.

Warlock.name: Contraverse Hold
Warlock.description:
Overcharged Grenades inflict Weaken for 6? [2.5?] seconds.

While overcharging a Void Grenade with Chaos Accelerant:
Grants 20% Damage Resist.

Upon dealing Overcharged Void Grenade Damage:
Triggers Chaotic Exchange for 1.75 seconds.
Chaotic Exchange grants Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate.
Axion: 5000% [4000%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate.
Scatter: 3700% [2700%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate.
Vortex: 3400% [2400%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate.
HHSN: 2500%? [2000%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown between activations which is removed on Grenade Usage.

Warlock.name: Crown of Tempests
Warlock.description:
While at least 1 Arc Ability is equipped:

Upon scoring an Arc Ability Kill or a Jolt Kill:
 Grants a stack of Conduction Tines for 10 [4] seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
 All stacks disappear simultaneously. Very short cooldown between gaining stacks.

Conduction Tines:
168% | 335% | 503% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Super Regeneration Rate.
22% | 44% | 65% Decreased Stormtrance Passive Super Drain.
Ionic Sentry Placement triggers a Storm Grenade on its position.

Warlock.name: Dawn Chorus
Warlock.description:
Daybreak Projectiles trigger an Ignition on hit.

Scorch ticks grant 5?% Melee Ability Energy per tick. 

Ignitions deal 100% increased damage. 
Each enemy damaged by an ignition grants 40% Melee Ability Energy.
Solar Fulmination (Hunter's Journal) doubles the Melee Ability Gained and has its damage doubled.

Warlock.name: Deimosuffusion
Warlock.description:
While a Strand Super Ability is equipped:

Casting a Rift suspends combatants within 6 meters.

Suspension inflicted by the user is enhanced.
Killing Suspended Enemies restores 15 Health.

Malevolent Grasp:
Suspended Enemies are dealt increasingly higher Kinetic Damage every 0.467 [0.3] seconds.
Restores 5 HP every time a Suspended Enemy takes damage from Enhanced Suspension DoT.
Damage begins at 23 [9], increasing by ~5.5% [?%] per tick on average. Longer Suspend = Bigger Damage
Suspended Enemies are dealt 64 [34?] Damage once Suspension expires.
Deals a total of ~380 Kinetic Damage on an Elite Combatant. Thread of Continuity increases it to ~550.

Malevolent Grasp inflicted through Rift Cast deals 112.5% increased damage. Numbers above do NOT include this.

Warlock.name: Eunoia
Warlock.description:
Hellion Projectiles deal 20% increased damage after travelling 17 meters.

Hellion Projectiles that have been in the air for 1 second release 4 pieces of Shrapnel.
Shrapnel deals 18 [?] Solar Damage and inflicts x5+0 Scorch.
Shrapnel projectiles have tracking.

Warlock.name: Eye of Another World
Warlock.description:
Passively grants 45% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Regeneration Rate, and +15 Airborne Effectiveness.

Highlights enemies below 50% HP enemies in a red outline.
Highlights Enemy Guardians with Fully-charged Supers in a yellow outline.
Invisible enemies that are below 50% HP or have a fully-charged Super will also be highlighted.

Warlock.name: Fallen Sunstar
Warlock.description:
Ionic Traces move 66% faster and grant increased Ability Energy.

Total Ability Energy Gained per Ionic Trace:
Grenade: 25% | Melee: 25% | Class Ability: 30%

On Ionic Trace Pickup:
Allies within 15 metres receive 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.

Warlock.name: Felwinter's Helm
Warlock.description:
Powered Melee Damage inflicts regular weaken for 6 seconds.
 Does not work with Grapple Melee nor Song of Flame.

On Powered Melee Kill or Finisher:
Enemy triggers a Highly Weakening Burst centered on the Enemy Death Location, disorienting and increasing damage by 30% for a variable duration.
Weakening Burst Duration and Range are dependent on Enemy Rank (Finisher).
Screen becomes blackened for 7.5 seconds, progressively getting clearer as the debuff reaches its 15 second duration. HUD does not disappear.

Warlord's End.
Rank-and-File: Debuffs in a 15 (20) meter radius for 10 (15) seconds.
Elite: Debuffs in a 20 (25) meter radius for 15 (20) seconds.
Miniboss+: Debuffs in a 25 (25) meter radius for 20 (20) seconds.

Warlock.name: Geomag Stabilizers
Warlock.description:
After sprinting for 1.5 seconds and maintaining the sprint, while having at least x5 Bolt Charge:
Grants a stack of Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.

On Ionic Trace Pickup:
+4% Chaos Reach Super Ability Energy.

Chaos Reach grants 10% Super Ability Energy on hit.
Incurs a 0.75 seconds cooldown between activation. 
 Chaos Reach's Total Damage is increased by up to 120%

Warlock.name: Getaway Artist
Warlock.description:
Arc Soul Hits grant 5% Grenade Energy up to once per burst.
Does not grant Grenade Energy on hit while Devour is active.

While an Arc Grenade Ability is equipped:
Holding [Grenade] summons an Arc Soul for 20 seconds and grants Amplified.
Arc Soul Rifts refresh Arc Soul duration to 20 seconds instead of 15 seconds while active.

Warlock.name: Karnstein Armlets
Warlock.description:
On Melee Kill:
x3 Cure and Restoration x1 for 8+4 seconds.

On Finisher:
x3 Cure and Restoration x2 for 8+4 seconds.

Warlock.name: Lunafaction Boots
Warlock.description:
For wearer and allies standing on Rifts and Well of Radiances cast by the wearer:
+100 Reload Speed and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.
Empowering Rifts and Well of Radiances grant 100% [50%] Increased Damage Falloff Distance.
Effect persists even after swapping off of the Exotic.

For Primary Weapons while hipfiring:
+5 Range, +30 Stability,
-30% Accuracy Cone Size, +2?° Precision Angle Threshold,
20% Increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance.
 DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook do not receive the Falloff bonuses, and receive uniquely tweaked Accuracy values.

Warlock.name: Mataiodoxía
Warlock.description:
Arcane Needles become Shield-Piercing. 
Scoring an Arcane Needle hit on an enemy applies a ♢mark for 10 seconds.

Grants Melee Ability Energy upon scoring an Arcane Needle Kill or Suspended Enemy Kill.
T1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 22.2% | T3 = 33% | T4 = 100% | Guardian = 33%

On Marked Enemy Death:
Target triggers a Suspending Burst.
Deals 269 [40] Strand Melee Ability Damage and inflicts Suspension to enemies within 6 meters.

Upon scoring 2 Arcane Needle hits on a Marked Enemy:
Target triggers a stronger Suspending Explosion. 
Deals 538 [?] Strand Melee Ability Damage and inflicts Suspension to enemies within 10 meters.

Upon scoring 5 Needlestorm Hits against a single enemy:
Target triggers a larger and more damaging Suspending Explosion.
Deals 5,040 [?] Strand Super Ability Damage and inflicts Suspension to enemies within 10 meters.

Warlock.name: Mantle of Battle Harmony
Warlock.description:
Upon scoring a Super-Element Matching Weapon Kill or 5 Super-Element Matching Weapon Damage Instances within 3 seconds of each, up to once per second:
Triggers Energy Siphon, granting additional Super Energy up to once every ? seconds.
Energy Siphon grants x4 Super-Matching Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds if Super Ability is charged.
Energy Siphon will, at times, fail to trigger on Solar Supers if they're charged.

By Kills: Tier 1 Combatant = 1.5% | T2 = 2% | T3 = ?% | T4 = 2.5% | Guardian = 2.5?%
By Damage: ?% Super Ability Energy

On Super Ability End:
x4 Arc, Solar, Void, Stasis, and Strand Weapon Surge for 10 seconds.
Grants Harmonic Munitions for 15 seconds.

Harmonic Munitions:
Dealing Super-Matching Weapon Damage triggers a Super-Matching Explosion on the target.
Detonation deals up to 180 [?] Damage over 6 meters, down to a minimum of 50% damage.
Can only trigger up to one detonation per second. Harmonic Munition Kills trigger Energy Siphon.

Warlock.name: Necrotic Grip
Warlock.description:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow.

Melee Hits inflict Potent Corruption.
Corrupted enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 metre radius.

Potent Corrupted Damage ticks every 0.52 [0.7] seconds up to 19 [?] times over 10 [?] seconds, dealing 32 [5?] Kinetic Damage every tick, totalling 1366 [?] damage over its duration.

Potent Corruption Damage deals more damage every tick, increasing by 11% per tick for the first 14 ticks, then increasing by an average of 41% per tick for the last 5 ticks.
Reapplying Potent Corruption will reset the ramping damage.

Warlock.name: Nezarec's Sin
Warlock.description:
Void Damage Kills grant Abyssal Extractors for 2.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 20 seconds.
Soul Siphon Kills and Suppressed Enemy Kills with Void Damage extend Abyssal Extractors duration by +1.5 seconds.

Soul Siphon hits inflict Suppression for 10 [5] seconds. 

While Abyssal Extractor is active:
300% Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate.
200% Additional Base Class and Super Regeneration Rate.

Warlock.name: Nothing Manacles
Warlock.description:
Grants an extra Scatter Grenade Ability Charge.

Scatter Grenades Submunitions receive drastically improved tracking and speed.

Scatter Grenade Kills spawn 3 additional Scatter Submunitions.
Additional Scatter Submunitions cannot trigger more explosions.

Warlock.name: Ophidian Aspect
Warlock.description: Passively grants +35 Handling, +35 Reload Speed, and +10 Airborne Effectiveness.

Warlock.name: Osmiomancy Gloves
Warlock.description:
Grants an extra Coldsnap Grenade Ability Charge.

Enhanced Coldsnap Grenades:
Stronger tracking.
Travel 17.5% further and faster.
Grant Grenade Ability Energy upon dealing damage. 

Coldsnap Grenade Ability Energy:
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 22% | T3 = 34% | T4 = 50% | Guardian = 7%

Warlock.name: Phoenix Protocol
Warlock.description:
While inside your Well of Radiance, while under 50% Super Energy, and if your Super Ability is Well of Radiance: 
Grants 10% Super Energy per kill. 

Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per kill.

10% -> 8.5% -> 7% -> 5% -> 4.5% -> 4% -> 4%...

Warlock.name: Promethium Spurs
Warlock.description:
While a Solar Super Ability is equipped:

Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy, based on the Enemy Rank.
Tier 1 Combatant = 18% | T2 = 26% | T3 = 40% | T4 = 60% | Miniboss = 80% | Boss = 100% 
Guardians = 30%

Upon scoring a Weapon Kills while in Rift:
Healing Rift | Grants Radiant for 6.5 seconds to the user and allies within 10 meters.
Empowering Rift | Grants Cure x1 to the user and allies within 10 meters.

Well of Radiance and Daybreak Kills grant Radiant and Cure x2 to the user and allies within 10 meters.

Warlock.name: Rain of Fire
Warlock.description:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.

Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle Kills grant Radiant for 7.5+3.75 seconds.

Air Moves refill all weapons.
Air Moves include Icarus Dash and Weavewalk.

Warlock.name: Rime-Coat Raiment
Warlock.description:
Enhances Bleak Watcher:
Targeting Range is increased to 50 meters.
Creates 4 Medium Stasis Crystals diagonally to where it spawns.
Bleak Watcher emits a Stasis Storm that covers 6 meters.
The 4 Stasis Crystals respawn after 15 seconds.
Stasis Crystals count as Super Ability Damage.

While standing in the Stasis Storm:
Grants a stack of Icicle every second, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Shooting triggers the Icicle to attack, releasing a Stasis Projectile that deals 50 [?] Stasis Damage and inflicts x50 [x20] Slow for ?+? seconds.
Icicle can fire every 0.2 seconds.
Icicle persists for 2 seconds while not in the Stasis Storm.

Warlock.name: Sanguine Alchemy
Warlock.description:
While in a Rift or Well of Radiance:

x4 Super-Matching Weapon Surge.

Damaging an enemy applies a mark for 5 seconds.
Marked Enemies receive 10% increased damage from the user.

Kills grant Blood Magic for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 15 seconds.
Blood Magic pauses the duration of the Rift for as long as it is active.
Well of Radiance will not be extended by Blood Magic.

Swapping to Sanguine Alchemy while in combat will disable all of its effects for 10 seconds.

Warlock.name: Secant Filaments
Warlock.description:
While a Void Super Ability is equipped, for the user only:
Standing on Empowering Rifts created by the user grant Devour for 11+0 seconds.
Exiting, and then re-entering the same Empowering Rift refreshes the duration of Devour.
Secant Filaments' Devour can be refreshed to 11+11 seconds.

While Devour is active:
Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

No longer grants Overload Shots as Breaker Functionality is now intrinsic to intrinsics :^)

Warlock.name: Skull of Dire Ahamkara
Warlock.description:
Massively Increases Damage Resist during Nova Bomb.
Begins at 99.5%, and sharply falls down to 75% near the end.

On Nova Bomb Cast:
Grants the ability to cast Nova Bomb: Lance for 5 seconds.
Nova: Lance deals up to 2269 [?] Damage over 8 meters. Deals up to 2950 damage against Bosses.

Destroying a Nova: Cataclysm with the Lance triggers a Nova Vortex alongside the Cataclysmic seekers.
Nova Vortex is functionally identical to the Super version.
Requires a minimum of 20 meters of distance to trigger.
A single cast of Nova Bomb deals up to ~14,500 damage against a Boss.

Nova Bomb Kills refund 5?% Super Energy, up to 50% Super Energy.

Upon scoring a Weapon Kill, while Devour is active:
Grants additional Super Energy based on the Enemy Tier.
Tier 1 Combatant = ?% | T2 = ?% | T3 = ?% | T4 = ?% | Guardian = ?%
Actual amount varies by Enemy Rank. Works with any Super Ability.

Warlock.name: Speaker's Sight
Warlock.description:
Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb is replaced with a Healing Turret.
Consuming a Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of the user.

Healing Turret
Lasts 9 seconds and has 100? Construct HP.
Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters.
Healing Seekers bestow Cure x1 and Restoration x1 for 4+2 [3+1.5] seconds over a 7.5m radius.
If Touch of Flame is equipped and only for the wearer: Cure and Restoration are increased to x2.

Upon restoring Health once [six times] to a damaged Ally:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy on the ally's position.
 Incurs a 10 second cooldown between Orb spawns.

Warlock.name: Starfire Protocol
Warlock.description:
Grants an extra Fusion Grenade Ability Charge.

Passively grants 20% Additional Base Fusion Grenade Regeneration Rate

While Radiant, or in either a Well of Radiance or Empowering Rift:
5% Fusion Grenade Ability Energy per Weapon Hit up to once every 0.4 seconds.
15% Fusion Grenade Ability Energy on Weapon Kill.

On Fusion Grenade Kill:
Grants 100% Class Ability Energy.

Warlock.name: The Stag
Warlock.description:
Grants 25% [5%] Damage Resist (Resist x2) to Guardians inside Rifts created by the wielder. 
Standing in a Rift that overlaps or is inside a Well of Radiance allows the Damage Resist to work in it.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Dearly Departed grants 50% [25%] Class Ability Energy.
Buff lasts until the user is no longer at Critical Health, essentially serving as a Cooldown.

On Death:
 Spawns a Healing Rift for 15 seconds.

Warlock.name: Stormdancer's Brace
Warlock.description:
On Super Cast:
Grants Amplified for 15 seconds.

While Stormtrance Super Ability is equipped:
Stormtrance Hits and Kills grant a stack of Ascending Amplitude, up to 30 stacks.
Decreases the Super Cost of Stormtrance's Ionic Blink by 50%, to 3.125%.

Ascending Amplitude:
 6.7?% Increased Stormtrance Damage per stack, up to 200% at 30 Stacks.

Refunds up to 30% Stormdancer Super Energy based on the amount of Enemy Kills.

While Amplified:
Arc Ability Hits grant x1 Bolt Charge up to once every 0.6 seconds.

Warlock.name: Sunbracers
Warlock.description:
The Solar-Element Grenades named "Solar Grenades" have Fastball intrinsically and last 2 seconds longer.

Powered Melee Kills grant 5 seconds of Sunbracers Ready.

On Grenade Ability Usage while Sunbracers Ready is active:
Grants Sunbracers buff for 4 seconds.

Sunbracers grants 20,000% Additional Base "Solar Grenade" Grenade Regeneration Rate.

Warlock.name: Swarmers
Warlock.description:
Upon destroying a Tangle:
Spawns 2 Threadlings.

Threadlings inflict Unravel on hit.

Warlock.name: Transversive Steps
Warlock.description:
Upon sprinting for 1.5 seconds:
Refills 100% of Magazine/Dissipates 100% Heat of Readied Weapon.

Increases Sprint Speed from 8m/s to 8.5m/s.
Increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
Crouch Speed cannot be decreased below 4m/s.

Warlock.name: Verity's Brow
Warlock.description:
Upon scoring a Grenade-Element Matching Weapon Kill: 
Grants a stack of Death Throes, up to 5 stacks, increasing Grenade Ability Damage and granting Bonus Grenade Ability Energy per second per stack.
Loses 1 Death Throes stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.
Death Throes stack timer begins decaying after 2 seconds of gaining a stack.

Death Throes:
x1 | 40% [20%] increased Grenade Damage, ?% Increased Grapple Melee Damage, and +0.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 8 seconds.
x2 | 55% [40%] increased Grenade Damage, ?% Increased Grapple Melee Damage, and +1% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 7 seconds.
x3 | 70% [60%] increased Grenade Damage, ?% Increased Grapple Melee Damage, and +1.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 6 seconds.
x4 | 85% [80%] increased Grenade Damage, ?% Increased Grapple Melee Damage, and +2% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 5 seconds.
x5 | 100% increased Grenade Damage, 170% Increased Grapple Melee Damage, and +2.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 4 seconds.

On Grenade Ability Usage while Death Throes is active, for 5 seconds: 
 Allies receive Feel The Flame while within 20 metres.
Feel The Flame grants 10x Grenade Regeneration Speed.

Warlock.name: Vesper of Radius
Warlock.description:
While within 15 meters of at least 3 enemies:
 Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate, scaling with enemy amount.
3 Enemies = 250% | 4 = 666% | 5 = 1085% | 6 = 1500%

After 1 second of placing a Rift:
Triggers an Arc Shockwave that deals 360 [100] Arc Damage and staggers over 7.5 meters. 
Additional shockwaves occur every 5 seconds, until the Rift expires.

Enemies killed by the Shockwaves explode, dealing 180 [100?] Arc Damage.
While an Arc Super Ability is equipped, explosions and shockwaves blind.

Warlock.name: Wings of Sacred Dawn
Warlock.description:
While a Solar Super Ability is equipped:
 ADS while Airborne grants Tome of Dawn. 
Passively grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness while airborne.

Tome of Dawn: 
Holds the user in place midair for 2.8 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer
Scoring additional hits extends the buff duration by +? seconds, up to ? seconds.
Grants 15% Damage Resist and 25% Flinch Resist while active.
Solar Weapon Kills grant Restoration x1 for ? seconds and refill stowed weapons.

Warlock.name: Winter's Guile
Warlock.description:
Melee Kills and Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of Warlord's Sigil for 4.75 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
 Finishers grant 3 Warlord's Sigil stacks. Scorch DoT Kills do not grant stacks.
Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time. Finishers refresh the stack duration on animation start.

Warlord's Sigil grants increased Melee Damage per stack.
x1 = 67.5% | x2 = 122% | x3 = 166% | x4 = 202% | x5 = 228%
x6 = 249% | x7 = 265% | x8 = 278% | x9 = 289% | x10 = 300%

Upon reaching or refreshing x10 Warlord's Sigil:
Gain a Melee Ability Charge.
 Grants Warlord's Fury Ready for 8 seconds and cannot be refreshed by Finishers.
Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.

On Melee/Glaive Melee Usage while Warlord's Fury Ready is active:
400% increased Melee Damage, 0.8x Melee Duration, and 38.4x👀 Melee Regeneration Speed for 10 seconds.
Cannot gain Warlord's Sigil while Warlord's Fury is active. Resets Warlord's Sigil to x0 stacks on buff end.

Warlock.name:
Sect of Vigor

Lightgiver Chant
Warlock.description:
On Ally Death:
