Base Glaive Block Movement is normally 0.85x without Weapon Energy, and 0.66x with Weapon Energy.
The time to raise the shield is based off of Handling and ADS Speed values.

Glaive Shield:
97.5% Damage Resist against Combatants.
50% Damage Resist against Guardians. Primary Ammo Weapons and Melee Attacks are only granted 30% Damage Resist.
Vexcalibur uniquely has 50% Damage Resist against all damage from Guardians.

Weapon Energy Drain Rate:
0 SD = 6.5s | 50 SD = 12s | 100 SD = 18? seconds
Drain Rate = 6.5 + (Shield Duration x ~0.1)

weapon_archetype_notes.name: Sword Guarding
weapon_archetype_notes.description:
[Guard] projects an energy shield in front of the user that constantly drains over time, the rate of which is determined by Guard Endurance.
Applies a 0.85x Movement Speed Multiplier while guarding.

Attacks that strike the shield deal decreased damage, with the damage resistance being determined by Guard Resistance.
Scales from 82.5% [52.5%] to 95% [65%] Damage Resist based on the Guard Resistance stat.

weapon_archetype_notes.name: Charge Rate
weapon_archetype_notes.description:
Charge Rate determines the delay before Sword Energy is regenerated, and the rate at which it is regenerated.
 Using any Sword Energy restarts Energy Regeneration Delay, regardless of which equipped Sword drained it.

Sword Energy Regeneration Delay, in seconds:
10 CR = 2.65s | 30 CR = 2.45s | 40 CR = 2.25s | 70 CR = 1.65s | 100 CR = 1.05s

Sword Energy Regeneration Rate = 1.35 - (Charge Rate x 0.01)

weapon_archetype_notes.name: Guard Endurance
weapon_archetype_notes.description:
Sword Guard passively drains Sword Energy. Guarding against any damage pauses passive drain for ? seconds.

Sword Energy Drain, in seconds:
0 GE = 2.5s | 40 GE = 5s | 60 GE = 6.35s | 90 GE = 9s | 100 GE = 12.5s
Stronghold and Infinite Guard Swords do not drain any Sword Energy.

weapon_archetype_notes.name: Guard Resistance
weapon_archetype_notes.description:
Guard Resistance determines the amount of Damage Resist the Sword Guard provides against blocked attacks.
Internally, this is the Stability stat, which means that effects that increase Stability, such as Rally Barricade, will increase the Damage Resist.

Guard Damage Resist = 82.5% [52.5%] at 0 Resistance to 95% [65%] at 100 Resistance. 
Damage Resist = ???????? | 52.5 + (0.125 x Stat)

exotic_weapons.name: Ace of Spades
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon

Radar remains active while ADS.

Enhanced Firefly deals a maximum of 436 [80?] Damage, down to a minimum of 20% [?] Damage over 7.5 meters, with Damage Falloff Start at 3.75m.

Upon finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill:
Grants x6 Memento Mori bullets.
Firing consumes a stack of Memento Mori per shot, granting 68% [29%] increased damage and 15% Decreased Damage Falloff Distance.
Memento Mori is removed on stow. Reload Trigger persists through stow.

↑Funeral Pyre:
50% Increased Firefly Damage while Memento Mori is active.

exotic_weapons.name: Ager's Scepter
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.3x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills trigger a Stasis Burst, inflicting x100 [x50] Slow Stacks to enemies within 10 meters.
Stasis Kills refill 10 Ammo.

↑Will Given Form: Hold [Reload] to activate Alternate Firing Mode while at Full Super Energy.
Immediately drains 20% Super Energy, then constantly drains 4% Super Energy per Second.
Overflows magazine to 192 from reserves, and grants 80% increased damage. 
Hits inflict x20 [x0] Slow Stacks for 4+0 seconds 
Effect lasts until Magazine is emptied, Super Energy runs out, or if Ager's Scepter is stowed.
No, it does not benefit from Super Stat >100, or any other Super Ability Damage increase!

exotic_weapons.name: Alethonym
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Micro-Missile Grenade Launcher Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)

Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 697 [91] Explosive Damage, down to 30% damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, being dealt 79 Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds. 
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.

Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.

Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and always explode on hit, meaning they cannot impale Combatants.

Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the One For All trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Arbalest
exotic_weapons.description:
Special Ammo Kinetic Precision Linear Fusion Rifle

Fires a single shield-piercing Precision Slug that deals 582 [132] Kinetic Damage with a 3.44x [4.3x] Precision Multiplier.
Shield-Piercing Slug instantly destroys Barrier Champion's Shield and Combatant Elemental Shields on hit, inflicting them with Disruption Break.

Kinetic Vulnerability from Disruption Break applies to Arbalest.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Handling, +1 Magazine Size (5 -> 6), and the Genesis trait.
Effectively makes all Shield Breaks refill the magazine.

exotic_weapons.name: Bad Juju
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Lightweight Pulse Rifle

Kills refill Magazine and grant a stack of String of Curses for 5.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
String of Curses grants increased damage and additional Super Energy on kill.
String of Curses persists through stow.

String of Curses
20% | 40% | 60% | 80% | 100% Increased Damage
10% | 20% | 30% | 40% | 50% Increased Damage
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.4% | 1.7% | 2% Additional Super Energy

Upon scoring 3 kills within 7.5? seconds of each without reloading or stowing Bad Juju:
Triggers a Cursed Explosion, dealing up to 305 [?] Kinetic Damage over ? meters.
Explosion Kills count towards the kill counter. String of Curses damage buff applies to the Explosion Damage.

↑Unending Curse:
String of Curses duration is increased to 7.5 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Barrow-Dyad
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Strand Aggressive Submachine Gun
Behaves differently depending on the current Path.

Automatically refills magazine-based Ammo every 0.2 seconds while not firing, refilling up to 34 Ammo over 4.85 seconds.
1-2 Ammo = 4 Refill per tick | 3-8 Ammo = 3 Refill | 9-16 Ammo = 2 Refill | 17 or higher = 1 Refill
Firing delays refilling to 0.285 seconds. Can fire permanently at 1 Ammo at 240?RPM. Refills to 34 Ammo to not prevent reloading.

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers. 
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 173 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within 1 seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 45 [9?] Impact Damage and 542 [21?] Explosive Damage over 0.25? meters.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.

exotic_weapons.name: Bastion
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Fusion Rifle

Fires a 3-round burst of 7 pellets each.
Deals 136 [31.2] damage per pellet x 7 = 952 [218.4] per burst x 3 = 2,856 [655.2] damage per Ammo spent.

Upon scoring 14 pellets in a burst:
300% [100%] increased Melee Damage for the next Melee Hit within 3 seconds.

Upon dealing Melee Damage:
35% increased damage, +? Reload Speed, and 0.85x Charge Time Multiplier for 8.5 seconds.
Additional Melee Damage refreshes Saint's Fury duration. 
Buff is removed on stow.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Cast No Shadows Origin Trait

exotic_weapons.name: Cerberus +1
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Quad-Barrel High-Impact Auto Rifle
Deals 85% of the damage of a High-Impact Auto Rifle.
Has reverse damage falloff at close ranges for both firing modes.  Deals 75% decreased damage to Stasis Crystals.

Each shot fires 4 evenly spread pellets in a triangular shape, with one always landing within the Accuracy Cone.
Each pellet deals up to 44 [20.4] damage with a 1.77x Precision Multiplier.
ADS grants -25% Pellet Spread.

Decreases damage dealt the closer an enemy is, up to a maximum of 16.67% Decreased Damage at point blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 metres. 
The ADS Damage Falloff Scalar of 1.6x increases the minimum distance to reach base damage to 22 meters.

↑Focused Fire: Hold [Reload] within 7 seconds of a kill to activate Focused Fire. Green Light displays when it's possible to swap firing modes.
50% [10%] increased damage and -30% Pellet Spread for 7 seconds.
Additional Weapon Kills while Focused Fire is active refresh its duration.
Focused Fire and Trigger Condition are removed on stow.

exotic_weapons.name: The Chaperone
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Slug Shotgun
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Passively has 5% Increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Fires a single Precision Slug that deals 737 [?] Damage with a 1.76x Precision Multiplier.

Upon scoring a Precision Kill, or 2 Precision Hits within ? seconds of each:
Grants Roadborn for 10 seconds. 
Scoring additional Precision Hits extends the buff duration by +3 seconds, up to 10 seconds.
Buff persists through stow.

Roadborn:
22% Increased Precision Damage, 0.58x Fire Recovery Delay, and 15% Total Increased Damage Falloff Distance
 +20 Stability, +40 Reload Speed, 0.75x Reload Duration Multiplier, 0.56x Handling Duration Multiplier.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Triple Tap trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Conditional Finality
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis + Solar Aggressive Shotgun
Reloads both shells at once.
 Counts as a weapon for Harmonic Resonance, and benefits from the Handling and Reload Speed Increase from it.

While Ammo = 2:
Deals Stasis Damage. ▲ Pattern Spread.
Scoring a hit with 10 out of the 12 pellets inflicts freeze.
Benefits from Stasis Mods.

While Ammo = 1 or 0:
Deals Solar Damage. ⬤ Pattern Spread.
Scoring a hit with 10 out of the 12 pellets triggers an ignition.
Benefits from Solar Mods.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Heal Clip and Rimestealer traits.

exotic_weapons.name: Crimson
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic 3-Round Burst Aggressive Hand Cannon

Allegedly shoots an illegal burst of 3 bullets, each dealing 67 [18] damage with a 1.85x Precision Multiplier.

Kills restore 32 HP and begin Health Regeneration.
Precision Kills refill the Magazine.

↑Catalyst: Passively grants +20 Range and the To The Pain trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Cryosthesia 77K
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Precision Sidearm

Kills grant LN2 Burst Ready, enabling a Charged Shot Reload.
LN2 Burst Ready persists through stow.

Hold [Reload] while LN2 Burst Ready is active to perform a special reload that loads up a Charged Shot.
Charged Shot requires briefly charging for 0.53 seconds, and instantly freezes on direct hit. Enemies within 6? metres are applied freeze [x50 Slow].
Firing the Charged Shot, or stowing while Charged Shot is active reverts the firing mode to Sidearm Mode.

↑Cold Efficiency:
Scoring a Frozen Enemy Kill refills the Magazine.

exotic_weapons.name: Cull's Shadow
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Aggressive Fusion Rifle
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow. 
The last Exotic Weapon added to Destiny 2.

Replaces Melee Ability with the weapon's Frontal Blades capable of performing a swift two-hit combo with an extended 7 meter lunge.
Each strike deals ? [84] Kinetic Damage. Frontal Blades deal 50% increased Melee Damage on Corrupted Enemies.
Frontal Blade Damage scales with Melee Stat and Melee Damage Buffs. It is NOT a Glaive Melee.

Upon scoring 2 Frontal Blade Strikes within 2? seconds of each or a Frontal Blade Kill:
Grants a stack of Soulfire Charges, up to a maximum of 6 stacks and restores 40 HP.
Stacks are only consumed upon firing or on death.

Fires an increasingly wider 3 round burst of 4 projectiles each.
Projectiles deal 143 [?] Kinetic Damage.
Consumes a stack of Soulfire Charge to inflict Potent Corruption on enemies.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds, ramping up by ~8.7% per tick over 20 ticks, up to a final tick of 300 [?] Damage, totalling 2,985 [?] Damage.

Soulfire Charge's Potent Corruption causes enemies to create a Soulfire Crystal on death.

Soulfire Crystals are Constructs with 400? HP that linger for 15 seconds, exploding upon being reduced to 0 HP.
Soulfire Crystal Explosion deals up to 1,065 [?] Kinetic Damage over 8 meters, down to 75% Damage.

↑Catalyst grants 4 selectable traits:
Soulfire Succor | Destroying Soulfire Crystals with Frontal Blades grants a Soulfire Charge and refills +1 Ammo.

Soulfire Rancor | Soulfire Crystals explode when an enemy is within 7 meters, dealing 5% increased damage and inflicting the aforementioned Potent Corruption.

Soulfire Zeal | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant maximized movement speed and 20?% Damage Resist for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.

Soulfire Skewer | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant Frontal Blades the ability to inflict Corruption for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.
Corruption deals 16 per tick every 0.5 seconds up to 10 times per infliction and can stack.

exotic_weapons.name: Dead Man's Tale
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Kinetic Aggressive Scout Rifle
Loads 2 bullets at a time

Precision Hits grant a stack of Cranial Spike for 4 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Stacks persist through stow.

Cranial Spike x1 | +8 Range, +2 Stability, 0.97x Reload Duration Multiplier, +4 Aim Assist, +1 Ammo Loaded, and 3.4% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x2 | +16 Range, +4 Stability, 0.94x Reload Duration Multiplier, +8 Aim Assist, +2 Ammo Loaded, and 6.8% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x3 | +24 Range, +6 Stability, 0.91x Reload Duration Multiplier, +12 Aim Assist, +3 Ammo Loaded, and 10.2% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x4 | +32 Range, +8 Stability, 0.89x Reload Duration Multiplier, +16 Aim Assist, +4 Ammo Loaded, and 13.6% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x5 | +40 Range, +10 Stability, 0.86x Reload Duration Multiplier, +20 Aim Assist, +5 Ammo Loaded, and 17% increased damage against Combatants.

↑Dark-Forged Trigger:
Passively grants 0.92x Hipfire Fire Recovery Delay, -50% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size, and -?x Hipfire Accuracy Cone Growth. 
Prefers Crits over Bodyshots if Precision AA Cone overlaps.
24% [15%] increased Hipfire Damage while at x5 Cranial Spike.
Adds up to a 45% Damage Buff against Combatants while Hipfiring.

exotic_weapons.name: Euphony
exotic_weapons.description:
Special Ammo Strand Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle

Fires a 3-round burst, with each shot dealing 174 [39] Damage with a 3.43x Precision Multiplier.

Scoring 6 hits within ? seconds of each spawns 3 Threadlings.
Scoring a Precision Kill spawns 1 Threadling.

Threadling hits grant a stack of Spindle, up to x25 stacks for 10 seconds.
 Spindle grants 2% increased damage, +? Handling, and +? Reload Speed per stack, up to 50% increased damage, +? Handling, and +? Reload Speed at x25 stacks.
Additional Threadling or Euphony Hits refresh the Spindle duration.
Spindle can be stacked and remains active while stowed.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Enlightened Action trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Final Warning
exotic_weapons.description:
Strand Rapid-Fire Sidearm
Projectiles despawn after 50 metres.

Fires projectiles that deal 118 [25] damage with a 1.6x Precision Multiplier and have different behaviors depending on whether it is hipfired or aimed-down-sights.

While holding down the trigger:
Enemies within 24 metres are marked over 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds, and gradually charges up a 10-round burst over 0.9 seconds. Burst-Fire has +30 Stability.
Fully-Charged Burst Hits inflict Unravel to marked enemies.

While Hipfiring:
Shoots slower-moving Tracking Rounds which aggressively seek marked enemies.
Marked Enemies receive 20% Increased Bodyshot Damage.

While ADS:
Shoots hitscan projectiles.
 Marked Enemies receive 100% Increased Precision Damage.

↑String Theory:
10% increased damage towards Marked Enemies. Marked Miniboss and Boss Combatants only receive 5% increased damage.
Hits against Marked Enemies have a chance to refill 1 Ammo.
Rank-and-File and Elites = ~85% | Minibosses+ = 25%

exotic_weapons.name: Forerunner
exotic_weapons.description:
Special Ammo Kinetic Sidearm

Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber rounds that deal 118 [42] damage with a 5.2x [1.85x] Precision Multiplier. 

Firing semiautomatically grants -33?% Recoil, -?% Accuracy Cone Growth and -?% Accuracy Cone Size. Impossible to obtain Accuracy numbers due to the gun's reticle.

↑The Rock: Hold [Reload] within 4 seconds of a Weapon Kill, while having at least 4 Ammo to replaces Grenade Ability with a Kinetic-Damage Fragmentation Grenade.
Fragmentation Grenade deals up to 1863 [181] damage in a 9 metre radius and follows a Medium Arc Trajectory.
Explosion deals a minimum of 20% damage at maximum falloff. Explosion deals 75?% Decreased Self-Damage. 
Has a 0.6 second fuse timer that begins as soon as movement is slowed enough.
Fragmentation Grenade counts as a Grenade Ability, and will activate any effect associated with Grenade Kills or Grenade Ability Usage.
The Rock persists through stow, and is only removed on Grenade Usage.

exotic_weapons.name: Hawkmoon
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon

Precision Hits or Kills grants a stack of Paracausal Charge.
Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants. based on the amount of stacks.
x1 = 21% | x2 = 36.5% | x3 = 47.6% | x4 = 55.3% | x5 = 59.8% | x6 = 63.2% | x7 = 66.3%
Paracausal Charge stacks are removed on reload, upon fully refilling the magazine, or upon stowing while at either 1 Ammo left, or while at Paracausal Charge ≥6 stacks.

The Final Round in the magazine consumes all Paracausal Charge stacks to deal increased damage based on the amount of stacks. 
The damage buff from Paracausal Charge does NOT apply to the Final Round damage.

Paracausal Shot's Final Round Damage Increase:
292% | 300% | 340% | 425% | 667% | 1071% | 1736%
30% | 33% | 45.7% | 80.5% | 154.3% | 288% | 508.6%
Weapon can get different rolls from Xûr.

↑Hunter's Trance:
Passively grants +1 Magazine Size (8 -> 9).
Grants increased Range, Handling, and Reload Speed as Paracausal Shot stacks increase.
+8 | +14 | +22 | +26 | +28 | +29 | +30 Range
+? | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? | +? Handling
+15 | +25 | +35 | +40 | +50 | +50? | +50? Reload Speed

exotic_weapons.name: Huckleberry
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Aggressive Submachine Gun

While holding down the trigger:
Grants a stack of Ride The Bull every 0.833 seconds, up to 2 stacks.
Ride The Bull x1 grants 0.9x Fire Recovery Delay and +?% Recoil.
Ride The Bull x2 grants 0.8x Fire Recovery Delay and +?% Recoil.
Ride The Bull is removed upon releasing the trigger.

Kills refill Magazine and grant a stack of "Yeehaw" Rampage for 3.5 seconds.
20% | 41% | 66% Increased Damage
10% | 21% | 33% Increased Damage

↑Bull Rider:
Grants the Kinetic Tremors trait, requiring 14 hits to trigger, with each shockwave dealing 215 [20] Damage, scaling with Weapon Damage Buffs.

exotic_weapons.name: Izanagi's Burden
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Sniper Rifle

Hold [Reload] to perform a slower Reload that consumes up to 4 Ammo and grants a single, high-damage Honed Edge shot that deals up to ↑7739 Precision Damage.
Honed Edge persists through stow until it is fired.

Honed Edge x2 = 12% [20%] Increased Damage and +1.92 Precision Multiplier. Total: 79% [91%]
Honed Edge x3 = 25% [45%] Increased Damage and +2.74 Precision Multiplier. Total: 131% [167%]
Honed Edge x4 = 112% [165%] Increased Damage and +2.74 Precision Multiplier. Total: 291% [389%]
↑Peerless Edge x4 = 155% [218%] Increased Damage and +2.74 Precision Multiplier. Total: 370% [487%]
Honed Edge's Reload Animation Speed is the same as a regular reload's.

↑Peerless Edge:
Honed Edge x4's Damage Increase is multiplied by 1.2x.

exotic_weapons.name: The Jade Rabbit
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic High-Impact Scout Rifle

Upon scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each or a Precision Kill:
Refills Magazine and grants 1 stack of Fate of All Fools, up to a maximum of 15 stacks.
Fate of All Fools persists through stow.

Fate of All Fools:
Landing a Non-Precision Hit consumes a stack to make it deal the same damage as a Precision Hit.
Grants 100% increased Firefly damage.

↑Catalyst: Passively grants +30 Stability.
Holding [Reload] consumes all Fate of All Fools stacks, granting a single Fated Micro-Missile that deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
Micro-Missile deals 122 [?] Impact Damage and 171 [?] Explosive Damage, down to 45% damage over 8 meters at 1 stack. 
x2 = 151 + 456 | x3 = 179 + 575 | x4 = 196 + 662 | x5 = 213 + 733 | x10 = 264 + 954 | x15 = 281 + 1023
Can also be used to rocket jump without any self-damage, weeeeeeeeeee!

exotic_weapons.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle

Picking up an Orb of Power grants x7 stacks of Eyes Up, Guardian. (A full magazine worth of enhanced ricochets)
Eyes Up, Guardian stacks persist through stow.

Every shot in the magazine divisible by 7 fires a ricochetting bullet that deals 252.52% [5% Guardians | 252.52% Constructs] increased damage with +50% Auto Aim Cone Size.
Rounds that ricochet off of enemies bounce towards the closest enemy within 8? [5?] meters, dealing 108 [4.6] damage.

Firing a ricochetting round while Eyes Up, Guardian is active consumes a stack, enhancing the ricochetting bullet.
Enhanced Ricochetting Bullets bounce up to 7 times between enemies within 12? [?] meters. Enemies can only be damaged twice by the same ricochetting bullet.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Attrition Orbs trait.

exotic_weapons.name: The Last Word
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Hand Cannon

Fires at 225RPM full-auto, with each shot dealing 175 [43] Damage with a 1.79x Precision Multiplier.
Hip-Fired Precision Hits deal 88% [?%] increased damage. 

Hipfired Hits grant a stack of Fan Fire for 4 seconds, up to 4 stacks.
Fan Fire stacks are removed on reload, ADS, or stow.

Fan Fire:
+5 | +10 | +15 | +20 Reload Speed
 -5% | -10% | -15% | -20% Accuracy Cone Size

↑Catalyst: Grants the Killing Wind and Envious Assassin traits.

exotic_weapons.name: Lumina
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon

Kills create a floating Remnant that homes in towards the user while within 15 metres. 
Remnants refill 4 Ammo and grant 1 Noble Round on pickup, up to a maximum of 6 Noble Rounds. Boots of the Assembler' Noble Seekers grant 1 Noble Rounds.
Noble Round stacks persist through stow.

Hipfiring releases a Noble Round, which aggressively seeks the closest ally.
Noble Rounds restore 90 HP to the ally, and grant Blessing of the Sky to both the wielder and the ally.

Blessing of the Sky:
35% [15%] increased damage and +100 Class Stat for 11 seconds.

↑Resonant Virtue:
Kills now create 2 Remnants.

exotic_weapons.name: Malfeasance
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Precision Hand Cannon

Hits embed Explosive Slugs on the enemy for 6 seconds. Slugs expire harmlessly individually.
Embedding 5 slugs on an enemy causes the slugs to explode, each dealing 216 [45] damage per slug.
Embedded slugs also explode on death.

Deals 25% Increased damage against Gambit Invaders and Taken Combatants.
Deals 25% Increased damage against Combatants that are directly struck by Witherhoard's Blight.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Range and the Vorpal Weapon trait.

exotic_weapons.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Lightweight Scout Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. MIDA Synergy Weapons inherit the Movement Bonus.

Grants 12.5% Increased Movement Speed while readied.

Radar remains active while ADS.

Scoring kills with MIDA Multi-tool and other weapons with MIDA Synergy traits progresses the 4-stage Software Update counter.
Primary MIDA Weapons grant 15% [100%] Current Stage Progress (3.6% [25%] towards maximum)
Special MIDA Weapons = 10% [50%] Current Stage Progress (2.5% [12.5%] towards maximum)
Dying sets the Software Update counter to the beginning of the previous stage.

Software Update: Incremental buffs that stack with the previous stages. Combatant Damage Buff is the total increase.
Chip | 0.75x Handling Duration Multiplier and 4.8% increased damage towards Combatants.
Barrel | +15 Range and +15 Stability and 9.6% increased damage towards Combatants.
Optics | 15% Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance, 5% Increased Auto Aim Cone Angle, and 14.4% increased damage towards Combatants.
Ammo | Shots explode on impact, dealing an additional instance of up to 22 [7] Damage, down to 0% Damage over 3 meters and 14.4% increased damage towards Combatants.

↑Vital Intel: While an enemy is within 15 meters:
Enhanced Radar, +20 Reload Speed, and 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier.
 Buff lingers for 4 seconds once criteria isn't met, even if stowed.

exotic_weapons.name: Monte Carlo
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle

Hits grant 2% Melee Energy.
Kills grant a stack of Markov Chain for 4.5 seconds, up to 5 stacks, and have a 25% chance to grant 100% Fixed Melee Ability Energy. 
Melee Kills refill magazine and grant 5 stacks.

Markov Chain:
13% | 26% | 39% | 52% | 65% Increased Damage
6.6% | 13.2% | 19.8% | 26.4% | 33% Increased Damage

↑Bayonet Locked: Hold [Reload] while at Markov Chain x5 to replace Melee Ability with a Bayonet for a single Melee Attack. Bayonet counts as an Unpowered Melee Attack.
Bayonet Melee Attacks deal 2,495 [140] Kinetic Melee Damage, grant 50% Fixed Melee Ability Energy, and increase the Melee Lunge Distance to 7 metres.
Bayonet Ready persists through stow.

exotic_weapons.name: Necrochasm
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

On Precision Kill, or upon scoring a Cursed Thrall Explosion Kill, or upon killing a Corrupted Enemy:
+70? Reload Speed and 0.9?x Reload Duration Multiplier for ? seconds.
Triggers a Cursed Thrall Explosion, dealing up to 630 [130?] Arc Damage, down to 10% damage and inflicting Corruption over a 8 meter radius. 
Cursed Thrall Explosion Kills refill Magazine.
Corruption deals 18 [0.4?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds.
Cursed Thrall Explosion and Corruption Damage scale with Combatant Rank Multipliers.
Fun Fact: Cursed Thrall (Hive Combatants) deal 250 damage against Combatants.

Upon finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill, or upon scoring a Cursed Thrall Explosion Kill:
0.8x Fire Recovery Delay Multiplier, +6? Stability, +10-15? Aim Assist for 7 seconds.

↑One for Thrall:
Damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage, +? Range, and +? Aim Assist for 10 seconds.
One For Thrall can be reactivated by damaging 3 enemies again, and persists through stow.

exotic_weapons.name: New Land Beyond
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle.

Fires a bullet that deals 970 [155] Kinetic Damage with a 2.75x Precision Multiplier, followed by a rechamber that scales based on the Reload Speed.
Rechamber animation can be skipped following the "clink" noise by sprinting, allowing for considerably faster fire rate.

Rechamber Speed:
Base Rechamber Speed allows firing every 1.834 seconds.
Bullseye Bolster allows firing every 1.49 seconds.
100 Reload Speed allows firing every 1.35 seconds.
 100 Reload Speed + Bullseye Bolster allows firing every 1.275 seconds.
100 Reload Speed + Rechamber Cancelling + Bullseye Bolster allows firing every ~1.05 seconds.

Upon scoring a Precision Hit:
Grants a stack of The Master, up to a maximum of 100 until death.
+? Stability, +? Handling, +40 Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist, and 0.95x Fire Recovery Delay? for 3 seconds or until firing and not scoring a Precision Hit.

The Master:
Grants increased Precision Damage, up to 70% at 20 stacks. 
15.7% | 22.2% | 27% | 31.3% | 35% x5
38.4% | 41.4% | 44.3% | 47% | 49.5% x10
51.9% | 54.2% | 56.5% | 58.6% | 60.7% x15
62.64% | 64.56% | 66.42% | 68.23% | 70% x20
Renames to The Grandmaster upon reaching 20 stacks, slowly increasing up to 73% over 100 stacks. Shots visually explode while at 20+ stacks.
 Transforms into THE GRANDERMASTER at 100 stacks. Transforms into The Chief Master at 999 stacks.

↑Top Tier Mastery: While at >20 Master stacks:
Magazine is constantly refilled, effectively removing reloading requirements.
Bullseye Bolster duration is increased to ? seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: New Malpais
exotic_weapons.description:
Strand Special Ammo Micro-Missile Pulse Rifle
Hold [Reload] to manually detonate all embedded projectiles.

Fires a 3-round burst of sticky projectiles that embed themselves to enemies and surfaces they hit, each dealing 271 [2] Impact Damage.
Projectiles detonate upon holding [Reload] or after being embed for 6 seconds, detonating for up to 321 [60] Explosive Damage over 6 meters.

Manually triggering the detonation of 6 embedded projectiles on a single enemy inflicts Suspension.

↑Unraveling Blast: Explosive Damage from Enemy-Embedded Projectiles now inflicts Unravel.

exotic_weapons.name: No Time to Explain
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic High-Impact Pulse Rifle.

Precision Hits and Hits against enemies affected by Stasis grant a stack of Rewind Again and refill 1 Ammo.
Reaching 10 stacks summons a Time-slip Portal for 9 seconds. Precision Hits extend its duration by 1 second.
Rewind Again stacks persist through stow.

Time-slip Portal:
 Shoots a burst of 3 bullets every 1.25 seconds towards enemies within 50 metres that are near the reticle.
Each bullet deals 49 [10.2] damage, has no damage falloff, inherits No Time To Explain's Shield-Piercing, and scales with Combatant Rank Multipliers.
Time-slip Portal is removed on stow.

↑Blast from the Side: 
Timebuddy Portal burst delay is decreased to 0.85 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Osteo Striga
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Kinetic Precision Submachine Gun
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Fires slow, seeking projectiles that deal ~10.8% increased damage over a Precision Submachine Gun's.

Scoring 14 Hits or 7 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each or scoring a kill triggers a Potent Corruption Burst centered on the enemy, corrupting enemies within 5 metres.

Potent Corruption mechanics are identical to Necrotic Grips. Incurs a 2-second cooldown between corruption bursts on death.
Osteo Striga's Potent Corruption is affected by Buffs, Debuffs, Exotic Primary Rank-and-File Bonus, and the Kinetic Damage Bonus. 
Reinflicting Potent Corruption resets the stacking damage.

↑Osteo Striga Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability and +30 Reload Speed.
 Corruption Kills refill 100% of Magazine, and can overflow up to 300% Increased Magazine Capacity.
Incurs a 0.5 seconds cooldown between Ammo Overflows.

exotic_weapons.name: Outbreak Perfected
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Kinetic Lightweight Pulse Rifle
Uses Auto Rifle Recoil Animations.

Scoring 12 Hits within 1? seconds of each spawns 2–3 nanites.
Precision Kills spawn 9 nanites. 

Nanites:
Tracking Projectiles that chase after enemies within ? meters, dealing 77 [13] damage on impact and embedding themselves for 9 seconds. 
Nanites that haven't embedded on an enemy begin disappearing after 3 seconds. Embedding additional nanites refreshes the duration to 9 seconds.

Outbreak Perfected deals increased damage to enemies with nanites based on the amount of nanites.
x1 = 30% [15%] | x2 = 60% [30%] | x3 = 90% [45%] | x4 = 120% [75%] | x5 = 150% [?%] | x100 = 300% [?%]
Each Nanite after the fifth increases the damage buff by 2.1%, up to 300% [?%] at x100 Nanites.
Nanited Enemies are highlighted on Outbreak's scope. Does not work for all ornaments.

↑Disease Vector:
25% Increased Nanite impact damage.
Nanited Enemies release 4 Disease Vector Nanites on death.
Disease Vector Nanites deal 13 [?] damage.

exotic_weapons.name: Praxic Blade
exotic_weapons.description:
Special Ammo Shield-Piercing Lightsaber Sword
Modifiable Tangs, Grips, Traits, Mods, and Catalysts.
Deals 50% increased damage towards Combatant Shields, and 200% increased damage towards Barrier Shields.
Defensive Form for base damage values against Elites, as it has no damage bonuses.

[Light Attack] performs a Melee Combo, with each hit dealing 479 [256] Kinetic Damage. Melee Attacks can discharge Bolt Charge.
Using [Heavy Attack] after performing 3 [Light Attacks] executes a Cormorant Combo.
Cormorant Combo deals 689 [368] Kinetic Damage, followed by 3 damage instances of 417 [220] Kinetic Damage each, totalling 1940 [☠️] damage.

[Heavy Attack Press] performs a Ranged Attack, throwing the blade forward up to 50 meters away, homing towards up to 3 enemies before returning.
Deals 945 [174] Kinetic Damage per hit. Damage is reduced by 80% when returning. Attacking recalls the blade.

[Heavy Attack Hold] throws the blade on a straight path forward, dealing 100% increased damage. [Heavy Attack Release] to recall the blade.

[Blocking] grants 100% [~46%] Damage Resist against all damage in a ?° cone.
Blocking a hit retaliates by reflecting a Crystal-Color Matching Bolt that deals 255 [50] Kinetic Damage towards the reticle.

-------------

Balanced Form | Scoring 3 Melee Attack Kills within 5 seconds of each grants +1 Ammo, restores 65 HP, and begins Health Regeneration. 
Deals 10% increased damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants. Technically 11.2% due to impact stat shift.

Defensive Form | Blocking an attack within 1 seconds of beginning to block grants 20% increased damage for 2 seconds.
Blocking ? attacks within ? seconds of each attack grants +1 Ammo, up to once per second.

Offensive Form | Scoring 3 damage instances within ? seconds of each grants +1 Ammo.
Deals 15% increased damage against Bosses and Vehicles.

exotic_weapons.name: Praxic Blade 2:
exotic_weapons.description:
Cores grant an Elemental Effect based on the element of the equipped Super Ability:
Solar Effects that are initially applied by Praxic Blade deal 5% increased damage and their damage can be increased by Weapon Buffs.

Impact Core [On Melee Damage Instance] = x1 Bolt Charge | x25?+10? Scorch | Weaken for 6s | x40? Slow for ?s | Sever for 10s
Refraction Core [On Reflect Bolt Hit] =  x1 Bolt Charge | x10+7? Scorch | Weaken for ?s | x20 Slow for ?s | Sever for ?s
Gyro Core [On Ranged Hit] = x1 Bolt Charge | x35?+15? Scorch | Weaken for 6s | x50? Slow for ?s | Sever for ?s

↑Slottable Catalysts:
↑Echoing Blade = Thrown Blade can home towards up to 5 enemies, up from 3.
↑Upper Hand = 30% Increased Ranged/Reflect Damage against enemies that are at least 3? meters beneath the user. Does NOT require being grounded.
↑Hyperblade = Reflecting grants Amplified for 15 seconds and 100?% Increased Lunge Distance for the next Melee Swing. Hyperblade is removed on stow.
↑Energy Conduit = Catching the thrown blade begins Health Regeneration and restores ? Health per Ranged Hit scored in the throw, up to ? HP for 10 hits.

exotic_weapons.name: Quicksilver Storm
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic ↑Strand Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle
 Displayed Damage Numbers are for the Strand Version.

Hits progress a Tracking Micro-Missile counter which, upon reaching 100% Progress, which will overwrite a regular bullet when firing. 
Precision Hits = ~10.25% | Bodyshots = ~7.7% | Hit Counter persists through stow, and is removed on reload.

Tracking Micro-Missile aggressively tracks enemies, dealing 5 [2.7] Impact Damage, and up to 155 [20 Guardians | 80 Constructs] Explosive damage on impact. 
Tracking Missile Hits grant a stack of Grenades Prepped for Grenade Launcher Mode, up to 3 Grenades Prepped.
Grenade Prepped stacks and hit counter persist through stow. Missile cannot travel further than 50 metres.

Grenade Launcher Mode:
Hold [Reload] to swap into Grenade Launcher Mode once a Grenade Prepped stack is gained. Firing Mode persist through stow.
Firing consumes a stack to fire a Grenade that deals 30 [14 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Impact Damage.
Grenade Explosion deals up to 1,278 [120 Guardians | 960 Constructs] Explosive Damage, down to 30% Damage over 5 metres. 
Grenade deals no self-damage. Automatically queues up a reload to load the next grenade after firing. If out of grenades, it will instead perform a regular reload.

↑Nano-entanglement:
Converts the Damage Type to Strand. No longer receives Kinetic Damage Bonus.
Grenade Launcher Mode Kills create a Tangle.

exotic_weapons.name: Rat King
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Sidearm

Upon finishing a reload within 3 seconds of a kill:
Grants Invisibility for 5.8 seconds.

Grants a stack of Rat Pack per ally with a readied Rat King within 20 metres, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Rat Pack decreases Fire Recovery Delay and increases Magazine Size.

Rat Pack:
- | 0.87x | 0.8x | 0.7x | 0.6x Fire Recovery Delay
- | +2 | +4 | +6 | +9 Magazine Size

↑Infestation:
Passively grants +20 Aim Assist and +20 Recoil Direction.
Finishing a reload within 6 seconds of a kill begins Health Regeneration and restores ~2 HP.

exotic_weapons.name: Revision Zero
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Kinetic Pulse Rifle
Selectable Origin Traits, between Heavy Burst Frames and Aggressive Burst Frames. 

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a stack of Targeting Data, up to 4 stacks after 48 Precision Hits.

Hunter's Trace:
Hold [Reload] while at least one stack of Targeting Data is loaded to swap into Hunter's Trace. Ammo loaded is equal to the amount of Targeting Data stacks acquired.
Replaces the 18 Zoom Scope with a 50 Zoom Scope. Fires with perfect accuracy, and has a Red Sniper Rifle Glint.
Fires High-Damage Hunter's Trace Rounds that deal 564 [158] Damage with a 3.25x Precision Multiplier at 72RPM and inherit the Shield-Piercing effect.
Scoring a Hunter's Trace hit triggers a Kinetic Shockwave that deals up to 322 [20] Damage, down to 0% damage, and exhausts for 5 seconds over 6 meters.
Hunter's Trace persists through stow and can only be deactivated by fully emptying the magazine or dying.
Exhaust reduces Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in Feeding Frenzy, Fourth Time's The Charm, Outlaw, or Under Pressure trait equivalents. Fourth Time's The Charm allows firing up to 6 Sniper Shots.

exotic_weapons.name: Sturm
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Aggressive Hand Cannon

Kills refill Energy Weapons Magazine and grant +1 Increased Together Forever Base Magazine Capacity, up to a maximum of 100% Increased Base Magazine Capacity.

 Together Forever Weapons Kills load an Overcharged Round.
Scoring multiple Together Forever Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each loads additional rounds, up to a maximum of 25 loaded rounds.
2 Rapid Kills = +2 Overcharged Rounds per kill | 3+ Rapid Kills and onwards = +3 Overcharged Rounds per kill.
Overcharged Rounds persist through stow and are lost on death.

Firing consumes an Overcharged Round to deal increased damage.
Rank-and-File and Elites = 300% increased damage | Mini-bosses and Champions = 280% | Bosses = 260% | Guardians = 75% 

↑Helping Hands: Passively grants +20 Range and +40 Handling.
Overcharged Round Kills grants 2 stacks of Definitely-Not-Shot Swap, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.
 
Upon stowing Sturm or a Together Forever Weapon:
Consumes a stack of Helping Hands, granting 0.5x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier.

exotic_weapons.name: SUROS Regime
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle
Selectable Trait between Dual Speed Receiver and Spinning Up. 
Hold [Reload] to swap shooting modes.

Kills have a 25% chance to begin Health Regeneration and restore 20HP.

Dual Speed Receiver turns the weapon into a High-Impact Auto Rifle Frame with +3 Zoom and +30 Range while ADS.
Scoring kills while Dual Speed Receiver ADS is active grants 1.?x Heavy Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Spinning Up grants 0.83x to 0.67x Fire Recovery Delay while holding down the trigger. 
RPM increases every 12 bullets while holding down the trigger. Releasing the trigger resets the buff.
Scoring kills while Spinning Up is active grants 1.?x Special Ammo Progress Multiplier.

As magazine progressively decreases below 50%, down to 0%:
5% to 10% increased damage.

↑SUROS Ascendance:
Passively grants +50 Recoil Direction.
Kills have a 50% chance to restore health.

exotic_weapons.name: Sweet Business
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Minigun High-Impact Auto Rifle

Rapidly shoots bullets that deal 41 [16.45] damage with a 1.51x Precision Multiplier.

On Ammo Brick Pickup: 
Refills magazine.

While holding down the trigger:
Spins up the weapon, gradually granting up to 0.4x Fire Recovery Delay and +? Range over 1.38 seconds.
-15% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size while fully spun up.

Fires an explosive round every 18 shots, dealing 56 [21] damage over 4 meters with no damage falloff. 
Explosive Shot requirement is lowered to 8 while fully spun up.

↑Serious Business:
25% Flinch Resistance while fully spun up.

exotic_weapons.name: The Navigator
exotic_weapons.description:
Strand Adaptive Trace Rifle

Upon scoring 8 hits within 1 second of each on an ally:
Ally restores 60HP, begins Health Regeneration, and is granted Woven Mail. Wielder is granted Woven Mail and generates 5 Ammo.
If Shields are healed, then Shields will recharge, otherwise only up to Critical Health.

Upon scoring 20 hits within 1 second of each:
Inflicts sever, and grants the wielder Woven Mail.

While Woven Mail is active:
25% [5%] increased damage and +40 Ammo Generation.

↑Gordian Knot. Hold [Reload] to swap into Grapple Tangle Firing Mode. 
Grapple Tangle Mode shoots a Grapple Tangle up to 23.5 meters away at the cost of 1 Ammo.
Shows a preview of the Grapple Tangle impact spot while Alternate Fire Mode is active.
Incurs a 30 second cooldown before Alt Fire can be activated upon creating a Grapple Tangle. Must land on the ground for the timer to begin. Stowing swaps back to Trace Rifle Mode.

exotic_weapons.name: Thorn
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon 
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Direct hits corrupt, dealing 30 [0.4] Kinetic Damage after a 0.3 seconds delay, every 0.5 seconds 4 times, dealing up to 120 [1.6] Kinetic Damage over 2 seconds.
Corruption can be stacked.

Kills create a floating Remnant that home in towards the user while within 15 metres.
Remnants refill 4 Ammo, overflowing up to 40 Ammo, and grant Soul Devourer for an initial duration of 7 seconds on pickup.
Soul Devourer increases Corruption Damage by 200% [1750?%].
Picking up additional Remnants extend the duration of Soul Devourer by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Soul Devourer persists through stow.

↑Refined Soul: Passively grants +15 Range, +5 Stability, and +5 Airborne Effectiveness.
Scoring a kill or picking up a Remnant grant Refined Soul for 7 seconds.
Refined Soul grants additional +10? Range, +15? Handling, and +50 Mobility.
Picking up additional Remnants, or scoring additional kills extend the duration of Refined Soul by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Refined Soul remains active while stowed.

exotic_weapons.name: Touch of Malice
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle
Hold [Reload] to trigger Blight Launcher once charged. Swap Speed is tied to Reload Speed.
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Scoring Precision Hits grants a stack of Charged With Blight, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Charged With Blight grants up to +? Stability and +? Reload Speed at 10 stacks.
Blight Launcher Mode can be toggled once at 10 stacks. Does not refill the magazine.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each:
 Rank-And-File = 50% | Elites/Minibosses/Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 66.7%.
Begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

While Magazine = 1:
132% [30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP per shot, and refunds itself. Health Drain is not lethal.
Blight Launcher's Damage benefits from the Final Round's Damage Increase. Health Drain is affected by Damage Resist.

Blight Launcher:
Shoots a slow moving Blight that deals 220 [113] Arc Damage on direct impact, and has a damaging field that deals 3 damage, blinds and corrupts enemies.
Corrupt deals 27 [0.375?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds a total of 7 [4] times.
Enemies hit by the Blight receive 50% increased damage taken from Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.
Entering Blight Launcher Mode begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

↑Touch of Mercy:
Grants the Precision Instrument trait.
Precision Instrument lasts long enough to trigger Blight Launcher, shoot it, and then keep firing normally.

exotic_weapons.name: Traveler's Chosen
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Adaptive Sidearm

Kills grants a stack of Gathering Light, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Gathering Light grants +15 Handling, +15 Reload Speed, and +2 Aim Assist per stack.
Gathering Light stacks persist through stow.

Holding [Reload] will trigger a special reload animation, consuming all stacks of Gathering Light to provide Ability Energy.
Grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per Gathering Light stack

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +2 Magazine Size (15 -> 17), the Osmosis trait, and the Surplus trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Verglas Curve
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Lightweight Bow
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Kills grant a stack of Hail Barrage, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Hipfiring releases every stored Hail Barage Arrow in a volley, spread out evenly. 
Hail Barrage stacks persist through stow.

Hail Barrage Arrows create a Large Stasis Crystal on impact, and inflict x100 [x60 for 1+1 seconds] Slow on direct hit.

Deals 50% increased damage against Frozen Enemies and Stasis Crystals. Stacks multiplicatively with Whisper of Rending and Frozen Enemy Multipliers.

↑Shiver Quiver:
0.65x Draw Time Multiplier for 5 seconds upon inflicting freeze or slow.

exotic_weapons.name: Vigilance Wing
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic 5-Round Burst High-Impact Pulse Rifle

Shoots a burst of 5 bullets, each dealing 41 [16] damage with a 1.63x Precision Multiplier.
Only weapon in the game with deterministic recoil.

On Ally Death within 24 metres:
+20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 m/s to 8.5m/s, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 6 seconds.
Begins Health Regeneration.

While Last Guardian Standing or Solo: 
+100 Health Stat, +X Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Ensemble trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Wicked Implement
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle

Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 4.5 seconds of each grants Creeping Attrition for 4.5 seconds. 
Additional Precision Hits refresh the duration of Creeping Attrition.
Creeping Attrition is removed on stow.

While Creeping Attrition is active:
Precision Hits inflict x40 [x20] Slow for 4+4 [4+2] seconds. 

Scoring a Precision Kill or shattering a Stasis Crystal creates a Small Stasis Shard that returns to the wielder.
 Incurs a 2 second cooldown between spawning shards.

Collecting a Stasis Shard or destroying a Stasis Crystals refills the Magazine.

↑Hadopelagic Tribute: 
Stasis Shards additionally overflow +5 Ammo on pickup, overflowing up to 100% Increased Magazine Capacity, and the Headstone trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Wish-Ender
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Lightweight Combat Bow

[ADS] while fully-drawn grants Truesight, displaying enemy silhouettes through walls up to 64 metres away.
Truesight lasts until no longer ADS, or after 3 seconds of being active. Must fully redraw to reactivate the perk.

Arrows deal a total of 1,164 [159] damage split into 3 [2] different damage instances.
The initial arrow impact deals up to 276 [129] damage with a 1.79x Precision Multiplier.
The two [one] instances from Broadhead deal up to 444 [28.75] damage and are not affected by Precision Hits.
Draw Strength affects the damage of all damage instances.

25% Increased damage against Combatants stuck by Witherhoard's Blight. 
10% Increased damage against Taken Combatants.

↑Catalyst: Grants the One For All trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Wish-Keeper
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Strand Precision Bow

Precision Hits and Kills charge up Snareweaver Arrows. Snareweaver requires 6 charges to be activated.
Precision Hits = 1 | Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite+ = 2 | Guardian = 3
When fully charged, hipfire to shoot a Snareweaver Arrow.

Snareweaver Arrow:
Hitting an enemy directly releases a snare underneath them and inflicts suspend.
Creates a snare with 6 linked traps in a ⏏ shape on impact. Traps last 15 seconds and have 10 HP. 
Enemies that come into contact with the linked traps are dealt 341 [5] damage and become suspended.
Suspending 2 enemies breaks a beam. A snare can suspend up to 6 enemies. 
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between repeated suspensions on a single enemy.

Deals 50% [20%] increased damage against Suspended enemies.
Bodyshot Hits against Suspended enemies deal an additional 50% increased damage. Displays as yellow numbers, but will not be counted as Precision Hits.
Precision Hits against Suspended Elite Combatants deal 701 damage while Bodyshots deal 806 damage.

Upon suspending an enemy, or upon damaging a Suspended enemy with this weapon:
+100 Reload Speed and 0.7x Draw Time Multiplier for ? seconds.

↑Catalyst grants multiple craftable traits:
Enduring Snare Refit increases Snareweaver Trap duration by +10 seconds, to 25 seconds.
Multi-threaded Snare Refit increases the maximum amount of suspensions per trap to 3, totalling a maximum of 18 suspensions. 
Hatchling trait or the Vorpal Weapon trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Witherhoard
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Breech-Loaded Grenade Launcher

Fires projectiles that detonate upon impacting the floor, dealing up to 172 [51] damage over 6 meters, down to 0% damage, and creating blighted ground on impact.
Blighted Ground lasts for 4.5 seconds and covers a 4.5 metre radius upon landing on the ground.
 Enemies take 86 [40] damage every 0.3 seconds while standing over blighted ground.

Direct hits deal 52 [10] impact damage and blight the enemy, dealing 172 [80] damage every 0.6 seconds for 9.5 seconds.
Direct hits against Blighted Enemy increases the impact damage to 773 [?] damage.
Blighted Enemies drop a Witherhoard projectile underneath them on death.

Enemies can only simultaneously take damage from directly being Blighted and standing over blighted ground.

Malfeasance and Wish-Ender deal 25% increased damage against Blighted Enemies.

↑Silent Alarm:
Passively grants +40 Handling and automatically refills after being stowed for 2 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Borealis
exotic_weapons.description:
Multi-Element Aggressive Sniper Rifle
[Reload] switches between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.
Chosen element persists through stow and death. Defaults to Void Element.

Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon inflicting or receiving an Elemental Effect that matches the currently selected Element.

Breaking a Matching Shield refills the Magazine and grants 5 stacks of Ionic Return, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Guardians in their Super Ability count as having an Elemental Shield that matches the element of their Super.

 Ionic Return:
Consumes a stack upon firing.
15% increased damage and 19% increased Precision Damage. 
37% total increased Precision damage over base.
Ionic Return shots persist through stow and reloads.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Reload Speed and the Shield Disorient trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Buried Bloodline
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Rocket-Assisted Frame Sidearm

Fires two tracking bolts per shot, each dealing 249 [42.3] Void Damage with a 1.2x Precision Multiplier.

Each bolt restores 11 HP upon scoring a hit.

Kills progress a counter that grants Devour upon reaching 100%. Counter has no timer. Kills will not count while Devour is active.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite+ = 100% | Guardians = 25%

↑Splitvein Lineage: 
While Devour is active:
Hits inflict Weaken for 5 [?] seconds.
+? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier.

exotic_weapons.name: Centrifuse
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Precision Auto Rifle

Refills 10% Ammo every 0.34 seconds while sprinting.

Sprinting, sliding, and shooting builds up charge, granting up to +? Range and +? Reload Speed. 
Shooting = +20%/s after firing 3 rounds automatically | Sliding = +10% Charge per slide.
Sprinting = +20% Charge/s after a 0.25 second delay. Movement Speed must be above ~6m/s to build up charge.
Charge decays at a rate of -33% per second after not doing any of those actions for 1.1 seconds. Manual Reloads instantly empty the charge.

Kills while at ≥40% Charge cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 95 [76] Damage, down to 30% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius.
Explosions triggered while at 100% Charge deal 189 [?] Damage, down to 40% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 8 meter radius.

Passively generates 7% Charge per second and removes Passive Decay while Amplified.
 Passive Charge is additive to Active Charge. Manual Reloads still empty the charge.

exotic_weapons.name: Choir of One
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Special Ammo Void Command Frame Auto Rifle
Projectiles despawn after 100 meters.

Fanatical Lance is mechanically identical to Radiolaria Transponder, with massively increased damage.
Explosion deals up to 239 [?] Void Damage, down to 0% damage over 7.5 meters.
Radiolaria Pool deals 123 [?] Arc Damage every second up to 5 times over 3 meters.

While hipfiring:
Shoots a single splitting projectile at the cost of 5 Ammo that spread into 5 slow-moving projectiles in a + pattern after 7.5 meters.
Initial projectile deals 98 [31] impact damage, and up to 849 [213] explosive damage, down to 30% damage over 3 meters.
Split projectiles each deal 17 [6] impact damage, and up to 170 [43] explosive damage, down to 30% damage over 3 meters.
Splits into fewer projectiles if Magazine <5. Does not deal self-damage.

While ADS:
Fires hitscan projectiles at the cost of 1 Ammo, with each dealing 243 [40.25] damage with a 1.79x Precision Multiplier.

Grants the option to slot-in Destabilizing Rounds, Onslaught, and Subsistence trait equivalents.

exotic_weapons.name: Cloudstrike
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Sniper Rifle

Upon scoring 3 Precision Hits within 6 seconds of each:
Grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Calls down a focused lightning strike that deals damage after 1.1 seconds, followed by a barrage of bolts after 0.5 seconds.
Focused Lightning Strikes deals up to 973 [300] damage, down to 0% damage over 7 meters.
Bolt Barrage releases 4 bolts spread out in an X pattern over the target, dealing up to 584 [180] damage, down to 25% damage over 5 meters and inflicting strong knockback. 
Enemies can only be hurt once per barrage. Precision Hit Counter is reset on stow. Bolt Barrage can deal severe self-damage.

Precision Kills instantly calls down a focused lightning strike and grant x5 Bolt Charge.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +25 Handling and the Triple Tap trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Coldheart
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Adaptive Trace Rifle

Steadily grants up to 80% increased damage as Energy is accumulated.
All energy is removed over 0.2 seconds after not generating energy for 1.05 seconds.

Upon dealing damage:
Grants 40% Energy/s for 1 second. 
Initial Charge has a 0.267 second delay before it starts incrementing. Not generating Energy for 1.05 seconds will remove all Energy over 0.2 seconds.

Upon picking up an Ionic Trace:
Slowly grants 50% Energy over 0.5 seconds.

While in the maximum damage state:
+100 Stability and +100 Reload Speed.
Hits spawn an Ionic Trace up to once every 2 seconds.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and the Supercharged Magazine trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Collective Obligation
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Adaptive Pulse Rifle

Scoring 27 hits leeches Void Debuffs in the order of Volatile -> Weaken -> Suppression. 
Scoring a hit against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs, or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly leeches said debuffs for Void Leech Mode.

Void Leech Mode:
Scoring a hit charges 1.3% Energy (76 hits).  Hits against Void-Debuffed Enemies charge 16.7% Energy (6 hits). 
Scoring a kill against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly charges Void Leech Mode.
Leeched Void Debuffs persist through stow. Void Leech Mode cannot be charged by self-applied debuffs.

Once charged, hold [Reload] to activate Void Leech for 15 [10] seconds.
Hits will inflict the Void Debuffs that were leeched and grants 20% increased damage.

Receiving Void Buffs refills Magazine. Reactivating Devour through kills also refills the magazine.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Repulsor Brace trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Dead Messenger
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Multi-Element Wave Frame Grenade Launcher
[Reload] switches between between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.
Chosen element persists through stow and death. Defaults to Void Element.

Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon inflicting or receiving an Elemental Effect that matches the currently selected Element.

Projectiles create 3 elemental waves, each dealing 581 [?] damage in an arc upon collision with the ground.
Elemental Waves can [can't] deal overlapping damage and travel 12 meters.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Turnabout trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Delicate Tomb
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Fusion Rifle
Fires a 16-bolt burst. ADS overlaps each bolt into 2.

Hipfired Bolts deal 20% increased damage.

Kills have a chance to spawn an Ionic Trace. 
Rank-And-File = 10% | Elites+ = 100% | Guardians = 100%

Picking up an Ionic Trace grants Tempest Cascade.
Tempest Cascade grants the next shot 100% [7%] increased damage and Jolt on hit.
Tempest Cascade can be triggered while stowed, and persists through stow.

↑Ionic Interment:
Refills 4 Ammo upon picking up an Ionic Trace.

exotic_weapons.name: Devil's Ruin
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Adaptive Sidearm

Kills spawn a Firesprite.
Picking up a Firesprite grants Pyrogenesis Available.

Hits against Suspended Enemies inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Killing a Suspended Enemy triggers an ignition.

Hold [Reload] while Pyrogenesis Available is active to perform a special reload that grants Pyrogenesis Ready.
Pyrogenesis Available and Ready persists through stow.

Pyrogenesis:
Continuous beam that charges over 0.5 seconds.
Deals 104 [22] Damage with a 1.6x Precision Multiplier, as well as inflicting x20+10 Scorch per hit up to 16 times over 0.95 seconds at 900RPM.
Laser Kills trigger an ignition.
Magazine is refilled upon firing Pyrogenesis.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Collective Action trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Divinity
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Trace Rifle
Deals half the damage of a regular Trace Rifle.

Fires a continuous beam that deals 21 [7.5] Arc Damage with a 1.38x Precision Multiplier at 900RPM.

Scoring 10 [5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each weakens, increasing damage taken by 15% [15%], and inflicting censured, creating a Precision Cage for 1.25 seconds. 
Shots that hit the Precision Cage are converted into into Precision Hits, but do not count as Weakspot Hits.
Weapons that cannot deal Precision Damage, such as Rocket Launchers and Fusion Rifles do not benefit from Precision Hits.
Divinity's weaken increases Divinity Damage by 30%.

 Enemies that remain in the Precision Field for 3.75 seconds suffer from Penance, receiving 1,735 [520] damage. Damage assumes the weaken, of course. 
Penance's timer is set to 3 seconds after the initial strike.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Focused Fury and Jolting Feedback traits. 
Penance damage is Weapon Damage and will be increased.

exotic_weapons.name: Duality
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Precision Pellet and Pinpoint Slug Revolver Shotgun
Hipfire shoots pellets, while ADS shoots slugs. Passively has 5% Increased Damage Falloff Distance.
Reloads its entire magazine at once.

Hipfiring | Fires a spread of 12 pellets, each dealing 104 [?] damage with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier.
Scoring a Pellet Kill or 10 Pellet Hits in one shot grants a stack of On Black Wings for 10.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Retriggering On Black Wings refreshes its duration.

ADS | Fires a single Precision Slug that deals 1,081 [?] damage with a 1.75x Precision Multiplier.
Slug Precision Hits refresh the On Black Wings duration to 10.5 seconds.

On Black Wings x1 = +3.5% [?%] Pellet Precision Damage | +15.6% [?%] Slug Precison Damage | +? Reload Speed
On Black Wings x2 = +8.8% [?%] Pellet Precision Damage | +39% [?%] Slug Precision Damage | +? Reload Speed
On Black Wings x3 = +12.4% [?%] Pellet Precision Damage | +54.7% [?%] Slug Precision Damage | +? Reload Speed
On Black Wings persists through stow.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Range and increases Magazine by 2 (6 -> 8).

exotic_weapons.name: Edge of Action
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Void Adaptive Glaive

After scoring 6 Hits, either through Projectile or Melee Damage:
Hold [Reload] to prepare a Gumdrop Protective Shield for the next shot, refilling the Magazine, and generating +1 Ammo.
Projectile hits grant 2 stacks.

Remote Shield:
Lasts 20 seconds and has 2,400 Construct HP with 85% Damage Resist against non-Boss Combatants, and 15% Damage Resist against Bosses.
Remote Shield blocks incoming and outgoing projectiles, preventing damage from the outside.
While in the Protective Shield: 45 HP Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds at a rate of once per second and Remote Shield for 10 seconds.
Remote Shield Buff | +? Handling, +? Reload Speed, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage. Buff duration is refreshed while inside. 
Helm of Saint-14 Interaction | Remote Shield allows triggering The Saint's Suppression Burst with the same conditionals.
Remote Shield's Overshield gains and weapon buffs persist where it was created even if the shield is broken.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Repulsor Brace trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Edge of Concurrence
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Arc Rapid-Fire Glaive

After scoring 6 Hits, either through Projectile or Melee Damage:
Hold [Reload] to prepare a Lightning Seeker for the next shot, refilling and overflowing the magazine by +1, and generating +1 Ammo.

Lightning Seeker chases after the closest enemy within 32 metres, dealing 1634 [a lot] damage, inflicting Jolt, and releasing Chain Lightning on impact.
Chain Lightning damages up to 4 enemies within 10 metres, dealing 65 damage to each enemy.

exotic_weapons.name: Edge of Intent
exotic_weapons.description:

After scoring 6 Hits, either through Projectile or Melee Damage:

A Healing Turret can release up to 3 Healing Seekers over its lifetime.

Healing Seekers bestow x1 Cure and x1 Restoration for 4+2 [3+1.5] seconds in a 7.5 metre radius.
While Touch of Flame is equipped by the wearer and ONLY for the wearer | Seekers bestow x2 Cure and x2 Restoration for 4+2 [?+?] seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Ergo Sum
exotic_weapons.description:

44% increased damage and +50 Charge Rate.

exotic_weapons.description:

Powered Heavy Attack Hits inflict Sacred Flame to enemies.
Enemies affected by Sacred Flame explode on Light Attack or upon death, dealing up to 136 [?] damage over 5 meters.

exotic_weapons.name: Ergo Sum
exotic_weapons.description:
Continuation of the Ergo Sum Exotic, for traits that are only available on Void Element variations.

Powered Heavy Attacks release multiple Telesto bolts around it, each dealing up to 68 OR 117 [83] explosive damage. Damage is random? Kinda fitting, no?

exotic_weapons.name: Eriana's Vow

Fires a single Shield-Piercing bullet that deals 674 [77] Damage with 1.6x Precision Multiplier.

Death At First Glance grants 32.5% increased damage and highlight targets while ADS for the first scoped shot.
Precision Hits and Hits against Combatant Shields maintain Death At First Glance.

Breaking a Solar Shield or Barrier Champion's Shield triggers an Ignition.
Guardians in their Super Ability count as having an Elemental Shield that matches the element of their Super.

↑More to Give:
Passively grants +3 Magazine Size (6 -> 9) and an Auto-Loading Holster trait equivalent.

exotic_weapons.name: Ex Diris
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Moth-Grenade Launcher 
Does not require reloading. Moths count as Weapon Damage.

Shoots arcing projectiles that deal 422 [21] impact damage, and up to 355 [119] explosive damage, down to 30% damage over a 4.5 meter radius.

Builds up 25% Enrage on hit, gradually granting up to 0.6x Fire Recovery Delay.
Reaching Critical Health maxes out Enrage.
Charge decays over 9.5 seconds. Charge doesn't decay while at Critical Health.

Upon scoring a kill, or 2 Direct Hits within ? seconds of each: 
Creates a Loyal Arc Moth, which seeks the closest enemy and detonates on contact.
Arc Moth deals up to 596 [31 Guardians | 201 Constructs] explosive Arc Weapon Damage over 7 meters, down to ?% damage and blinding.
Moths don't deal self-damage. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Moth spawns.
Mothkeeper's Wraps creates a Loyal Void Moth alongside the Loyal Arc Moth. Loyal Void Moths grant 22.5HP Void Overshield to the nearest ally.

↑Berserk Rush:
Grants Amplified on kill. 
Hits while Amplified grant 50% Enrage on hit.

exotic_weapons.name: Fighting Lion
exotic_weapons.description:
Primary Ammo Void Breech-Loaded Grenade Launcher.
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Fires bouncing grenades that can be remotely detonated after ~0.3 seconds.
Grenades deal 142 [?] Impact Damage and up to 559 [?] Explosive Damage, down to 30% Damage over 4.5 meters.
Direct Hits trigger a Volatile Burst, inflicting Volatile to enemies within 7.5 meters.

+30 Reload Speed as well as the Chimera trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Graviton Lance
exotic_weapons.description:
Heavy Burst Void Pulse Rifle.

The 1st round of a burst deals 15% decreased damage but has no recoil.
The 2nd round of a burst deals 35.3% increased damage, has no damage falloff, and has recoil.
Total damage per burst matches that of a Heavy Burst Pulse Rifle.

Kills fling enemies backwards and trigger a Void Explosion that deals up to 470 [100] damage, down to 0% damage over 7 meter radius and releases 2 seeking Void orbs.
Seeking Void Orbs each deal up to 51 [20?] damage on explosion.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Range, the Turnabout trait, and the Vorpal Weapon trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Graviton Spike
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Arc + Stasis Modal Hand Cannon
[Reload] to swap between 150RPM Arc Firing Mode and 95RPM Stasis Firing Mode, refilling 3 Ammo.

Scoring a combined total of 3 Kills and Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants Overcharge to the opposite element.
Overcharge progress persists through stow and reload, but is cleared upon swapping firing modes.
Overcharge begins passively draining at a rate of -4.5% per second upon fully charging, even while stowed. 

150RPM Arc Mode:
Fires bullets that deal 141 [42.03] Damage with a 1.85x Precision Multiplier.

Arc Overcharge:
Kills and Precision Hits call down a lightning strike, dealing up to 262, down to 0% damage over 2 meters + 240 over 5 meters = 502 [21 + 21 = 42] Arc Damage.
Each Precision Hit consumes 34% Arc Overcharge. Hitting Stasis Crystals will consume 34% Arc Overcharge to call down a lightning strike on them.

95RPM Stasis Mode:
Fires explosive bullets that deal 185 [43.2] Impact Damage and up to 149 [21.02] Explosive Damage, down to 0% damage over 3 meters with a 1.85x Precision Multiplier.

Stasis Overcharge:
 Kills and Precision Hits trigger a Stasis Explosion that deals up to 126 [?] Damage, down to 0% damage over 7 meters and create 2 seekers perpendicular to the target.
Seekers spawn a Medium Stasis Crystal rotated 45 degrees away from the enemy after traveling 4 meters, forming a \  / shape.

Temporal Alignment Refit grants 20% [?%] increased damage for 16 seconds upon triggering both Arc and Stasis overcharge.

Other options include the Rapid Hit trait, the Subsistence trait, and the Transcendent Moment trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Hard Light
exotic_weapons.description:
Multi-Element Adaptive Auto Rifle
[Reload] switches between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.
Chosen element persists through stow and death. Defaults to Void Element.

Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon inflicting or receiving an Elemental Effect that matches the currently selected Element.

Damage Falloff End stops at 0.7x instead of the usual 0.5x for Auto Rifles.

Bullets can ricochet up two times from sharper angles.
Bullets that have ricochet at least once deal 100% [35%] increased damage.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +25 Stability and the Light Touch trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Heirloom
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Combat Crossbow Balanced Heat Blaster
Passively dissipates 15 Heat per second. Has the Perfect Vent Balanced Heat Weapon Mechanic.

Fires explosive bolts that explode on impact and generate 130 Heat per shot.
Bolts deal 406 [70] Impact Damage with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier and up to 539 [40] Explosive Damage, down to 50% Explosive Damage over 4 meters on impact.

Aiming Down Sights generates 30 Heat every 0.3 seconds and increases the Charge Level up to 3 times.
Charge Levels increase the damage and explosive radius of the next shot fired.

Charged Shots:
x1 | 602 [71] Impact Damage, 631 [41] Explosive Damage, ↑and x20+0 Scorch over 5 meters after 0.5 seconds of charging. Generates 200 Heat upon firing.
x2 | 897 [80] Impact Damage, 688 [49] Explosive Damage, ↑and x40+0 Scorch over 6 meters after 1.2 seconds of charging. Generates 300 Heat upon firing.
x3 | 1,216 [106] Impact Damage, 1032 [81] Explosive Damage, ↑and x60+0 Scorch over ~9.5 meters after 1.8 seconds of charging. Generates 340 Heat upon firing.

↑Heirloom Catalyst:
Direct Hits with charged shots inflict x20 Scorch per Charge Level.

Grants the Incandescent trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Hierarchy of Needs
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Lightweight Combat Bow
Unique Damage Profile similar to Precision Bows that uses Lightweight Draw Curves.

Guidance Ring charges persist through stow.

Guidance Ring:
Spawned by firing a fully-drawn hipfired shot while at x3 Guidance Ring Charges.
 Guidance Ring lasts for 20 seconds and rotates to face its owner. Only 3 Guidance Ring may exist at once across all players. Only 1 Ring per user.
Arrows release explosive seeking projectiles for each Guidance Ring they pass through, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers per shot.
Precision Hits guide the Seekers towards the hit enemy.
Bows require a half-draw minimum to release seekers.

Seeking Projectiles:

Seeker Damage is counted as Matching Weapon Explosive Damage and will be increased by Weapon Buffs/Surges. Surges must match the Weapon's element!
Seekers can benefit from Volatile Rounds, Unraveling Rounds, and more!

Hierarchy of Needs releases 3 Seekers, each dealing up to 193 [15?] Damage.
Primary Ammo Bows (Including non-listed Exotics) release 2 Seekers, each dealing up to 138 Weapon-Matching Damage. Ticuu's Hipfire releases 3 Seekers.
Trinity Ghoul = 3 x 179 | Wish-Ender = 2 x 167 | Buried Bloodline = 2 x 120 | Heirloom = 2 x 40
Crossbows = 2 x 153 Matching | Leviathan's Breath = 2 x 18

Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver = 3 x 136 per volley | Shadowshot: Deadfall = 6 x 136 per usage
Shadowshot Seekers are counted as Void Super Damage and DON'T scale with Weapon Buffs! They scale with Super Buffs!

↑Panoptic Tessellation: Upon deploying a Guidance Ring or scoring a hit with a seeking projectile:
 -40% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size, 0.5x Draw Time Multiplier, 100? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5 seconds.
 Scoring additional seeker hits or redeploying a Guidance Ring refreshes the buff duration.

exotic_weapons.name: Ice Breaker

Scoring a Precision Kill or shattering a Frozen Enemy triggers an ignition.

Every 10? seconds, the first hit always generates Ammo. Every other hit generates Ammo.

exotic_weapons.name: Jötunn

Projectile deals 1,184 [?] Impact Damage and up to 269 [?] Explosive Damage, down to 0% damage over 7 meters.

exotic_weapons.name: Lodestar

Hipfire | Becomes an Adaptive Trace Rifle that deals 34 [?] Damage with a 1.35x Precision Multiplier.

30% increased damage against Arc-Debuffed Enemies.
Killing an Arc-Debuffed Enemy causes them to explode on death, dealing up to 100 [?] Arc Damage, down to 0% damage, and inflicting blind over 8 meters.

exotic_weapons.name: Lorentz Driver
exotic_weapons.description:

 Telemetry Patterns:

exotic_weapons.description:
Solar High-Impact Fusion Rifle

 Additional hits refresh the Conserve Momentum duration. Buff persists through reloads.

Scales down to 0.2x Charge Time Multiplier (216ms) and 11.93% decreased damage after 15 (3 bursts) hits.

exotic_weapons.name: Prometheus Lens
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Trace Rifle

After 0.45 seconds of holding down the trigger:
Creates an expanding Scorching Field, that fully expands to a 1 metre radius over 4 seconds.
Scorching Field deals 19 [6] damage every 0.1 seconds. 

Upon scoring 20 damage instances (including Scorching Field) within 1.5 seconds of each:
Inflicts x20+10 Scorch.

Kills refill 75 Ammo.

exotic_weapons.name: Red Death Reformed
exotic_weapons.description:

Upon scoring a Weapon Kill:

x1 = +? Handling | ?% Flinch Resist | ?% Increased Movement Speed

10% [2%] while Shield HP is <114 | 20% [4%] while Shield HP is <60 | 40% [6%] while Shield HP is 0.

Scoring 2 [1?] Weapon Kills grants Red Death Charged.

exotic_weapons.name: Riskrunner
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Adaptive Submachine Gun

Receiving Arc Damage activates Arc Conductor for 6 seconds.
Scoring additional Direct Impact Kills extends the Arc Conductor buff duration by +3 seconds, up to 6 seconds.

Arc Conductor:
Firing has a 33?% chance to fully refill the magazine.
10% increased damage, +100 Handling, and 50% [15%] Arc Damage Resist.
Scoring 2–3 hits within 0.2 seconds of each causes the enemy to release weak chain lightning.
Weak Chain Lightning deals 21 [?] damage to the closest enemy within 8 metres.
Enemies hit by Weak Chain Lightning release additional Strong Chain Lightning that deals 28 [?] damage.

exotic_weapons.name: Ruinous Effigy
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.4x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills collapse enemies into Transmutation Spheres with 30 Ammo. Spheres can remain on the ground for up to 30 seconds. 

Transmutation Spheres are pickupable objects that are able to use Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, and Guard/Drain. Dropping a Transmutation Sphere immediately despawns it.
Ammo is passively drained at a rate of 1 Ammo Per Second. Attacking or Guarding disables passive drain until the Attack Animation is finished or until no longer Guarding.

Transmutation Spheres:
They are considered Generic Void Weapons, and their damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs, as well as Activity Surges and other generic Void Damage buffs. 
They are also able to inflict Volatile through Volatile Rounds. 
Spheres will not trigger, nor be affected by any effect related to Melee Abilities, Void Abilities, Trace Rifles, or Weapon Surge Mods.

Light Attacks | Lunges forward, dealing 270 [150] damage, disorienting Combatants and consuming 1 Ammo. Airborne Attacks deal 25% decreased damage. Can attack twice every second.

Heavy Attacks | Slams the Sphere onto the ground, detonating it, dealing 1350 [300 Guardians | 1500 Constructs] damage without falloff and inflicting suppression to enemies within 5? metres. 
Damage is unaffected by the Ammo Remaining.

Guarding | Projects a draining field over a ? metre radius, dealing 28 [12] damage and restoring 5 HP per enemy hit every 0.3 seconds.
Grants 80% [50%] Damage Resist and prevents knockback while guarding. Combatants inside the draining field are disoriented.
Ammo Drains at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.25 seconds. The last remaining 3 Ammo drain at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.5 seconds until 1 Ammo is left.

Guarding while at 1 Ammo inflicts Transfiguration, dealing increasingly higher self-damage every 0.7 seconds until no longer Guarding or death. 
Self-Damage inflicted maxes out at 100 damage per tick and ignores all Damage Resist. Will eventually outright kill after enough time.

↑Deconstruction:
Upon scoring a Transmutation Sphere Kill or upon damaging a Miniboss+ with a Transmutation Sphere:
30% [15%] increased damage for 7 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Skyburner's Oath
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar High-Impact Cabal Slug Rifle

Hip-fire | Fires arcing projectiles that deal 43 [22] impact damage with a 2.97x Precision Multiplier and up to 55 [22] splash damage, down to 0% damage, inflicting x5+5 Scorch over a 3.5 meter radius.

exotic_weapons.name: Slayer's Fang
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Void Pinpoint Slug Frame Shotgun
Reloads its entire magazine at once.

Fires Slug Rounds that deal 638 [?] Damage with a 1.75x Precision Multiplier that release 7 bouncing, tracking submunitions on impact.
Submunitions deal 99 [5.03] Void Damage, bounce up to 3 times, and are unaffected by damage falloff.

Directly impacting an enemy will score a hit with every submunition
