 If the submunitions impact a surface, the redirection angle is increased to 360 degrees to enemies within 5 meters.

Scoring a kill or picking up a Void Breach grants Nightsworn Sight for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.
Buff persists through stow. Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters also receive the buff upon scoring a kill.

While Nightsworn Sight is active:
 15% increased Precision Damage and +? Reload Speed.
Submunition inflict Weaken, and bounce up to 4 times with higher tracking strength at the cost of 18% decreased damage.

exotic_weapons.name: Still Hunt
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Adaptive Sniper Rifle

Super Charge can be obtained while stowed, and persists through both stow and death. Rally Flags fully charge up Golden Gun Mode.

Golden Gun Mode:

exotic_weapons.name: Symmetry
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle.

Arc Seeker Mode:
Fires tracking bolts that deal up to 76 [50 Guardians | 25 Constructs] splash damage, down to 0% damage over a 3 meter radius at the cost of 2.6x Fire Recovery Delay.
Tracks to enemies within the aim-assist cone. Deals no self-damage.
Switching to Arc Seeker refills the magazine by an amount equal to Dynamic Charge stacks.

Precision Hits and Kills grant a stack of Dynamic Charge, up to a maximum of 15 stacks.
Dynamic Charge stacks each grant 30% [complicated, x3 = 3 STK and x7+ = 2STK | 30% Constructs] increased damage and increased splash radius to Arc Seeker mode.
x10 = 4 meter radius | x20 = 7 meter radius

 Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

[ADS] without firing gradually compresses the spread into an Amalgamation Round over 1 second.
Amalgamation Rounds deal 290% [18%] Increased Damage and highlight the enemy for the entire team for 5 seconds.
Amalgam Round is still 4 Void Projectiles that each have the stated damage increase!

Third Iteration deals 95% [6.7%] increased Spread Shot damage and 30% [6.7%] increased Amalgamation Round Damage to Highlighted Enemies.

On Marked Enemy Kill or Amalgamation Round Precision Kill:
Void Invisibility for 7+3.5 seconds and Truesight for 4 seconds.

Target explodes (twice, lol) in a Void Blast, inflicting weaken over 8 meters and then dealing up to 140 [?] Damage, down to 20% Damage over 5 meters.

exotic_weapons.description:

Drawing from the hip tracks up to 3 enemies, splitting 3 arrows amongst all marked targets on release.
Each arrow deals up to 29 [?] Damage and inflicts Sacred Flame on hit for 10 [5] seconds. 
Enemies afflicted by Sacred Flame explode upon being hit by aimed shots or upon death, dealing up to 295 [137] damage, down to 50% damage over 5.5 meters.

 Perfectly Drawn Precision Hits that trigger Sacred Flame explosions deal 100% increased explosion damage.

16% | 31% | 49% | 67.5% | 87% | 87% 
3.6% | 11% | 12% | 16% | 23% | 23%

Minimum of 9 Precision Hits + 1 Bodyshot required to charge without a kill.

Low-Power deals base damage. Medium-Power deals 32.2% [3%] increased damage. High-Power deals 68.7% [6.25%] increased damage.

Med 0.5s -> Low 1s -> High 1s -> Med 1.5s -> Low 1.5s -> Med 2s -> High 1.25s -> Low 1.25s -> Repeat

Picking up additional Orbs of Power extends the duration of Supercharged Battery by +10 seconds, up to 20 seconds.

Supercharged Battery:
Power Level to High.

exotic_weapons.name: Vex Mythoclast

Fusion Bolts deal 66 [?] Damage with a 1.8x Precision Multiplier.

Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 80% of all damage instances scored. Always rounds up. Counter persists through stow.
Requires scoring at least 9 hits for refill to activate. Always rounds up. 
No cooldown preventing hits from counting, unlike Rewind Rounds.

Kills in Auto Rifle Mode grants Overcharge stacks, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 1 | T3 and T4 = 2 | Guardians = 2

Linear Rifle Overcharge Mode: Hold [Reload] while at 6 Overcharge stacks to swap into Overcharge Mode.
Fires Linear Fusion Shots that deal 461 [168] damage with a 3.2x Precision Multiplier.
Linear Fusion Precision Kills trigger an ignition that deals 5% increased damage.
Each shot fired consumes 2 Overcharge Charges, allowing up to 3 shots per activation.
Overcharge is removed on stow. Fully refills magazine on deactivation.

↑Calculated Balance:
On Weapon Kill or upon scoring 15 hits within 3 seconds of each:
20% increased damage, +20? Stability, and -20% Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds for Auto Rifle Mode.
Damage buff persists through stow.

exotic_weapons.name: Vexcalibur
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Void Rapid-Fire Glaive
Projectile Hits grant 8% Weapon Energy per bolt.

Fires a spread of 5 bolts in an alternating + x pattern, each dealing 138 [28.85] damage.
Deals 25% increased projectile damage towards Vex Combatants. Melee Attacks disorient Non-Boss Vex Combatants.

While Blocking with Weapon Energy:
Gradually grants Void Overshield at a rate of 14 Overshield HP per second to the user and allies within 15 metres. Overshield lasts for 8+4 seconds.
Uniquely has 50% Damage Resist against Primary and Melee Damage from Guardians, compared to other Glaive's 30% against Primary and Melee Damage.

While any kind of Overshield is active:
Glaive Melee Attacks deal 20% increased damage. 
Glaive Melee Kills fully refill Void Overshield health and duration to 10+2 seconds and grant 100% Weapon Energy.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the option to slot-in Immovable Object, Grave Robber, and Replenishing Aegis trait equivalents.

exotic_weapons.name: Anarchy
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Trap Grenade Launcher

Fires Arc Bolts that stick to surfaces or enemies for up to 30 seconds. Up to 6 Arc Bolts can be simultaneously placed per Guardian.
Bolts that are within 15 metres of others will create an electrified tripwire between each linked bolt.
 Arc Bolts that are linked will all simultaneously trigger.
Bolts will not link to an ally's Anarchy Bolts.

Arc Bolts:
Deal ticks of 218 [35] damage every 0.5 seconds, down to 30% damage over a 4 meter radius for 10 seconds once triggered by detecting an enemy within 5 meters.
Linked Arc Bolts deal 435 [?] damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies touching the tripwire. Linked Arc Bolts only damage enemies in the tripwires.
Explode after 10 seconds of being triggered, or upon expiring, dealing 223 [40] damage, down to 50% damage over 4 meters.
Bolts created by allies do not interfere with damage, allowing each Guardian to deal their own independent damage.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Jolting Feedback trait.
Jolts on the 4th damage instance, 3 if Amplified.

exotic_weapons.name: Black Talon
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Projectile Sword

Unique Heavy Ranged Attack: 
Fires an explosive projectile, dealing 693 x 2 = 1386 [456? x 2] damage and inflicting Suppression over 3 meters, at the expense of 3 Ammo and 50% Sword Energy.
Dealing damage to a Suppressed Enemy with the Explosive Projectile inflicts Suppresion to enemies within 8 meters.
Two projectiles can be fired in quick succession with any amount of Sword Energy.
Projectile Attacks while at 0% Sword Energy deal 455 [152] damage, only deal direct impact damage, and only cost 1 Ammo.
Projectile Attacks deal 30% increased damage towards Rank-And-File Combatants.

↑Reversal: Effect does not trigger.
BUNGIE'S INTENT: Upon scoring a hit against Void-Debuffed Enemies:
10% | 20% | 30% increased damage until... a menu is open for at least a few seconds??. 
Effect scales with the amount of Void Debuffs on the enemy, maxing out at 3 debuffs.

exotic_weapons.name: D.A.R.C.I.
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Sniper Rifle
Utilizes Scout Rifle Animations, granting peripheral vision unlike other Sniper Rifles.

Upon aiming at an enemy for 0.5 seconds while scoped-in:
Highlights the enemy and displays Health and Shield Percentages, distance from target, and Power Level information.
Grants Target Acquired while an enemy is highlighted.
Highlight persists for 1 second after being off-target. Only highlights enemies within 150 metres.

Target Acquired:
Grants 18.35% increased damage, 31.34% increased Precision Damage, +? Aim Assist, -50% Recoil, -50% Accuracy Cone Size, and 50% Flinch Resistance.
Scoring a hit while Target Acquired is active inflicts Jolt.

↑Networked Targeting and passively grants +20 Stability:
Hits while Target Acquired is active grant a stack of Networked Targeting for 10.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks to the wielder and allies with Non-Exotic Sniper Rifles within 15 meters.
Bestowing x5 Networked Targeting stacks to an ally grants 15% increased DARCI damage.

Networked Targeting Bonuses:
+? | +? | +? | +? | +? Stability
+? | +? | +? | +? | +? Handling
+? | +? | +? | +? | +? Aim Assist
2.8% | 6.1% | 9.1% | 12.5% | 15.9% Increased Precision Damage
?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% Flinch Resist

exotic_weapons.name: Deathbringer
exotic_weapons.description:
Void High-Impact Rocket Launcher
 
Fires a slow-moving Void Orb that can be detonated midair by releasing [Fire], exploding on impact otherwise.

Detonation releases 7 Void Orbs that slowly descend and track enemies.
Void Orbs initially deal up to 211 [224] damage over ? meters, with their damage increasing based on how long they've existed.
Damage linearly increases up to 182.5% [47.7%] increased damage over 3 seconds. Maximum damage is indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.
Void Orbs do not deal self-damage.

↑Dead Weight:
Void Orbs' initial damage is increased by 63%, reducing the time needed to reach maximum damage to 2 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Deterministic Chaos
exotic_weapons.description:
Void High-Impact Machine Gun

While holding down the trigger:
Every 4th shot fires a Heavy Metal projectile that inflicts Volatile.
Every 4th Heavy Metal (16th shot) fires a Vexadecimal projectile that has increased recoil.
Every 2nd Vexadecimal Projectile (32nd shot) inflicts Weaken.

Releasing the trigger after firing a Vexadecimal projectile refills 12 Ammo.
Optimizing the Ammo Refill actively makes inflicting weaken impossible.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Target Lock trait.
Target Lock timer persists long enough to trigger the refill from firing a Vexadecimal projectile.
However, due to the aforementioned bug, it only triggers every 32 consecutive shots without stopping to actually weaken.
So... every trait of this weapon is antisynergistic with each other :')

exotic_weapons.name: Dragon's Breath
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar High-Impact Rocket Launcher
Uses a Fuel Counter to strengthen the effects of the Rocket. Always has x1 Fuel.

Passively gains 1 Fuel every 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 Fuel after 24 seconds. Ignitions within ? metres grant 2 Fuel. Reaching 5 Fuel refills the weapon. 
Shooting consumes all Fuel and halts passive Fuel generation for 3 seconds.

Rockets leave an Incendiary Trail as they travel.
Rockets embed themselves on direct impact, triggering small explosive bursts every 0.75 seconds that deal 70 [15] damage and release 3 Incendiary Pools each time.
Fuel increases the embed duration of the rocket, allowing it to Scorch more and spreading more Incendiary Pools, as well as granting it increased explosive damage.

Incendiary Pools deal 41 [74] damage and inflicts x40+20 Scorch every ? seconds in a ? meter radius for ? seconds.
Rockets' Incendiary Trail inflicts inflicts x50+20 Scorch.

1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 Fuel Stacks
1.5s | 2.25s | 3s | 3.75s | 4.5s Embed Duration
0% | 7.1% | 14.3% | 21.4% | 28.6% Increased Explosive Damage
3 | 6 | 9 | 12 | 15 Total Incendiary Pools

↑Pyromancer:
Time between passively gaining stacks of Fuel is decreased to 3 seconds, reaching 5 Fuel after 15 seconds. (It's not 12 seconds as shooting halts passive fuel generation for 3 seconds).
Kills spawn Firesprites without any cooldown between each pickup.

exotic_weapons.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Homing Volley Rocket Launcher

Fires 6 Rockets per Volley, with each Rocket exploding on proximity to an enemy, individually dealing up to 1,015 [215] Splash Damage over ~9 meters.

ADS over an enemy to mark them, up to 6 enemies.
Rocket Volley is split across all the marked enemies.

Killing 4 or more enemies with a single volley grants Adaptive Ordnance.
 Adaptive Ordnance generates 1 Ammo and grants the next full volley 50% increased damage.
Stowing Eyes of Tomorrow before the sixth rocket is fired preserves Adaptive Ordnance.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Blast Distributor and Demolitionist traits.

exotic_weapons.name: Fafnir
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Linear Fusion Rifle
Hold [Reload] to trigger Quantum Nova while having Ammo in reserves.

Hits deal 368 [?] Damage with a 3.44x Precision Multiplier.
Hits lacerate enemies, dealing 344 [?] Damage 3 times (1032 [☠️]) after 0.75 seconds.
Deals a total of 2297 [📁.zip] Damage on a Precision Hit.

Quantum Nova:
Consumes up to 9 Ammo in reserves to grant Quantum Nova for up to 20 seconds. Also refills the magazine.
1 Ammo = 4 seconds | 3 Ammo = 8s | 6 Ammo = 14s | 9 Ammo = 20s
Deals 1,420 [?] Damage and inflicts a 30% [?%] Weaken for 5 seconds over 10 meters upon triggering Quantum Nova, regardless of ammo consumption.
Timer is paused while stowed. Buff can be retriggered to extend its duration.

Hits while Quantum Nova is active inflict a stronger weaken that increases damage received by 30% [?%] for 5 seconds.

↑Catalyst: Grants the No Distractions trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Finality's Auger
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Turret-Placing Precision Linear Fusion Rifle
Hold [Reload] to switch between Create Turret Mode and Regular Linear Fusion Mode.

While in Create Turret Mode:
Firing consumes 3 Ammo, shooting a projectile that creates on impact Ruinscribe Turret and changing the firing mode to Ruinscribe Turret Mode.
Automatically refills magazine after creating a turret.

Ruinscribe Turret Mode:
Firing paints enemies within a 6 meter radius if targeted at a surface, or paints the enemy it is pointed at for 30 seconds.
Does not utilize ammo to marks surfaces or enemies in Ruinscribe Turret Mode, and can be used even at 0 Ammo.
Marks persist through Turret despawn or death.

Ruinscribe Turret:
Missile Turret that lasts for 25 seconds with a maximum targeting range of 70 meters. Turret has ? Construct HP.
Fires missiles that deal up to 359 [131] Solar Damage over 4 meters every 2 seconds. Targets the closest enemy in range.
Turret prioritizes Painted Enemies, firing a 3-Round Salvo towards the target, with each missile dealing up to 137 x 2 = 274 [55 x ? = ?] Solar Damage every 1.65 seconds.
Turret CAN self-destruct if hit by enough of its own missiles.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Bait and Switch trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Gjallarhorn
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Homing Rocket Launcher

Rockets release 8 Homing Cluster Missiles on explosion.
Cluster Missiles deal the same damage type as the Rocket Launcher that fired it. Cluster Damage is unaffected by Rocket Frame.

While within 15 metres of allies:
+50 Handling, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.

After shooting:
Allies within 15 metres receive Pack Hunter for 15 seconds, granting them Wolfpack Rounds for Non-Exotic Rocket Launchers.
Pack Hunter persists through stow.

↑More Wolves:
Passively grants +1 Magazine Size (1 -> 2).
Wolfpack Rounds Kills release an additional faster, homing rocket that deals 126.5% increased damage. 
Damage dealt by the More Wolves rocket is displayed in Yellow Damage Numbers and follows Wolfpack Rounds damage scaling.

exotic_weapons.name: Grand Overture
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Slug & Missile Launcher 

Slug Launcher slowly charges up over 1 second.
Slugs deal 1243 [259] damage and grant a stack of Missiles Loaded, up to a maximum of 20 stacks.

Missile Volley:
Hold [Reload] while at least one stack of Missiles Loaded is obtained to swap into Volley Firing Mode.
Fires Tracking Missiles in 5-round bursts which consume Missile Loaded stacks instead of ammo.
Missiles deal 250 [52] impact damage and up to 888 [185] explosive damage on hit.
Missile Volley persists through stow and can only be deactivated by running out of Missile Loaded stacks or dying 

↑Grand Overture Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability and +20 Handling.
 Missiles blind Combatants on hit. Missile Kills make enemies explode, dealing up to ? [?] damage in a ? radius.

exotic_weapons.name: Heartshadow
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Projectile Sword

Grants Shot in the Dark after being invisible for 0.25 seconds, for 2.5 seconds after Invisibility ends, or upon scoring a kill while Shot in the Dark is active.

Shot in the Dark:
25% increased damage and hits inflict Weaken for 6 [3] seconds.
Kills grant Void Invisibility for 6.3 secods.

Powered Grounded Heavy Attacks:
Consume 3 Ammo and grant Void Invisibility for 6.3 seconds.
Release a fan of 4 tracking Void Orbs up to ? meters forward, each dealing 507 [363] damage on detonation. 
Orbs have no damage falloff. Orbs deal an additional 30% increased damage towards Rank-And-File Combatants.

↑Wraithwalk:
Passively grants +6 Reserves (50 -> 56).
50?% Increased Movement Speed while Shot in the Dark is active.

exotic_weapons.name: Heir Apparent
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Rapid-Fire Machine Gun
[Aim-Down-Sights] to Spin up. Can only be fired after being spun up for 1.5 seconds.

While at Full HP and fully spun up:
Grants an Arc Shield over 1 second. 

Arc Shield:
Has a durability of 80 HP. Shield's durability recharges over 1 second after 2 seconds of not receiving damage if Shield HP is at full.
Provides immunity to Precision Damage, 50% Damage Resist against Kinetic Damage, and 15% Damage Resist against Non-Arc Elemental Damage.
Detonates when destroyed with Arc Damage, dealing 130 damage to the wielder and their nearby allies.

↑Legion's Bulwark:
Arc Shield is granted 75% [25%] Damage Resist.
Arc Shield refills 50% of Magazine upon being destroyed.

exotic_weapons.name: Legend of Acrius
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Pellet Shotgun
Reloads faster than it shoots, firing always at its maximum fire rate if reload cancels are used.

Fires 15 pellets in a wide spread which dissipate after 18 metres. Pellets have no damage falloff and can overpenetrate an unlimited amount of enemies.
Hits against grounded [all] enemies deal an additional damage instance that inflicts 135.2 [150] damage.

While Magazine has least 1 Ammo:
Increases Outer Ring Radar Range to a maximum of 80 metres.

↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +40 Reload Speed, +2 Magazine Size (4 -> 6) and +50 Ammo Generation, as well as the Trench Barrel trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Leviathan's Breath
exotic_weapons.description:
Comically Large Void Bow

Fully-drawn arrows deal 800 [death] Impact Damage with a 1.6x Precision Multiplier and create a concussive blast on impact.
Concussive Blast deals up 701 [death] Explosive Damage, inflicts Volatile, and heavily knocks enemies.

↑Colossal Quiver:
Passively grants +5 Total Ammo (9 -> 14), +80 Ammo Generation, and an unique version of Archer's Tempo that grants 0.563x Draw Time Multiplier. (0.75^2, technically)

exotic_weapons.name: Microcosm
exotic_weapons.description:
Kinetic Trace Rifle

Fires a continuous beam at 900RPM that deals 101 [?] Damage with a 1.35x Precision Multiplier.
Deals massively increased damage to Combatant Shields.

Kills grant bonus Super Energy, scaling with Enemy Tier.
 Tier 1 Combatant = ?% | T2 = ?% | T3 = ?% | T4 = ?% | Guardian = ?% 

On Super Ability Cast | Refills Weapon.
On Super Ability End: Paracausal Imbuement | 20% increased damage for 20 seconds.
Paracausal Imbuement persists through stow.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Stopping Power and Thresh traits.

exotic_weapons.name: One Thousand Voices
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Fusion Rifle

Shoots out a beam that ticks 10 times and marks 9 delayed explosion spots along its 0.6 seconds duration, each initially dealing 22 [11] damage. 
The last beam tick does not mark an explosion.

Marked spots detonate after 0.7 seconds of being created, each dealing up to 281 [100] damage and inflicting x10+5 Scorch over ? meters.
Solar Effects that are initially applied by One Thousand Voices deal 31.6% increased damage.

↑Fall From Grace:
Each detonation releases a Taken Seeker that aggressively targets enemies, dealing 84 [?] Impact Damage as well as 22 additional DoT ticks.
Each tick deals 13 [?] damage every 0.25 seconds for 5.65 seconds, dealing a total of ? [?] damage.
An enemy can be afflicted by up to ~5 seekers at once.
Blighted Enemies (Witherhoard Direct Hit)  receive 100% increased tick damage.

Has no interactions with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.

exotic_weapons.name: Salvation's Grip
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Grenade Launcher

Deals 25% increased damage to Frozen Enemies and always destroys Stasis Crystals.
Damage Buff stacks with Frozen Enemy Modifiers.

Uncharged Shots fire Stasis Grenades that destroy Stasis Crystals on hit.
Shattering 3 crystals within ? seconds of each with uncharged shots refills the magazine. 
Destroying a large amount of Stasis Crystals does not result in all of them exploding instantly for performance reasons. 

Charged Shots create Stasis Crystals in a ▼ shape.
Salvation's Grip's Stasis Crystals deal up to 183 [?] Stasis Weapon Damage, down to 60% damage over 8 meters upon being shattered.
Creates a Small Crystal on impact, with 2 Medium Crystals spread out in a V formation, followed by 3 Large Crystals diagonally, with the middle one being behind the Small Crystal.
Displays a preview of where the projectile will land while [Fire] is held.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Rimestealer trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Service of Luzaku
exotic_weapons.description:
Strand Support High-Impact Machine Gun
Shares MOST Healing Mechanics with Support Frame Auto Rifles. Threadlings from Rapid Healing and Nests both count as Weapon Damage.

Scoring a hit grants 10% Healing Charge. Does NOT get charge from damage from other sources, nor is it scaled by damage.
Hipfired Healing Shots do not consume ammo, expend 2% Healing Charge to restore 30 HP, and refill 2 Ammo at an increased 600 RPM.

Upon scoring 5 healing hits within 1 second of each on allies or Teeming Nests:
The next healing hits within 1 seconds of each on allies spawns 1 Threadling on them, and applies Support Frame Boost to the user and the targeted ally.
Rapid Healing a Teeming Nest ADDITIONALLY fully restores its health and also triggers Support Frame Boost.

Kills create a Teeming Nest.
Scoring a kill within 30 meters of a Teeming Nest instead spawn a Threadling on Enemy Death Location.

Teeming Nest: 300 Construct HP. Lasts for 17.5 seconds, constantly draining 6.7% (-20) HP per second 1.5 seconds after reaching Full Health.
Gives birth to a Threadling every 5 seconds.
Can be targeted by Service of Luzaku, restoring 11.5% (+1.5s) HP per shot.

↑Disorganized Attachment:
Nests become harvestable after giving birth to a total of 6 Threadlings.
Harvesting a Nest destroys it to grant a Throwable Tangle.

exotic_weapons.name: Sleeper Simulant
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Linear Fusion Rifle

Fires overpenetrating shots that deal 1.802 [death lol] Solar Damage with a 1.38x Precision Multiplier.
Shots pierce through unlimited enemies and refract upon impacting a surface, splitting into 5 lasers that deal 369 [145] damage.
Bosses take 18 damage from each refracted laser.

↑Deeper Pockets and Accelerated Coils:
Passively grants +2 Reserves (14 -> 16) and decreases Charge Time by 250ms (1024ms -> 774ms)
Charge Time Reduction does not decrease damage.

exotic_weapons.name: Parasite
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Worm Launcher

Kills grant stacks of Worm's Hunger, up to a maximum of 20 stacks.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 1 | T3 and T4 = 4 | Minibosses and Bosses = 5 | Guardians = 5

Worm's Hunger grants 10% increased damage and ?% larger Blast Radius per stack, up to 200% increased damage and ?% larger blast radius.
Worm's Hunger stacks persist through stow.

Receiving self-damage from the explosion grants the Worm Byproduct buff, increasing damage from other weapons by 15% for 10 seconds.
Deals a lot?% decreased self-damage. Worm Byproduct persists through stow. (obviously)

↑Catalyst: Grants the Envious Arsenal trait.

exotic_weapons.name: The Colony
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Arachnid-Grenade Launcher
Intrinsic Auto-Loading Holster equivalent.

Fires small, seeking arachnids that detonate on proximity to target. 
Arachnids can crawl on surfaces, and detonate after 2.5 seconds of landing on a surface.

Spawns additional arachnids on kills, depending on the Enemy Rank.
Rank-and-File = 2 | Elite = 3 | Miniboss+ = 6 | Guardians = 1

↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +1 Magazine Size (7 -> 8).

exotic_weapons.name: The Lament
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Chainsaw Sword

Restores 7HP per damage instances.

Banshee's Wail:
[Block] revs the blade, granting Banshee's Wail x1.
Hits while revved grant a stack of Banshee's Wail, up to x9 after 8 hits.
Banshee's Wail stacks are removed upon no longer attacking, running out of Sword Energy, or upon performing a Heavy Attack.

Revved Light Attack Strikes: Consume 20% Sword Energy per swing.
Deal 539 [389] Direct Damage, followed by two additional instances of 135 [95] Damage after 0.1 second.
Revved Light Attack Strikes after the first attack animation deal 33% increased direct damage.

Revved Heavy Attacks: Empties remaining Sword Energy.
Consume 2 Ammo to deal 2 hits of 198 [152] Damage each within 0.1 seconds of one another, ending with a strike that deals 1,054 [811] damage.
Performing a Revved Heavy Attacks consumes all Banshee's Wail stacks to deal increased damage based on the amount of stacks it consumed.
x1-x3 = Base Damage | x4-x6 = 54% Increased Damage | x7-x9 = 109% Increased Damage.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Burning Ambition trait.
Allows Scorch to be inflicted from a single Revved Light/Heavy Attack.
Scorch ticks also restore 7HP.

exotic_weapons.name: The Prospector
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Drum-Loaded Grenade Launcher

Grenades explode into 3 Cluster Bombs, each dealing up to 158 [50] damage over 4? meters.

↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +40 Blast Radius, +50 Reload Speed, and the Danger Zone trait.

exotic_weapons.name: The Queenbreaker
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Linear Fusion Rifle
Selectable Perks, between Marksman Sights | Combat Sights, and Hip-Fire Grip | Quickdraw. 
Hold [Reload] to quickly swap between Sights.

While Marksman Sights are equipped:
Grants +15 Range, +10 Zoom, and sets charge time to 0.633 seconds. 
Right-Side Scope displays ammo (Yellow Bar on the right) and charge level (Yellow circle on the right).

Shoots a single chaining bolt that deals 439 [180] Arc Damage with a 3.44x Precision Multiplier and inflicts blinds.
Hits chain up to 5 times towards the closest enemy within 10 meters, dealing 347 [?] Arc Damage and blinding. 
Enemies can only be damaged once per chain.

While Combat Sights are equipped:
Grants +10 Handling, +40 Aim Assist, sets charge time to 0.533 seconds and fires in 3-Round Bursts. 
Left-Side Scope displays ability energy. Left icon is Grenade. Right Icon is Melee. Wheel is Super.

Shoots a 3-Bolt Burst, dealing 191 x 3 = 573 [79 x 3 = 237] Arc Damage with a 3.44x Precision Multiplier per shot
Scoring 6 Hits within ? seconds of each grants Charge Accelerant for 5.5 seconds.

Charge Accelerant | 0.6x Charge Time Multiplier.
Charge Accelerant does not decrease damage per shot. Buff can be refreshed.

Catalyst:
Grants the Rewind Rounds trait.

exotic_weapons.name: The Wardcliff Coil
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Volley Rocket Launcher

Shoots a volley of 8 wildly imprecise rockets, each dealing 107 [22] impact and up to 1500 [300] explosive damage over ? meters.

Grants x1 Bolt Charge to the user and allies within ? meters for every 2 Rockets fired.

On Heavy Ammo Brick Pickup: 
Refills Magazine.

↑Pinpoint Guidance Module:
Passively grants slight tracking to the rockets.

exotic_weapons.name: Thunderlord
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Adaptive Machine Gun
Intrinsic Dynamic Sway Reduction, and reticle moves drastically less, akin to Zen Moment without needing hits.

While holding down the trigger:
0.75x Fire Recovery Delay after initially firing 13 rounds.
0.6x Fire Recovery Delay after firing a total of 26 shots.
Triggers a Lightning Strike every 10 hits or on kill, dealing up to 232 [65] damage in a 5 meter radius and granting x1 Bolt Charge.

↑Return Stroke:
Lightning Strikes refill 5 Ammo.

exotic_weapons.name: Tractor Cannon
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Blast Shotgun

Void Blast deals up to 491 x 2 [??] damage and knocks enemies back, down to a minimum of 10% damage over 10 meters.
Knockback has no effect on Minibosses and Bosses and scales with distance/enemy mass.

Void Blast hits inflict suppression and a stronger weaken that increases damage received by 30% for 10 seconds.

↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +3 Magazine Size (4 -> 7) and +3 Reserves (15 -> 18)

exotic_weapons.name: Truth
exotic_weapons.description:
Void Airburst Homing 3-Shot Rocket Launcher

Rockets lock-on to targets by aiming, and aggressively track locked-on enemies.
Truth Rockets deal up to 1821 [?] Damage over 11 meters, down to 0% damage, and have proximity detonation, automatically exploding within 2 metres from enemies.
Rockets cannot deal Impact Damage due to Proximity Detonation.

Dealing damage with 3 rockets without reloading generates +1 Ammo.
Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with 3 rockets grants Prototype Trueseeker.

Prototype Trueseeker:
Lasts until reloading or after dealing damage with 3 different rockets.
0.2x Fire Recovery Delay, +? Stability, massively improved tracking, and rockets explode into 8? Cluster Bombs on detonation.
Cluster Bombs each deal 177 [?] damage over 3 meters.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Reaper's Tithe trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Two-Tailed Fox
exotic_weapons.description:
Void + Solar + ↑Arc Homing Burst-Fire Rocket Launcher

Fires a burst of 2 ↑3 Rockets at the cost of 1 Ammo.
Each rocket deals 405 [?] impact damage and up to 1,419 [?] splash damage, down to 0% damage over 9 meters.

First rocket deals Void Damage and inflicts Suppression.
Second rocket deals Solar Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch. 

↑Third Tail:
Alters the two-burst into a three-burst fire, firing an additional Arc Rocket at the end of the burst.
The third rocket deals deals 102 [22] Impact Damage, up to 355 [76] Explosion Damage, and inflicts Jolt.

exotic_weapons.name: Whirling Ovation
exotic_weapons.description:
Strand + Solar Chargeable Rocket Launcher
Counts as a Strand Weapon for most purposes.

Holding [Fire] charges the weapon, increasing its damage the longer it is held, maxing out at 4.85 seconds.
Releasing [Fire], or holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds upon reaching 100% Charge shoots the weapon, fully emptying the Anticipation meter. 
Does not require reloading unless picking up an Ammo Brick while fully empty.

Anticipation:
Meter that charges over 160 seconds at base, which decreases the time needed to charge the weapon.
Dealing Kinetic Slot and Energy Slot Weapon Damage speeds up the rate at which Anticipation is filled, down to a minimum of 3 seconds to reach 100% Anticipation.
0% Anticipation = 4.85 seconds | 20% Anticipation = 4.25s | 40% Anticipation = 3.75s
60% Anticipation = 3.15 seconds | 80% Anticipation = 2.5s | 100% Anticipation = 2s.
Can't build up Anticipation while in the Fire Recovery Delay state.

Coronal Culmination:
<33% Charge | Fires a rapidly accelerating Strand Projectile that deals 1,076 [218] Strand Damage on impact.

34%–66% Charge | Projectile deals 1,663 [337] Damage. An additional Solar Explosion occurs after ? seconds, dealing up to 1,640 [255] Damage over 10 meters
Deals up to 3,303 damage per shot, 207% more damage than the previous charge level. 

67%–99% Charge | Projectile deals 2,251 [455] Damage. Solar Explosion deals up to 2,216 [345] Damage over 10 meters
Deals up to 4,467 damage per shot, 35% more damage than the 2nd charge level.

100% Charge | Projectile deals 3,360 [680] Damage. Solar Explosion deals up to 3,368 [523] Damage over 10 meters. Autofires after 0.4 seconds of reaching 100%.
Deals up to 6,728 damage per shot, 50% more damage than the 3rd charge, and 104% more damage than the 2nd charge level.

Strand Projectile benefits from Strand Weapon Surges. Solar Explosion benefits from Solar Weapon Surges.

↑Filled Determination:
Fully charged shots pierce through Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants, and create a Solar Grenade that lasts for ? seconds.
Solar Grenade benefits from Touch of Flame, but not Sunbracers.

exotic_weapons.name: Whisper of the Worm
exotic_weapons.description:
Craftable Solar Aggressive Sniper Rifle

Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine, generating 1 ammo and pulling 2 ammo from reserves.

↑Whispered Breathing:
Grants Whispered Breathing after 1.2 seconds of ADS without shooting, until no longer ADS.
Whispered Breathing grants 35% Increased Precision Damage and grants 10.777% increased damage against Combatants.

exotic_weapons.name: Winterbite
exotic_weapons.description:
Stasis Aggressive Glaive
Gains 25% Weapon Energy on each Freeze Orb hit.

Freeze Orb fires Explosive Projectiles every 0.5 seconds towards non-frozen enemies within 10 metres of it.
Explosive Projectiles inflict Freeze over a 3? meter radius and deal up to 60 [11] damage on impact.

Freeze Orb detonates on impact, dealing 1282 [250] damage and inflicting x60 Slow in a 10 metre radius.
Freeze Orb moves at a speed of 9.5 metres per second and has a maximum lifetime of ? seconds, being able to travel up to ? metres.

While Magazine is loaded with at least 1 Ammo:
Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and inflict x40 Slow for ?+? [1.5+0] seconds.
Boss Combatants only receive 20% increased damage.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Rimestealer trait.

exotic_weapons.name: Wolfsbane
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Heavy Axe
Uses Twilight Arsenal's Axes Animations. Sword Energy is visibly displayed in the Melee Ability icon.

Light Attacks deal 470 [377] Damage grant 30% Sword Energy and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 attacks or on kill.
Heavy Attacks, while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 Ammo to launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters forward, dealing 675 [301] Damage.
Airborne Heavy Attacks consume 2 Ammo and always send out a Solar Wave, regardless of Sword Energy.
Wolfsbane deals up to 25% increased damage against enemies with Outbreak Perfected's Nanites.

Quicksilver Nanites restore ? HP on pickup and grant ~4.5% Nano-Assault progress, requiring 21 Nanites to max out.
Hold [Reload] upon reaching 100% Nano-Assault to trigger Overclock.
Quicksilver Nanites generated from attacks against ~~ A F F L I C T E D enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites grant ?% increased Nano Assault progress.

Overclock | Enhanced Offensive Capabilities for 12 seconds.
Generates +14 Ammo, 25% increased damage, and 30% Sword Energy/s.
Heavy Attacks always launch a Solar Wave.
Fully Charged Heavy Attacks's Solar Wave explodes, dealing 421?? [376] Damage over ? meters and create a Swarm-Nado. Explosion has no falloff.
Swarm-Nado deals 55? [55] Damage every 0.3 seconds over 5? meters for 3 seconds.

Grants Damage Resist for 5 seconds upon scoring Light Attack Hits within 3? seconds of each.
Damage Resist strength and hit requirements are variable, with both being determined by the equipped handle.
Unyielding = 15% DR after 2 hits | Rampager's = 20% DR after 3 hits | Tenacious = 25% DR after 4 hits
Can be triggered even without Ammo. Can be refreshed by retriggering the Damage Resist effect.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in Relentless Strikes, Attrition Orbs, Burning Ambition, and SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION.
~RECURSION | Nanites restore an additional ? HP per stack of Nano-Assault. Spawns ? Nanites nearby every ? damage taken while Nano-Assault is active with a 2s CD.

exotic_weapons.name: Worldline Zero
exotic_weapons.description:
Arc Adaptive Sword

After sprinting for 1 second, while at 100% Sword Energy:
Grants Temporal Sprint until no longer sprinting.
 
Tesseract:
Grounded Powered Heavy Attack while Temporal Sprint is active launch a Heavy Blink Attack.
Heavy Blink Attacks drain 50% Sword Energy and consume 3 ammo.
Teleports the user 10 metres forward, dealing up to 530 [353] damage 7 times to enemies that are within 2 metres of the teleport path.
Scoring a Tesseract kill allows performing another Heavy Blink Attack within ? seconds that consume ? Ammo and drain 10% Sword Energy.

↑Another Dimension:
Temporal Sprint is granted after sprinting for 0.5 seconds.

exotic_weapons.name: Xenophage
exotic_weapons.description:
Solar Explosive Machine Gun

Fires Explosive Rounds that deal 262 [75?] Impact Damage and up to 898 [75?] Explosive Damage, down to 0% damage at 4.5 meters.

Recommended to hold down the trigger, as tapfiring reduces firerate.
This behavior is shared with most Automatic Weapons.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Chain Reaction and Rampage traits.

game_mechanics.base_health_and_shields:
Guardians possess, by default, 70 [100] Health Points with 34.5% Damage Resist against Combatants and 130 Shield Points, totalling ~237 effective HP against Combatants, or 230 in Crucible.
Health Stat above 100 grants additional Shield HP against Combatants, up to a maximum of +20 Shield HP at 200 Health Stat.

Health | Start of Health Recovery: 1.75 seconds. 
Health Recovery Rate: ~27.5% Health/s. (20 [30] HP/s)

Shields | Start of Shield Recharge: 5.3s.
Shield Recharge Rate: ~30% Shield/s. (39.5 Shields/s)
Damage dealt to Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.

↑Enhanced Health Stat grants up to 25% faster start of Shield Recharge and 50% increased Shield Recharge Rate at 200 stat.

modern_stats.description:
Picking up Orbs of Power restores Health, at a rate of +0.7 HP per point, up to +70 HP per Orb at 100 points.
Additionally grants 0.1% Flinch Resist while ADS per point, up to 10% Flinch Resist at 100 points.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Grants faster Shield Regeneration and increased Shield HP against Combatants per point above 100.
Provides up to 25% faster start of Shield Recharge, 50% increased Shield Recharge Rate and +20 Shield HP against Combatants at 200 points.

Grants ?% Additional Base Melee Ability Regeneration Rate and ?% Increased Melee Ability Gains.
Stat provides up to ?% Additional Base Melee Ability Regeneration Rate and ?% Increased Melee Ability Gains at 100 points.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Grants 0.3% [0.2%] more Melee Damage per point above 100.
Provides up to 1.3x [20%] Melee Damage at 200 points.
Works with Unpowered, Powered, and Glaive Melee Damage. Damage increase is multiplicative.

Grants Additional Base Grenade Ability Regeneration Rate and Increased Grenade Ability Gains.
Stat provides up to ?% Additional Base Grenade Ability Regeneration Rate and 211.5%% Increased Grenade Ability Gains at 100 points.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Grants 0.65% [0.2%] increased Grenade Ability Damage per point above 100.
Provides up to 65% [20%] increased Grenade Ability Damage at 200 points.

Grants Increased Super Ability Gains per point.
Provides up to ?% Increased Super Ability Chunk Gains at 100 points.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Grants 0.45% increased Super Ability Damage per point above 100.
Provides up to 45% increased Super Ability Damage at 200 points. 
Well of Radiance and Ward of Dawn instead receive up to 33% increased Super Ability Duration at 200 points.

Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate and Increased Class Ability Gains.
Stat provides up to ?% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate and 90% Increased Class Ability Gains at 100 points.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Class Ability Usage grants a Overshield for (Thruster/Dodge = 5 | Rift/Barricades = 10) seconds.
Overshield Health scales at a rate of 0.4 [0.1] HP per point, up to a maximum of 40 [10] HP Overshield at 200 points.
Damage dealt to the Overshield by Guardians is reduced by 50%, increasing its maximum eHP in PvP to 20.

Class Abilities that deal damage scale up by 0.65% [0.1?%] increased damage per point, up to 65% [10%] increased damage at 200 points.

Grants increased Handling and Reload Speed per point, up to 0.9x Handling Duration Multiplier and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier at 100 points.
Additionally increases Weapon Damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants by 0.15% per point, up to 15% increased Weapon Damage at 100 points.
Handling bonus doesn't exceed 100 Handling Stow Animation Duration.

↑ENHANCED BENEFIT
Ammo Bricks have a 1% chance to drop increased ammo per point above 100, up to 100% chance at 200 points.
Primary/Special Weapon Damage is increased by 0.15% against Bosses and 0.05% against Guardians per point, up to 15% [5%] Increased Weapon Damage at 200 points against Bosses and Guardians, respectively.

Power Weapon Damage is increased by 0.1% against Bosses and 0.05% against Guardians per point, up to 10% [5%] Increased Weapon Damage at 200 points.

champions.name: Barrier Champions
champions.description:
Barrier Champions summon an impenetrable Shield once their Health is lowered past a difficulty-determined HP Threshold. 
Barrier Champions constantly regenerate a portion of their Health while shielded.

The Shield can be damaged and broken through the usage of Anti-Barrier Effects, stunning the Champion for a brief time.
 The Shield's Durability is determined by difficulty.

Stunning prevents the Champion from attacking, moving, or using any abilities.
Dealing damage to the Shield briefly stops Health Regeneration.

Additional Shield-Piercing Effects:
Ignores Shielded-Affixed Bane Combatant Shields, Hydra Shields, Hobgoblin Immunity, (Taken) Phalanx Shields, Taken Vandal Shields, and Scorn Buckler Shields.
Weapons deal 30% increased damage towards Titan Barricades.

champions.name: Overload Champions
champions.description:
Overload Champions passively restore their Health over time, use abilities and weapons more frequently, and move erratically unless stunned through Disruption.
Stunning prevents the Champion from attacking, moving, or using any abilities.

Disrupted Combatants are bugged and no longer deal 25% less damage for 5 seconds.
Disrupting Guardians lowers their Ability Regeneration Rate by 0.4x.

Overload Champion Stunning Application:
 Arc Jolt stuns upon dealing damage to the Champion.
Stasis Slow stuns upon inflicting Slow Stacks to the Champion.
 Void Suppression stuns upon suppressing the Champion.

champions.name: Unstoppable Champions
champions.description:
Unstoppable Champions relentlessly chase enemies, and possess 70% Damage Resist unless stunned. 
Damage Numbers visually appear as Italic Desaturated Pink Numbers
Stunning removes the Damage Resist and prevents the Champion from attacking, moving, or using any abilities for the duration of the stun.

Unstoppable Shots tend to inflict more Stagger, with certain weapons/effects forcing a stagger.

Stunning Methods outside of Unstoppable Shots:
Arc Blind
Solar Ignition
Stasis Freeze/Shatter
 Strand Suspension

banes.name: Caltrops
banes.description:
Caltrops-Affixed Combatants drop an Elemental Pool every 2 seconds and on death.
Elemental Pools deal damage 4 times a second over 6 meters seconds for 5 seconds.

Caltrop Combatants will relentlessly chase after Guardians, preferring to stay within Melee Range.
Finishers are disabled against Caltrop Combatants.

banes.name: Cascade
banes.description:
Cascade-Affixed Combatants periodically shoot out a Stasis Seeker every 6.5 seconds in front of them that travels up to 60 meters away at a speed of 15m/s.
Stasis Seeker detonates upon impacting a wall or Guardian, inflicting x50 Slow over 6? meters for 4 seconds.

banes.name: Drain
banes.description:
Drain-Affixed Combatants instantly tether to all Guardians in line of sight within 50 meters, inflicting Umbral Drain on them.
Tether is removed upon losing line of sight or by being over 50 meters away.
Invisible Guardians cannot be targeted by the Drain Combatant.

Umbral Drain deals Moderate Non-Lethal Void Damage every ? seconds.

Inflicting Suppression on the Drain Combatant will disable its draining abilities while the debuff is active.
Invisible Guardians are unable to be tethered.

banes.name: Grasp
banes.description:
Grasp-Affixed Combatants periodically release multiple projectiles, with each turning into a Strand Turret.

Strand Turrets last for 10 seconds, shooting threads that deal Strand Damage and inflict Unravel for 5 seconds on hit.
Strand Turrets can be destroyed, but do not count as Constructs.

banes.name: Gravity
banes.description:
Gravity Combatants periodically lobs out an accurate Vortex Mortar every 8 seconds towards Guardians up to 45 meters away, and have 60% Damage Resist.
Vortex Mortar implodes on impact, pulling in Guardians within 6? meters.
Vortex slowly expands in size to 9 meters while dealing Void Damage over Time for 4.5 seconds.
After 4.5 seconds, the Vortex detonates, dealing moderate Void Damage over 9 meters.

Inflicting Suppression on a Gravity Combatant temporarily disables their ability to generate Vortex projectiles.

banes.name: Healing
banes.description:
Healing-Affixed Combatants bestow Health Regeneration to Combatants within 20 meters. Does not affect Champions, Bosses, or themselves.
Combatants with the Health Regeneration buff continuously restore HP. while within range.

Rank-and-File Combatants restore 2.25% HP every 0.1 seconds (22.5% HP/s).
Elite Combatants restore 1% HP every 0.1 seconds (10% HP/s).

Inflicting Suppression on the Healing Combatant will disable its healing abilities while the debuff is active.

banes.name: Hypernova
banes.description:
Hypernova-Affixed Combatants trigger a Self-Destruct Sequence after being lowered to 67% Health and have a lower-than-average 40% Damage Resist.

Self-Destruct Sequence:
Ocurrs over 7 seconds, ending in an explosive blast that deals Massive Solar Damage, inflicts x40 Scorch, and knocking back all entities within 40 meters.
Hypernova Combatants' Damage Resist increases to 60% and restore 8.25% HP/s during the arming sequence.
Nuclear Blast also kills the Hypernova Combatant in the process.

Self-Destruct can be safely prevented by killing the Nuclear Combatant.
Self-Destruct Damage can be partially avoided by being in cover (Inflicts Scorch) or fully avoided by being over 40 meters away.

banes.name: Medusa
banes.description: Medusa-Affixed Combatants inflict x5 Slow every 0.25 seconds while being looked at until either becoming frozen or no longer looking.

banes.name: Meteors
banes.description:
Meteor-Affixed Combatants release 3 Solar Meteors every 20 seconds.

Meteors track to nearby Guardians within 60 meters, exploding on impact and dealing Moderate Solar Damage.

Meteors can be destroyed by shooting at them, making them collide on surfaces, or avoided by taking cover.

Invisible Guardians are not able to be tracked.

banes.name: Mines
banes.description:
Mine-Affixed Combatants release 4 Proximity-Triggered Mines in a ♦️diamond formation on death.

Mines deal up to 200 damage, down to a minimum of 50 damage, and can be destroyed by dealing damage to them.

Inflicting Suppression on the Mines Combatant will prevent them from releasing mines on death.

banes.name: Promoted
banes.description:
Promoted-Affixed Combatants (from the Battlefield Promotion Modifier) gain 60% Damage Resist, deal 6.25% increased damage, and become ~50% physically larger.
Champions, Bosses, and Affixed-Combatants cannot receive the Promoted Affix.

Inflicting Suppresion on a Promoted Combatant temporarily disables their Damage Resist and shrinks them down to regular size.

banes.name: Protected
banes.description:
Protected-Affixed Combatants are guarded by 3 Drones, each with 100 HP.

Protected Combatants receive 90% Damage Resist for as long as a Protecting Drones is present.

Destroying all drones removes the Protected Bane status and accompanying Damage Resist.

banes.name: Pummel
banes.description:
Pummel-Affixed Combatants have an Immunity Shield until Physical Melee Damage is received, permanently destroying their Shield.
Pummel Combatants lose their immunity and have no Damage Resist after losing their Shield.
Despite the Immunity Shield, they are susceptible to crowd control effects such as Slow, Freeze, and Suspend.
Glaive Melee and Sword Attacks can break the Immunity Shield.

Breaking the Immunity Shield causes the Pummel Combatant, as well as other combatants within ? meters to be disoriented for 4 seconds.

banes.name: Rage
banes.description:
Rage-Affixed Combatants deal incrementally higher damage, have increasingly higher Damage Resist, and grow in size as their health is reduced.

Damage Resist begins at 60% DR at 100% HP, gradually rising up to 90% Damage Resist upon reaching 30% HP.
Damage Buff increases linearly from 0% Increased Damage at 100% HP, up to 70% Increased Damage at 10% HP.
Size Increases maxes out at ~50% Increased Enemy Size.

banes.name: Screeber
banes.description:
Screeber-Affixed Combatants periodically release a Mini-Screeb every 3 seconds.

Screeber Combatants release 6 Mini-Screebs upon dying.

banes.name: Shield
banes.description:
Shield-Affixed Combatants possess an invulnerable frontal shield, as well as 30% Damage Resist.

Shield can be penetrated by Shield-Piercing Weapons.

banes.name: Shielded
banes.description:
Shielded-Affixed Combatants bestow a Permanent Overshield to Combatants within 20 meters. Does not affect Champions, Bosses, or themselves.
Overshield has 600 HP and does not receive Precision Multipliers or Energy Weapon Multipliers, but takes ~390% increased damage, reducing it to ~155 eHP.
Overshield is not actually a Void Shield, despite being visually purple, and will not receive increased damage from Void sources.

Combatants with Overshields continuously regenerate their Overshield at a rate of 150 (~38 eHP) Overshield HP/s (25%/s).
Breaking the Overshield permanently removes the Overshield.

Inflicting Suppression on the Shielding Combatant will disable its shielding abilities while the debuff is active.

Killing the Shielding Combatant will instantly remove all existing Overshields.

banes.name: Shock
banes.description:
Shock-Affixed Combatants build up a Shock Charge over ? seconds, and tether to Guardians within 30 meters and in line of sight.
Shock Charge is discharged to tethered Guardians, dealing Severe Arc Damage to them.

Inflicting Suppression on the Shock Combatant will disable Shock Charge build up while the debuff is active.
Invisible Guardians are not able to be tethered.

Shock Combatants explode on death, dealing Arc Damage to Combatants within 15 meters.

banes.name: Shroud
banes.description:
Shroud-Affixed Combatants project an aura that camouflages other Combatants within 14 meters. Does not affect other Banes, Champions, or Bosses.

Camouflaged Combatants are rendered almost fully invisible, except for overlayed effects such as debuffs and their shadow, and have no Name Plate.
Aim Assist and tracking projectiles work as usual. Effects that rely on directly targeting an enemy (such as Final Warning) do not work on the camouflaged combatants.

Inflicting Suppression on the Shroud Bane Combatant temporarily removes the camouflage from other Combatants.

banes.name: Slowing
banes.description:
Slowing-Affixed Combatants project a slowing field over ? meters and and have 35% Damage Resist.
Guardians inside the slowing field are instantly inflicted x10 Slow, followed by x5 Slow every 0.3 seconds while remaining inside.

Inflicting Suppression on the Slowing Combatant will disable its slowing field while the debuff is active.

banes.name: Threaded
banes.description: Threaded-Affixed Combatants release a hostile Threadling upon being dealt NON-Precision Damage with a 0.3 second cooldown between each spawn.

banes.name: Zealous
banes.description:
Zealous-Affixed Combatants bolster Combatants within 20 meters on death by enraging them.

Enraged Combatants:
Affected Combatants become aggressive, receive 35% Damage Resist, shoot more frequently in longer bursts.
Additionally, they are unaffected by Blind, Suppression, and cannot be finished.
Combatants explode on death or after being enraged for 20 seconds, dying in the process.
Explosion can harm Guardians, dealing up to 50 Damage, down to a minimum of 15 Damage, and inflicting heavy knockback.

Zealous Combatants, as well as Enraged Combatants are unaffected by Blind, Disorient, and Suppression, but remain susceptible to other CC effects.
